reviews.title: Kevin’s Meals Are a Weekly Staple in Our Home
reviews.text: I absolutely love Kevin’s chicken and beef entrées and sauces. These meals are delicious, convenient, and incredibly easy to prepare. I buy 7 to 8 of them every week because my family enjoys them so much. The flavors are always great, and the sauces are especially tasty and full of flavor. I like pairing the meals with rice, cauliflower rice, or cabbage with heavy whipping cream, depending on which family member I’m cooking for and their individual diet preferences. The only downside is that I wish they were a little more affordable, although I do occasionally find them on sale when the expiration date is getting closer. I’m also hoping to try the Kevin’s pan soon since I’ve seen a lot of positive reviews about it. Overall, these meals do not disappoint. They are a lifesaver for quick, flavorful dinners, and I highly recommend them.

reviews.title: Really good, but better!!
reviews.text: The first time I prepared this, it was pretty good, but I felt it needed something. Everything needs a little something. I love it for those " I really don't want to cook, but I want a great meal night". I saute sliced shallots (or your favorite allium) in olive oil and add chopped garlic in a non-stick pan, then remove from the pan and set aside. I then add a little more olive oil and some toasted sesame oil to the pan and saute sliced red/orange/yellow pepper or whatever pepper you have or prefer. I usually have blanched, frozen asparagus that I throw in as well but any vegetable will do. I remove the vegetables from the pan and add a little more olive oil to the pan and add the chicken to heat, then add all ingredients together including the sauce and heat through. I serve it over some jasmine or basmati ready rice in the pouch (Yes, I said I didn't want to cook) and top with toasted sesame seeds and sliced green onions if I have them. I buy sesame seeds and toast them and put them back in their container and refrigerate to have on hand. This makes two decent, delicious servings. Enjoy!

reviews.text: Because the sodium levels seemed a lot less than other processed Asian foods, I gave it a try and boy was it good! Not overly processed, tasted fresh, chicken was tender. I added stir-fry veggies and some healthy rice and that was a winner. Will buy again!

reviews.title: Nicely Surprised
reviews.text: I often toss an entree from some new line of healthy frozen meal, only to be enormously disappointed at mealtime. Not the case here! Setting the bar low due to these previous experiences, I was incredibly surprised by this product, which I served with Kevin’s fried rice. Excellent taste and consistency. The chicken was moist and there was plenty of it, unlike other prepared meals I’ve bought. This is the real deal! BTW, the rice was awesome too. A perfect combo.

reviews.title: Authenticate and Yummy Flavor!
reviews.text: This was far better and was more authenticate than I expected. My mother and I loved it and said we need to prepare two packs at once because we wanted more leftovers! Will definitely be a staple item in my fridge and can't wait to prepare for guests!

reviews.title: Bought on a whim --> SO good!!!
reviews.text: I randomly choose this meal as the photo looked yummy. I had low hopes though, as I usually do w/warm up meals, but it was SO good!!! I wish I had rice too, since there is some excess sauce (yay!). WILL buy again!!

reviews.title: A Health Food with Flavor
reviews.text: So I picked this up as a healthy option as our family tries to move away from the bad foods. This definitely did not disappoint. I served this over a bed of rice. Kevin your apart of our family now🫶🏽

reviews.title: A twist
reviews.text: This has become a staple for us. I never purchase premade foods but this one is delicious. I wanted to share that we typically dice sweet potato in this dish (cooked in advance) and it’s delicious. If we need to stretch it more because we have company I will serve it over rice berry or add chickpeas.

reviews.title: Awesome Curry!
reviews.text: I rarely ever purchase pre made foods. The sous vide chicken was just as good as the chicken I sous vide at home. I served this over multi grain rice, added some fresh squeezed lime and cilantro. It was a perfect meal. Now I am going to go out and see what other Kevin's products our local food stores might carry.

reviews.title: Tasty on the taste buds
reviews.text: I always steered clear of ever trying a curry. But I felt adventurous and decided to try it. It was wonderful! I will be buying this again.

reviews.title: Thai coconut chicken
reviews.text: Excellent flavor, texture and ease of preparation. Left over chicken made a delicious Thai curry chicken salad. Chopped chicken, celery, red onion, raisins, cashews moistened with left over sauce served on a lettuce leaf. Loved it twice!!!

reviews.title: Love this with Mango!
reviews.text: I love this product, especially when I add fresh mango to it after cooking but long enough for the mango to warm.

reviews.title: So good!
reviews.text: Super good, clean ingredients and doesn’t have fish sauce (I’m highly allergic to any seafood) like so many Thai dishes do! Had it for lunch and already craving more. 😋

reviews.title: 10 yr Palio
reviews.text: I have been waiting for someone to come up with palio on the go. This is awesome! Has a great kick blended in with smooth creamy coconut sweetness. I love Thai food! Im going to try more of these entrees. Im hoping for snack bars in palio as everything granola!

reviews.title: Don't let other reviews deter you
reviews.text: I sm not sure why there are such negative reviews. I absolutely love this product and like many other Kevin's products its clean ingredients make it a clean taste. I don't have to worry about preservatives getting in the way. I will continue buying these dishes over and over!! #Tryazon #KevinsNaturalFoods #getthatcleaneatingfeeling #GreatFood #CleanEating

reviews.title: The chicken is great--moist, heats up well,
reviews.text: The chicken is great--moist, heats up well, excellent texture. The sauce has a nice creamy consistency and it does not taste bad, but it is not anything like garlic. I would need to re-check the ingredients, but to me it tasted as though coconut milk or some other coconut product had been used, because that's what I tasted. So I was disappointed, but if this tasted like garlic, I'd love it!

reviews.title: I love these meals! Loved the vibrant cream
reviews.text: I love these meals! Loved the vibrant cream sauce! I have had 3 Kevin's so far and am very impressed!! So glad my local store carries them and I found them!

reviews.title: I wish I could add images to this post
reviews.text: I wish I could add images to this post. The advertising on the front of this packaging is some of the biggest false advertisement I’ve ever seen. The “vibrant cream sauce” is more like a dull brown gravy. Has zero flavor and the chicken looks plastic. Will never buy this product of anything from this company again.

reviews.title: I microwaved
reviews.text: I microwaved. Directions were a little confusing at first. After thawing i just broke into chunks. lt was soaked with that liquid so I drained as instructed. I wasn’t crazy about chicken texture and I thought the sauce was horrible. Not sure why everyone is rating this so high.

reviews.title: Great Chicken
reviews.text: Great and efficient. I am a huge fan of the time and stress that was saved. The texture was good, but the sauce was very lacking. I might try other flavors, but I might not get this one again unless I get some spices to go with it.

reviews.title: I absolutely love this garlic roasted chicken
reviews.text: I absolutely love this garlic roasted chicken. It is WAY too hard to share!

reviews.title: Please don't let any of the negative reviews
reviews.text: Please don't let any of the negative reviews deter you from giving these a try. They are AMAZING! So far, I have tried the roasted garlic, thai curry, and korean bbq, and they have all been so flavorful, tender, and delicious. I have some pretty strict health-related food limitations, and finding these tasty, easy meals has been such a boon. I love that they have very minimal carbs, no seed oils, no wheat/grains/seeds/beans and lots of quality protein. I have a very busy schedule, so being able to grab one of these from my freezer in the morning makes dinner prep take about a minute. I like to eat them with riced cauliflower and some broccoli, and add a little butter for some extra fat. So tasty! These are a gonna be a regular entry on my grocery list for sure!

reviews.title: It doesn't like chicken, it feels like chewing
reviews.text: It doesn't like chicken, it feels like chewing on rubber. That was a nig waste of $10.

reviews.title: This was absolutely delicious!
reviews.text: This was absolutely delicious. The chicken was tender and moist, and the gravy was thick and flavorful. Read the directions - drain the broth (I sipped on mine separately). I would recommend pairing with some steamed broccoli.

reviews.title: Missed the Mark
reviews.text: I expected the “vibrant cream sauce” to be tomato based as the photo showed, but it just looked (and tasted) like brown gravy. I’ve had other products from your company before, and they have been good. This one just missed the mark, so much so that felt compelled to provide feedback.

reviews.title: Very disappointing. The sauce is brown??
reviews.text: I was really disappointed by this meal. Definitely false advertisement with the photo used on the front of the package. In the photo the sauce appears to be a creamy orange/red color. But when you open your box you get a package of brown gravy like sauce. I honestly wondered if we got the wrong sauce on accident? Didn’t taste at all like roasted garlic. It tasted like a bland gravy. Might want to rethink this recipe Kev

reviews.title: First experience, not very positive
reviews.text: Wife picked up the Garlic Chicken for dinner tonight, since she said she heard great things about Kevin brand food on TikTok. We had just had Thai and so I passed over the Thai Coconut chicken that she had heard about and got this instead. Sous vide chicken is a different texture, so I expected that (which seems to be a complaint from some people online). What bothered me, though, is this sauce that's supposed to be a slightly orange, garlicky flavor was a grey, flat watery mess. It had next to no flavor at all, aside from what just tasted... off. This is despite ensuring everything was drained and cooked properly. Chicken was decent enough, which does require a little extra TLC to prepare if you're not used to sous vide for your meats. Nothing extraordinary, but actually on par with my expectations (which is what gives the 2nd star). My wife had 2 bites and ordered pizza instead. Very underwhelming and sad considering how hyped the brand was.

reviews.title: Make sure all juice is drained
reviews.text: Make sure all juice is drained from package. Cook chicken until all extra juice evaporates. Add sauce and reduce. I did add more garlic. The sauce packet should be twice the size so one can put it over rice.

reviews.title: Got this at kroger
reviews.text: Got this at kroger. First and last time I will get a Kevins item. This was so bland. Says roasted garlic but there was no flavor of anything at all. And the chicken itself taste like chicken from a can. Will not bother getting another flavor. Too expensive for it to be so bad.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Saw this at Costco. Thought I’d give it a try for a quick meal. Not as pictured on packaging. Says chicken strips - but not. Two chicken “breast” pieces that fell apart. Sauce was runny/watery and not creamy. Not sure what the overall flavor was but it wasn’t garlic. Very salty. Won’t buy again. Hoping the Korean Bbq Beef is better.

reviews.title: Did not enjoy
reviews.text: We did not enjoy this, thought I could serve it with pasta but didn’t go well and just a tangy sauce that wasn’t good.

reviews.title: Like bland gravy
reviews.text: I love your Coconut Thai chicken so I thought I would try this one. The "vibrant" sauce was more like a bland gravy. The chicken was good but we only ate a few bites and tossed the rest out. Very disappointing.

reviews.title: Most delicious sauce!
reviews.text: This is a staple in our house, we love the delicious, deep savory garlic sauce. Wish the sauce was jarred and sold separate!

reviews.title: Sauce is very bad but chicken is good
reviews.text: My husband and I picked this up at Costco because he is watching his cholesterol and we were hoping it could become a staple in our house. However the sauce was SO BAD. Almost airplane food inedible. We ended up washing it off and using tomato sauce to dress the chicken which was actually quite good!

reviews.title: Not a fan of this one
reviews.text: The roasted garlic sauce is pretty mid. I love garlic, but this just has a burnt garlic taste that’s somewhat unpleasant.

reviews.title: More coconut than garlic tasting
reviews.text: We picked this up at Costco and mixed it up with some noodles. This is very much more coconuty than garlic. Very bland, very so-so and we even tried to doctor it up a bit with red pepper flakes. It's just..... it's not great. Wouldn't spend my money on this again.

reviews.title: Sauce
reviews.text: I actually love this dish. It's perfect when I want something on the lighter side. Downsides, I buy it at Costco and it's hit or miss when they have it. Also I wish I could buy the sauce on its own as well. So when it was not in stock at Costco I could still make it

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: The taste and quantity simply weren’t worth the price. Might be worth it if the cost was cut in half or something. But will not purchase again.

reviews.title: Good chicken
reviews.text: It’s actually pretty good. I eat it with pasta and red pepper flakes. Kind of tastes like chicken Marsala. But I took off 1 star because it’s enough for one serving only. It’s not enough my 2 sons to split, 13 yr and 8 yr. And my 75 yr old mom eats like a bird and still not enough. I have to buy at least 4 to feed all of us. I only weigh 100 lb and needs lots of protein. I think Whole Foods sous vide chicken actually weigh true 14 oz to 16 oz. And Trader Joe’s sous vide is completely 16 oz. This is more like 10 oz.

reviews.title: not good at all.
reviews.text: Went into it thinking it was going to be good. and it was one of the blandest things I have ever put into my mouth. I would save your tastebuds and money. the chicken just fell apart, and the sauce was bland and looked nothing like the packaging.

reviews.title: Additions to Kevin's
reviews.text: The chicken is good if you docter it up. I sauté about 6 mushrooms slices in a separate pan first. Add an additional tablespoon of garlic, a few red pepper leaves and add the mixture to the chicken with the sauce. Serve with brown rice and some decent wine.

reviews.title: Honestly, awful. Would not recommend
reviews.text: This was not great. It didnt look anything like it did on the package. The sauce was fairly bland with a tiny bit of roasted garlic flavor. Definitely not "vibrent". The chicken was also lackluster. It was the texture of canned chicken rather than chicken slices. We will not be getting this again.

reviews.title: A family fav!!!
reviews.text: I am limited on my diet due to food allergies and then have a 2 year old who is beyond picky and this is one of those that work for both my allergies and her picky habits!!! We looooove the, what we call, gravy chicken.

reviews.title: Where's the garlic?
reviews.text: The garlic sauce was very diappointing. Other Sauces from Kevin's are very good so I was expecting something delicious. Not for me.

reviews.title: Garlic Chicken
reviews.text: After raving about the Beef Stroganoff, this dish missed the mark by a bit. The cooking instructions were inaccurate as the chicken did not brown quickly and I did mashed potatoes on the side although I think cauliflower pasta would have been better. Off the menu for now.

reviews.title: Mediocre
reviews.text: We were disappointed with the sauce, definitely not vibrant; would call it bland. The color of the sauce didn't even match the picture on the package: it was a pale beige. We were able to salvage it by adding capers and serving over a noodle package that had sufficient flavors.

reviews.title: Meh…
reviews.text: This is the first time For all the hype on the box it’s pretty disappointing. The cream sauce is described as “vibrant.” I’d call it mediocre. The chicken was good. I ended up adding more spices to liven it up. I must say the ingredient list is refreshing in that everything is normal stuff and understandable. I don’t know if I’d buy this again or not. But I’ll probably try the others varieties at some point but dial down my expectations.

reviews.title: quick and delicious
reviews.text: So delicious & easy for a quick weeknight meal. We sauteed 8 oz. sliced mushrooms & added steamed broccoli to the pan with the garlic chicken. YUM! A complete meal that took less than 10 minutes to make.

reviews.title: Roasted Garlic chicken
reviews.text: This is my fav! I I serve roasted garlic chicken with cauliflower rice and a vegetable, what a great meal!

reviews.title: Very, very tasty!
reviews.text: Easy to make, tasty to eat. I froze the package after getting home with because I didn't know when I'd make it. It froze really well and defrosted well in the fridge. I had some leftover rotini and poured it over those and it was fabulous!

reviews.title: Love this!!
reviews.text: I love to meal prep for my lunch during the week and I must say, these entrees are absolutely delicious. I was skeptical at first because I usually just cook chicken during the week, but now I don't have to spend as much time preparing my lunches. I plan on trying every single one of these. I was going to snap a picture, but the chicken smelled so good, I just dived right it! Maybe next time!

reviews.title: Yum yum in my tum tum
reviews.text: This was delish!

reviews.title: AMAZING
reviews.text: I purchased the roasted garlic chicken while looking for healthier quick meal options. I have to say the flavor of this absolutely shocked me. It exceeded my expectations by far! The chicken is so tender and the sauce is very flavorful. Definitely will be purchasing again and again!

reviews.title: My favorite!!
reviews.text: This is my favorite Kevin’s Chicken! It’s sooo good!! Please make this available as a sauce!!

reviews.title: Great for a cold winter's night dinner!
reviews.text: I needed something that would warm both my insides and my taste buds. I haven't had good luck with the taste of pre-pared foods before, but I made some brown rice and Kevin's Garlic Chicken tonight. Five minutes from pan to plate, and it was delicious! Also healthy and enough for two meals. It will just need a warm-up tomorrow night. I can't wait to try some of the other choices. That was truly a yummy meal on a bitterly cold winter's night!

reviews.title: What a wonderful discovery!
reviews.text: My friend made the Roast Garlic Chicken for me the other night and I am in LOVE with it! I can't wait to pick up some for myself and to also try other flavors. I love Kevin's story and mission! Sometimes if you want something done right, you have to do it yourself! Glad to have Kevin doing it for me :)

reviews.title: DELICIOUS!!! Tender, flavorful.
reviews.text: Mind blown - sous vide chicken is scrumptious, the sauce is so good they should bottle and sell that too! So flavorful! The package says serves 3 and it is true, definitely plenty of tender, white meat chicken breast for 3 people's meal. Will definitely buy it again and again.

reviews.title: Mannnnn!
reviews.text: Now Kevin out did himself with this one. I kept going back to the pan for more. That sauce was BOMB. Although it tasted great without adding anything else, I did add some wine wine and spinach. I did not use any seasoning. It was perfect!

reviews.title: Pleasant surprise
reviews.text: My husband has difficulty swallowing and this chicken so tender. The sauce is perfect. We are new to Kevin’s products but will definitely buy more.

reviews.title: Fantastic!! Honestly,I don’t understand the haters.
reviews.text: Honestly I don’t understand the hater on here that keeps leaving a one star review.. This is DELICIOUS quick easy to make and healthy meal. Perfect for nights I don’t want to cook! Will be repurchasing again!

reviews.title: WTF Kevin, figure it out man... This is gross
reviews.text: I have eaten at many Indian restaurants and I can assure you this tastes nothing like actual Tikka Masala, incredibly disappointing.... Tastes nothing like Tikka Masala to the point I believe either all positive reviews are lies or just plain sad, because these people have never had actual Tikka Masala and if they ever do will either hate it because they believe it should taste like this imposter or love it and be completely confused as to what the heck they have been eating....Some weird spice combination that slightly tastes Italian but not really at the same time.

reviews.title: And they, within minutes, remove negative reviews
reviews.text: Pay no attention to the start rating. It's not an accurate reflection of reviews.

reviews.title: Was disturbingly bad
reviews.text: This was depressingly, unsettling poor. Kinda offended that my grocery store is offering this product, especially at this price point. Astounded that there are positive reviews out here.

reviews.title: DO NOT BUY!!!
reviews.text: Never enough for three servings chicken looks like it's animal feed low quality and isn't even in pieces as the instructions say separate into pieces and this tikka masala does not taste anywhere near what a tikka masala should taste like

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: I loved this dish over rice.

reviews.title: It’s a 12
reviews.text: This was extraordinaire really good. It tasted like restaurant quality food delicious😋

reviews.title: This one is very good. Cilantro lime
reviews.text: This one is very good. I recommend cooking in skillet. Break up the pieces in bag. Then put in a strainer. Drain excess liquid. Then I rinse water on chicken. Strain all the excess water. I use 1 tbsp evoo. Then I brown the chicken until no liquid is in pan. Pour sauce in pan, mix and cook for 5 min. I get to meals. I serve with brown rice.

reviews.title: Very tasty and this is real chicken
reviews.text: Very tasty and this is real Chicken! it’s not pressed meat It doesn’t have a weird spongy texture and It has great, fresh flavor! Sometimes I use It plain and sometimes I use the cilantro pack that comes with It, over rice. Have used several times and will use again. It’s consistent and flavorful. Great to use on nights you’re tired because it’s very quick and easy

reviews.title: Good for a quick meal that is healthy!
reviews.text: I received a free sample from Tryazon. We all liked the chicken - for a quick, easy meal option, it was moist and tasted fresh. We made rice bowls then used the leftovers for nachos and it was good in both dishes.

reviews.title: Cilantro Lime Chicken
reviews.text: This Kevin’s Cilantro Lime Chicken was easy to prepare and paired perfectly over rice. The chimichurri sauce was packed with flavor and this dish is great for the whole family to enjoy. I love that it has two meals in one package. I recommend these meals for an easy weeknight dinner.

reviews.title: We loved Kevin’s Cilantro Lime Chicken!
reviews.text: We recently purchased the Kevin’s Cilantro Lime Chicken entree from Costco to give it a try. I am a busy mom who likes to feed her family as clean as possible. This dish was quick and delicious…we will definitely be purchasing again! We served over cauliflower rice but you could add in tacos, over regular rice or so many other possibilities.

reviews.title: Tried for the 1st time last night - Delicious and Easy
reviews.text: Tried for the 1st time last night. Excellent flavor and low carb makes it a super easy meal. I didn't know what to except with pre-made chicken. The sauce waa delicious and the texture of the chicken was so tender and yummy. I will definitely purchase more!

reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.text: Delicious. We like to use this for chicken tacos! Corn tortillas, cheese, lettuce and hot sauce. Yum!

reviews.title: Many ways to use this Kevin's Cilantro Chicken
reviews.text: The first time we made the cilantro chicken I was a bit skeptical because it seemed there was not enough chicken to feed 3 people (as the package suggests). We put it over rice and it was sufficient for two. We just made it again and this time decided to use it in a burrito wrap. We put some shredded cheddar cheese down on the wrap, heated the chicken with the chimichurri sauce as directed allowing the chicken to soak up all that flavor, then we took just the chicken and put it on the burrito with the cheese, added some other veggies, wrapped them up, sprayed them with some avocado spray, then put them in the air fryer for about 10 minutes. Served them with the chimichurri sauce and some sour cream on the side. Plenty for 3+ people and really delicious. The whole process took about 12 minutes from start to finish. Unfortunately we didn't take pictures because they smelled and looked so good, and we were so hungry that we dove right in. Perfect meal when you don't feel like cooking. Looking forward to trying some of the other Kevin's options and getting creative with them.

reviews.title: Great Taste and Easy Preparation
reviews.text: I was so pleased with the taste of this easy to prepare and healthy entree. My family of 3 adults each had enough food to eat with the addition of rice and a healthy vegetable. Thanks for making a great and easy meal for my family and I to enjoy.

reviews.title: This is a terrific, quick, and delicious addition
reviews.text: This is a terrific, quick, and delicious addition to anybody doing paleo or ketogenic diets!

reviews.title: I weighed the chicken and it was not a lb of
reviews.text: I weighed the chicken and it was not a lb of chicken. Barely enough for one person . The price (12$) for less than a pound of chicken. First and last time buying thes . Highly disappointed

reviews.title: It's alright
reviews.text: It's alright. Works for a quick meal with better ingredients than alternatives. But every entree I've tried is too sweet. I don't understand the need to add sweeteners to everything. Sure, there isn't white sugar added... but monkfruit, coconut sugar, [enter weird "natural" sugar alternative here]. Sigh. It's hard enough that every protein bar on the market is like a dessert, do we really need entrees to taster like candy, too? It'd really be nice to be able to buy quick meals, but alas, I end up making everything from scratch to avoid sweeteners. The instructions are also a little misleading, they instruct you to massage the meat in the packet, but then to sear it in strips. Once you massage it, it's a bunch of shedded bits of chicken, not actual strips. Solid idea, not the best execution.

reviews.title: Chicken
reviews.text: First look was a turn off. The chicken looked like it was chopped and formed with strange looking meat layer that looked fake. Im convinced this is printed chicken I couldnt even swallow it. The texture was weird. Huge turn off, threw that 11 doller meal in the trash.

reviews.title: Delicious!
reviews.text: We love this! Chicken is excellent, not sure what other reviewers experienced but ours has been consistently great. Sauce is very tasty. This is our go-to meal when we don’t want to spend a lot of time cooking.

reviews.title: Not a fan
reviews.text: First and last time I will try this. Chicken has a weird texture and doesn’t taste like chicken or anything for that matter. The sauce is just a chimichurri sauce with no real flavor other than what tasted like cat food. It was missing the flavor of real chicken, the brightness of real lime and freshness of real cilantro.

reviews.title: Delish!
reviews.text: First time trying a Kevin’s entree and we loved it. Husband is keto and I’m low-sugar, GF, and corn free as I’m trying to get to the root of an autoimmune condition. It was so nice that this was something we both could eat. I also added green peppers and onion to the pan, and made a side dish of sweet potato fries. Perfect meal! We both love cilantro and the flavor was so very good. It was certainly enough for 2 people, especially with the extra veggies.

reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text: The chicken was somehow pressed together like a chicken nugget but still have some grain. The meat seemed very low quality. I was expecting this to be very good but it was awful. Do not waste your money on this.

reviews.title: Rip off
reviews.text: Package says 2 lbs, but only 1 lb and half of that is sauce. Complete bs

reviews.title: Tastes Great
reviews.text: I was a little nervous reading some of the reviews. I added my touch to the dish. Heat a little olive oil, sauté some red onion and green peppers. Add the chicken, and let it simmer. Add the sauce packet and let it heat thoroughly. Add some rice, I used Spanish rice and some black beans on the side. I enjoyed it!

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: Aside from the fact that the portions are misleading, I didn’t think it was good. There is too much lime in the sauce, not at all close to chimichurri, it’s really a weird combination of flavors.

reviews.title: Tasty and healthy but you get 2/3 of what they say you do
reviews.text: Since I'm tracking macros, I weigh my food on a food scale before consuming. I've had almost all of Kevin's meals, and every single one of them shorted me based on the nutrition label. It states 5oz is a serving and there are approximately three servings. This is categorically false. There are closer to two servings in every container. I like having a serving and a half for extra protein and satiation, and I am left with about three ounces of food after I portion out 7.5 oz. If it truly were three servings, these meals would be perfect for me. Instead, I feel shorted and lied to. Very disappointing.

reviews.title: Where’s the flavor?
reviews.text: Honestly it could be better if it says cilantro lime chicken, it has no flavor, not even SALT. It’s actually pretty bad, the chicken itself is just disgusting and adding the “chimichurri” makes no difference. It’s just oil and herbs. Waste of money!!

reviews.title: AWESOME CILANTRO LIME CHICKEN!!
reviews.text: I tried this for the first time today and WOW Im blown away by the taste & versatility of what u can make with it. I made Cilantro Lime Chicken Linguine. Sauteed the Chicken w Mushrooms & Chopped Baby Asparagus tips added to cooked Linguine. It was fabulous!! I like that the chicken & sauces are separate. Makes it easy to pack for lunch at work for a healthier meal than settling for fast food or expensive delivery. Going to try Kevins Thai Coconut Chicken fixed with their Cilantro Lime Rice and adding some sauteed pea pods next. THANKU KEVINS!! I appreciate the portable convenience, delicious taste & good price of ur products. Also the fact many of ur items have no milk or dairy used. (In some there are.) Please add more delicious items without Dairy or with Almond or Coconut milk/cream for those ppl allergic to Dairy. Chivken Tikka/Butter Chicken is one Im looking for & anything with Ginger added. Great job & Keep em coming!

reviews.title: Tacos!
reviews.text: Do yourself a favor and make this into tacos- they are super easy to make and really good when you don’t have the time to make some from scratch. Cut the chicken into bite sized pieces, brown them in a frying pan and then add the sauce as directed. Serve on a small flour tortilla, topped with chopped white onion, chopped avocado, chopped cilantro and sour cream. You’re welcome! One pouch makes about 4 small tacos.

reviews.title: Serving sizes are misleading
reviews.text: This is the second time I’ve had this product and I genuinely liked it both times but I do feel like the labeling and portion size is misleading. It says there is about 3 servings per container and the serving size is 5oz. There should be somewhere near 15oz of product but it’s definitely closer to 10oz. I strongly encourage the company to update their labeling to be more accurate because this is misleading consumers.

reviews.title: Disgusting
reviews.text: Probably one of the most disgusting meals I’ve had in a while. I’ll throw the leftovers in the garbage.

reviews.title: Healthy Flavor
reviews.text: I purchased this not knowing it was a healthy meal. I didn't even pay it any attention. It was delightful! Everyone loves it, and I am so thankful I got it. I love it and my friends and family do too.

reviews.title: Cilantro Lime Chicken Forever
reviews.text: This entree is the best ever. Cannot get over how good a pre-prepped meal could taste as great as this one. I have been cooking mostly home made all of my life (and it's a long time) and this one deserves 10 stars. My husband and I enjoy it with curly pasta and a side of freshly sliced carrots with honey and cinnamon. Albsolutely fabulous. Keep up the good work.

reviews.title: Love this one!
reviews.text: The cilantro lime chicken meal makes wonderful burrito bowls, tacos, nachos, burritos....all the things. It's also a great filling for enchiladas verde and a great addition to chilaquiles. But my favorite use for it (the sauce specifically) is to add flavor and brightness to chicken tortilla soup......really nice addition to your soup stock base. I love that you can get the sauce by itself for certain recipes. I would like to see the sauce sold in a bottle or resealable container (maybe put a capped spout on the existing bags?), but that's just a wish list item that will not affect how often I purchase this product. This one is definitely in my top three for Kevin's products.

reviews.title: AMAZING
reviews.text: I was completely blown away by this entree. I paired it with a gluten free pasta and it was absolutely amazing. I have found myself going back to the store for more weekly!!! It’s easy and quick and reasonably priced. I was able to make two meals out of one entree. So glad I found this product.

reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.text: I am hooked only tried two so far but they are delicious alittle pricey but worth it on occasion

reviews.title: Explosively Delicious
reviews.text: Wow! It was so good! The look of the sauce threw me off a little but one bite and I was sold. I probably ate ate the try by myself!

reviews.title: I love it!
reviews.text: Cilantro Lime Chicken - quick and easy. Very tasty!

reviews.title: Delicious !
reviews.text: Bought this at Costco to try as it looked interesting. What a treat! A delicious blend of flavors. I serve it with cilantro lime rice as I love cilantro. Can't wait to try more of Kevin's dishes.
We just tried our first Kevin's entree, the Cilantro Lime Chicken. It was delicious! Looking forward to trying more of your entrees!

reviews.title: Getting more asap 🤩
reviews.text: Found this at Costco today and couldn't believe how tasty it was. My husband devoured his which surprised me since he doesn't care much for cilantro or lime... he even declined shredded Mexican cheese on top after having a test bite, saying it had perfect flavor on its own. I'm quite fond of Kevin's coconut curry chicken, but this one is my new favorite. I'm going to pick up a few more tomorrow while they're on sale to freeze. Highly recommended!

reviews.title: WOW!
reviews.text: This was my first purchase of any Kevin product. We found it at Costco. I'm so impressed with this dish, from ease of cooking, to flavor, that now I'm on the hunt for more!!! I have 2 grown men, and myself that I cook for. It was the perfect amount!! Not salty (I was worried), it was all just right! Kevin, where have you been all my life!!!

reviews.title: Very Good
reviews.text: I so love this product, so tasty. I would definitely recommend. I added chopped onions and more cilantro. (Not necessary) I will be purchasing more.

reviews.title: WOW!
reviews.text: I purchased the Cilantro Lime Chicken and I was not expecting it to taste the way it did, it was soo good!! and the cook time was awesome! I will be buying this again and I plan to try other flavors.

reviews.title: Only 1 chili Pepper? No way!
reviews.text: Tasty, but too spicy! Please lower the spice level so we can all enjoy them.

reviews.title: The best entree of them all
reviews.text: This is my favorite entree from Kevin's.

reviews.title: First Time Experience
reviews.text: Pleasantly surprised. The chicken was moist and tender. The cilantro seasoning was very tasty.I will definitely try more of these meals. I was skeptical about these type of products but this was fantastic.

reviews.title: First time trying this
reviews.text: I picked this up because of the low carb count. It was delicious. I will definitely purchase this again. My husband and I could probably eaten one each.

reviews.title: Best Prepared Meal
reviews.text: The Cilantro Lime Chicken was absolutely delicious! Easy to prepare, done in minutes. I served it with cauliflower rice with veggies mixed in. This was plenty for two people with some left over for lunch the next day. I will be trying other meals.

reviews.title: Fresh food
reviews.text: I live alone and preparing meals is a challenge. I picked up a package of the cilantro lime chicken and tried it tonight! Tomorrow I’ll go back and pickup different ones!! Soooooo delicious!

reviews.title: lemongrass chicken has great flavor
reviews.text: The natural lemongrass chicken had so much flavor. It was quick and easy to prepare. A healthy and delicious meal.

reviews.title: Delicious!!!
reviews.text: Delicious. First time trying a Kevin's product. Then reading about the entree I was sold on trying every one of them. Few carbs and lots of protein. Of course I upped the carb count by serving with rice, but believe me, this is a spectacular way to have great tasting meals in no time, that are also good for you. Thank you for bringing these products to market!! Francie

reviews.title: I was in bed & hungry...
reviews.text: I was in bed, half awake and hungry. I knew I wanted something hot and quick but dreaded the fridge search. Then it hit me! I have Kevin's in my freezer from my last trip to Costco. I totally, forget it was in there. I began to process the little bags of chicken and sauces with the help of a little warm water. I got everything into the pan as suggested; made me a pot of jasmine rice and a side of shrimp scampi. When I tell you how good my place smelled, the family started coming out of their rooms to see what that aroma was. The whole process took no more than 30mins in prep & cooking time. -- It was great! Just like the sample I had that day at Costco but better. The sweetness, creaminess, tenderness of the chicken and sauce was all worth it. The spice level was moderate and I opted to add a touch of pepper sauce to increase the heat. The only thing I wish I had on hand was fresh basil. I would purchase this product again and recommend it to friends and family. Thanks Kevin!

reviews.title: Delicious and super convenient
reviews.text: This is a delicious option to help a busy family eat nutritious and delicious protein. My partner has a hard time with tough proteins and this (and other sous vide options) are perfect for us.

reviews.title: Kevin's natural foods
reviews.text: Began with these tubs of chicken noodle, queso chicken soup and tuscan soup. So good I bought 3 cases and served to a local neurologist office. Then it happened. No longer available. To my delight ready in 5-minutes hit the shelves at Costco. Easy prep and at first bite I know this is what food would taste like in heaven! Sooooooooo delicious I use to cook gourmet whrn I was much younger. Nothing I prepared compaired to Kevin's. Hooe she does not sell his product line to big manufacfurers.

reviews.title: Delicious and Healthy!!
reviews.text: Had this meal with my family and we absolutely loved it! Very easy to cook and prepare along with it being tasty and flavorful!! After eating, I researched what other flavors may be available and came to this page. Reading Kevin’s story and the healthy ingredients that they use within their products made us want to buy more!! Can’t wait to try the others!

reviews.title: There was no sauce packet with my Chicken Marsala
reviews.text: There was no sauce packet with my Chicken Marsala.

reviews.title: Good But no enough Sauce
reviews.text: The taste was very good, and I thoroughly enjoyed it. The quality of the chicken was excellent as well. However, there wasn't enough sauce to cover the noodles I served it with, and the sauce contained only four small slices of mushrooms. I believe you could improve the dish by adding more sauce and more mushrooms!

reviews.title: So good!
reviews.text: I love Kevin’s meals, but the Chicken Marsala is my favorite. Delicious with really good ingredients. My go-to for a weeknight dinner with leftovers for lunch.

reviews.title: Pleasantly Surprised
reviews.text: After having Kevin's Chili Lime Chicken, and surprised it was very good. I decided to give another one of your products a try, so my husband and I had the Chicken Marsala. Wow, I have to say I am impressed with your product. The dish was creamy like the sauce had just been made, only suggestion is that it could of had a little less salt, but don't worry it did not stop us, we enjoyed it. I can't wait to try some of your other products that Costco carries.

reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.text: This entree is delicious and fancy enough to serve to guests. Best of all, it's gluten free. I highly recommend this product.

reviews.title: Sooo good!
reviews.text: This was the first entree we tried, and it was amazing! It's good enough to serve to guests. We have family members who are gluten intolerant, so this would be perfect to serve to them when they visit.

reviews.title: My go to nightly dinner
reviews.text: We absolutely love Kevin's Dinners our by far favorite is the Chicken Marsala. I just wish they sold the Marsala by it self so we can have extra sauce.

reviews.title: This meal was delicious! It is a healthy version
reviews.text: This meal was delicious! It is a healthy version of orange chicken. Most of the negative reviews are probably from not cooking it properly. If you follow the directions it is NOT watery or tasteless. People are so lazy they don't even read anymore. Mine came out fantastic. Thank you!

reviews.title: Inedible
reviews.text: I bought this for my celiac daughter. It was so bad that all she could eat was the broccoli, and she doesn’t like broccoli.

reviews.title: Flavorless, Bland, and Watery
reviews.text: This was honestly terrible. The chicken was dry and bland, the sauce tasted watery with almost no flavor, and the rice had a weird chewy texture. It looked nothing like the packaging, and the whole meal just tasted disappointing and low quality. The regular ready-made meals are usually pretty good, which made this even more disappointing.

reviews.title: It looks like cat food, the flavor of the sauce
reviews.text: It looks like cat food, the flavor of the sauce is absolutely disgusting and the texture is mushy. I bought this to serve as an easy protein but I will be throwing it in the trash instead. I am done wasting money on Kevin’s products.

reviews.title: Package claims 3ea 5 oz servings, chicken
reviews.text: Package claims 3ea 5 oz servings, chicken provided is 11.5 oz. Company says 16 oz includes sauce. Draining the unusable liquid from the chicken you get 9oz of protein. So now I have 1 portion of 5 oz and 1 portion of 4 oz with 1 ounce of sauce, and finally a portion of just 5 ounces of sauce. How does that make sense on the nutrition info?!? Kevin, you’re a scam and a liar. Do better

reviews.title: Worst Orange Chicken EVER
reviews.text: This is the worst orange chicken I have ever eaten! There was absolutely no flavor! I ended up throwing over half of it away. What a waste of money!

reviews.title: Need more
reviews.text: I have had several of your food options - I love the food and flavors . I love all the options . But the potions are pretty small 2.5 servings - so if I buy 2 boxes -I should be able to feed a family of 5 …I needed more chicken , more veggies , and more sauce . Still love the taste !!

reviews.title: THE BEST!!! Low Cal/high protein diet approved!
reviews.text: I have always been a fan of Chinese food. Orange chicken has always been my go to. As you know, the deep fried orange chicken is far from healthy. Kevin's Orange Chicken has been a game changer for me and my healthy lifestyle! I really do not miss the fried chicken! This hits the spot! Amazing flavor, chicken has great texture and love that it is high protein low calorie! Beef it up with some veggies (green beans, broccoli, carrots, onions) and a half cup of jasmine rice and BOOYAH!! You have a delicious, cravings satisfied meal for well under 500 calories!!

reviews.title: Fantastic!
reviews.text: Where do I start? Kevin's orange chicken is the best! I sauteed chopped onion in olive oil until translucent, add fresh broccoli florets and Kevin's chicken, cook for a few minutes, then add his sauce, some pieces of chunk pineapple, a handful of whole cashews and about a teaspoon of red pepper flakes. Serve over rice. Best my family or I have EVER had! Thank you, Kevin! The clean ingredients are appreciated more than you know! Can't wait to try the other flavors! YUM!!!!

reviews.title: Super easy and delicous
reviews.text: This is super easy to make, can be stored in the freezer, making it a good go-to, the chicken is so tender and juicy and the sauce is delicous. I have celiac disease so this is an amazing option for me.

reviews.title: Celiac Approved!!
reviews.text: Delicious. I have Celiac disease and need gluten free, dairy free and egg free. Finally a scrumptious prepared meal the two of us could eat. Thank you. Served with wild rice with quinoa and green beans. Will try other Kevin's meals soon.

reviews.title: I would eat a flip flop if it had this orange sauce on it!
reviews.text: The chicken was very tender, great flavor and the orange sauce is world class!

reviews.title: Better than my Very Good Local Restaurant
reviews.text: No kidding! This sauce is the OG! I've never had better. Served it with a little basmati and broccoli, carrots, and red peppers from fresh. Dinner in 15 easy minutes! LOVE LOVE LOVE! Will eventually find and try them all. It's the -only healthy- ready food there is.

reviews.title: Orange Chicken
reviews.text: I just tried the Orange Chicken for the first time. It was so good. I've tried the Cilantro Chicken several times. I'm glad this didn't disappoint. I will definitely get this again.

reviews.title: Really good!
reviews.text: Love it, but hard to find at my local stores.

reviews.title: My lil family Favorite
reviews.text: This is one of our favorites !

reviews.title: Great flavor
reviews.text: Just an easy dinner after a VERY busy day. THe flavor of this was amazing, had it over some brown rice. So easy and a great meal to just as a veggie too. I'll be getting this again

reviews.title: Quick easy and Yummy
reviews.text: I have a picky family and we gobbled this up! Used two packages for three eaters and we ate it all. Will certainly buy again

reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.text: Very easy to make healthy dinner. I added 1 chopped red pepper and 2 cups Broccoli to a frying pan with little oil cook few minutes. Then added the chicken cooked five minutes. After chicken heated through added the sauce. Make ahead some rice. Perfect meal under 30 minutes to prepare.

reviews.title: Great entree
reviews.text: I love that I found a Chinese food entree that is soy free. I love it so much because I can eat Chinese foods again and not worry about getting a migraine afterwards.

reviews.title: Yummy!
reviews.text: I finally found and made the orange chicken tonight. I was a little nervous making this for my boyfriend, because I didn’t know if he would like it or not. I made (the stovetop version) with white rice and a side of green beans. He really enjoyed it. I really liked it a lot, too! It was great! I didn’t get a picture because I ate mine too fast, it was so good!

reviews.title: GOOD
reviews.text: I liked it but it wasn't as good as others.

reviews.title: Deliciously good!
reviews.text: I am absolutely obsessed with Kevin’s Buffalo-Style Chicken! As someone trying to eat cleaner without sacrificing flavor, this is exactly what I needed in my life. The chicken is incredibly tender (sous-vide perfected) and the Buffalo sauce has the perfect tangy kick with a genuinely satisfying amount of spice—not too mild, not too overpowering. The best part? It is literally ready in 5 minutes, making it the perfect, high-protein, low-carb lunch or weeknight dinner when I’m in a rush. I love that it's Paleo-friendly and soy-free, so I don't have to worry about weird ingredients. I’ve tried it on its own, but it also makes for amazing, easy Buffalo chicken tacos or over a salad. If you love spicy food and need a 5-minute meal prep hack, this is it. Will be keeping my freezer stocked with this!

reviews.title: Nice surprise!
reviews.text: This dish was great and actually spicy! Wasn’t sure what to expect from the box. Didn’t taste like traditional buffalo sauce, actually quite better with more depth. I will buy again.

reviews.title: Spicy!
reviews.text: We love everything Kevin’s but this one was so spicy we couldn’t even eat it which was so disappointing. If you’re brave enough to try it, good luck!

reviews.title: A Greek meal in minutes
reviews.text: The Greek Lemon Chicken was a success for dinner. Step by step optional instructions to make the cooking for those squeeze in a meal days using the microwave. Or a little bit longer on the stove. The chicken was juicy and moist even before putting the sauce provided. Then adding the Greek deliciousness really stepped up the meal. The way I served it was on top of rice. You could even use for protein in a salad. As far as the portion size, there is enough for 4 adults meaning of you have kids in the mix you will have plenty. Can't wait to try other variations.

reviews.title: I was so excited to this new [to me] variety
reviews.text: I was so excited to this new [to me] variety. Kevin's is always so delicious and fresh tasting. I know you can microwave it, but I like to make these in a pan and add a fresh ingredient/herb. I paired it with a pita and tabbouleh salad

reviews.title: Fast, healthy and delicious!
reviews.text: This Greek lemon chicken is excellent and everyone in my family enjoys it. The chicken itself is wonderfully tender, with no odd pieces or stringiness. The lemon sauce is bright and savory. It is especially delicious served over rice, which soaks up every bit of the sauce. Preparation is simple. Whether you warm it on the stovetop or pop it in the microwave, the whole process takes under five minutes. I also appreciate how clean the ingredients are. There are no added sugars or weird ingredients I do not recognize. This is exactly the kind of meal I love having on hand. It is quick to prepare, healthy, and delicious enough that everyone in the family enjoys it. It is perfect for busy days when you want something fast but do not want to compromise on nutrition or flavor.

reviews.title: healthy and tasty
reviews.text: The Greek-Style Lemon Chicken was really tasty and full of flavor. I loved the bright lemon flavor combined with the Greek-inspired seasoning and just a touch of creaminess from the coconut milk. It was flavorful without feeling too heavy, and the flavors worked really well together. Definitely something I’d have again!

reviews.title: Delicious and easy!
reviews.text: I love how fast and easy it was to get on the table. Less than 10 minutes in the skillet. I am a big lemon chicken fan and this meal did not disappoint. The chicken was delicious! I was happily surprised that my kids ALL liked it. Half of them can be pretty picky so this was awesome. According to the packaging, this meal serves 6.5 people, however I would say if your people are bigger than ours, it might serve 4 to 5 as the chicken was only 18oz of the 32oz contents. When you see reviews for these meals, the servings on the plate are way bigger than 1/6th of this meal. Would definitely buy again though.

reviews.title: I really enjoyed this lemon chicken
reviews.text: I really enjoyed this lemon chicken Mediterranean meal the convenience of how easy it was and how much time it took to make also how fresh everything was and that everyone in my family enjoyed eating it.

reviews.title: Ideal easy dinner
reviews.text: Ideal easy dinner. We paired this with rice and it fed a full family of 5! Tastes great and filling

reviews.title: Quick & Easy
reviews.text: I really enjoyed trying Kevin's Greek-Style Lemon Chicken! It tastes great cooked on the stovetop and mixed with fresh vegetables. I love that it uses high-quality white chicken breast meat, is very low in carbs, and comes in a super convenient package with two individually wrapped chicken portions and separate sauce bags. It is incredibly easy to use and prepare. My only critique is that it is a bit expensive, which is why I am giving it 4 stars instead of 5. However, the quality and convenience make it worth trying!

reviews.title: Easy to prepare!
reviews.text: My husband and I really enjoyed eating Kevin's Greek Lemon Chicken. The chicken was tender and not a bit stringy, which is a big plus for a refrigerated ready-to-eat meal. The lemon flavor is bright without being overpowering, and the herbs give it a fresh Mediterranean flavor. There was more sauce included than I wanted to use, so I only used part of the packets. If I were serving this over rice, I would have used it all, but we were making Greek sandwiches and salads with it, so we didn't want it too soupy. I found this easy to prepare and was super quick. Yes, the chicken looks funny when you first take it out of the pouch, but once you drain it and brown it in a fry pan, it comes to life! Overall, this is a wonderful meal to have on hand when you are short of time. It is healthy and tastes great! I will definitely buy again. (I received this product as a promotion to try and leave my honest feedback.)

reviews.title: Convenient and delicious
reviews.text: I purchased this at Costco and I was very pleasantly surprised. I loved that it came in separate pouches so if I only wanted to serve one, I could save the other for later. I also liked how easy it was to cook; both stovetop or microwave options and both options were really fast. The sous vide chicken was tender and delicious white meat and the sauce was a great compliment. It tasted good on its own but I really enjoyed over rice. I’d buy again and I’d love to try some other flavors.

reviews.title: I didn’t think this flavor matched the description
reviews.text: I didn’t think this flavor matched the description. It was spicy because of the chili flakes. It was like random chicken slathered in Italian spicy dressing. I didn’t know what to pair it with. It broke into odd sized pieces when cooking.

reviews.title: Convenient for a fast entree
reviews.text: Convenient for a fast entree. We enjoyed the lemon chicken, didn't really match up with the "Greek" flavor but it still worked in our Mediterranean bowls. The chicken was juicy and flavorful- appreciated that it was pre-cooked.

reviews.title: We are big fans!
reviews.text: We usually get the Thai chicken and we love that one, this one was at Costco this time and we got it and it was delicious. I love how easy they are to make! No more than 10 mins for dinner prep to be done!

reviews.title: This is the best flavor of Kevin’s chicken I’ve
reviews.text: This is the best flavor of Kevin’s chicken I’ve had yet! Got it at Costco and I hope they will continue to carry it

reviews.title: Defrosted this in the refrigerator as instructed
reviews.text: Defrosted this in the refrigerator as instructed and the packaging melted onto the tempered glass shelf. Don’t know how thi could have happened but it ruined the shelf.

reviews.title: Light & Delicious!
reviews.text: My husband and I just had this one for dinner with some white rice. It was perfect! Light & delicious. I normally love Korean BBQ Chicken or Thai Coconut, but we saw this one at Costco and decided to switch it up this week. I am so glad we did.

reviews.title: Not Greek
reviews.text: I love Kevin's entree's but this one was not what I expected. It tasted like it was cooked in Italian dressing with red pepper flakes added. Greek chicken should have lemon, oregano and possibly a little yogurt in it for the marinade.

reviews.title: This natural meal is delicious!
reviews.text: This natural meal is delicious! I love the tomato curry sauce. It was easy and quick to prepare. The family loved it so much. No leftovers.

reviews.title: Was the flavor forgotten?
reviews.text: Was the flavor forgotten? I love Kevin’s but boy was this a major flop. The rice had a crunch to it, chicken was too chewy and the tomato curry sauce tasted like somehow they added the ingredients but extracted the flavor. Definitely not buying this again.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I bought Kevin’s Butter Chicken expecting the rich, creamy, flavorful dish shown on the packaging, but it was a huge disappointment. The sauce was surprisingly bland and watery, lacking the warm, aromatic spices and buttery richness that make butter chicken so good. The chicken itself was dry and didn’t seem well-seasoned, making the entire meal taste flat. The packaging sets the expectation for bold, authentic flavor, but this didn’t come close. There are far better frozen butter chicken options available for the same price. Unfortunately, I won’t be buying this again.

reviews.title: Great flavor
reviews.text: My family and I tried the butter chicken for the first time tonight and it was great! I added a little extra seasoning as I prefer mine spicy but next to some garlic naan it was a hit. I’ll be buying this product again.

reviews.title: Kevin If you cannot replicate the easiest of flavors then don't bother
reviews.text: The package picture looks like butter chicken, but the final product looks nothing like butter chicken, it has the same hue as Tikka Masala. Also does not taste at all like butter chicken to the point I believe either all positive reviews are lies or just plain sad, because these people have never had actual butter chicken and if they ever do will either hate it because they believe it should taste like this imposter or love it and be completely confused as to what the heck they have been eating....Some weird spice combination that reminds me of Italian food with a hint of vomit. I'm very confused how anyone finds this flavor appetizing, I found this flavor worse than Kevin's Tikka Masala and btw that flavor wasn't good either.

reviews.title: First Kevins meal I have had and it was amazing
reviews.text: First Kevin's meal I have had and it was so good I felt the need to write a review. I've had a lot of different types of butter chicken and this one is awesome. The chicken was super tender and moist, only 1 minute in the microwave. The sauce is one of the best I've had, not super spicy but so delicious I used it as a dip for pop corned chips after. Total microwave time of 2 and half minutes. I will definitely be getting more of these.

reviews.title: This was great!
reviews.text: This was great! It probably had one of the better butter chicken flavors. It’s comparable to a restaurant. Worth it!!

reviews.title: The flavor of the sauce is delicious!
reviews.text: The flavor of the sauce is delicious. The chicken also tastes good. I just can’t get over the way the chicken comes in a huge clump in a plastic bag. So although it tastes good and the flavor is delicious, I won’t be purchasing in the regular.

reviews.title: I bought 2 at Costco thinking it would be tasty
reviews.text: I bought 2 at Costco thinking it would be tasty and up to the high Costco standards for quality. Unfortunately I was wrong. The chicken portion is small and the overwhelming sauce has too much pepper and no pineapple taste.

reviews.title: Easy and Delicious!
reviews.text: I love how easy it is to get a healthy, protein packed meal on the table without sacrificing flavor. The ingredients are super clean, the sous-vide chicken stays tender, and the Hawaiian style sauce is delicious. Highly recommend keeping a pack in the fridge for busy days!

reviews.title: Great flavor, easy prep, but watch the portion size
reviews.text: If you're looking for a quick, delicious weeknight meal made with natural ingredients, the taste of Kevin's Hawaiian Style Chicken definitely delivers. We served ours over white rice, and the flavor combination was spot on-sweet, savory, and clean. Something to keep in mind: the portions run small. The box indicates 6 servings, but it would not be enough food to feed a family of four for dinner without adding a lot of extra sides. Overall, it's a high-quality, delicious product that takes standard weeknight cooking down to minutes. Just be sure to prepare plenty of rice or veggies on the side if you're feeding a full household!

reviews.title: Great easy weeknight dinner option!
reviews.text: Great easy weeknight dinner option! Tastes great and made with quality ingredients! Appreciated how fast it was to make and that it was healthy too! The price was very affordable too! Looking forward to trying other Kevin‘s meals!

reviews.title: This was a quick and easy dinner
reviews.text: This was a quick and easy dinner. Just heat the chicken in a skillet and add the sauce. Heat it through and enjoy. I did make some rice to serve it over. It was the perfect amount for myself and my husband. This can also be made in the microwave. I also like that you can choose to make 1 serving or two as there are 2 pouches of chicken and 2 pouches of sauce.

reviews.title: Great flavor, easy to cook with detailed
reviews.text: Great flavor, easy to cook with detailed instructions. The whole family enjoyed it.

reviews.title: Quick n Easy
reviews.text: I purchased Hawaiian style chicken and it was very easy to prepare and delicious. It took only minutes. I would recommend this to anyone who is looking for a healthy meal in a quick amount of time.

reviews.title: A hit with *most* of my family
reviews.text: *I received a free product in exchange for my honest review.* I have tried Kevin's foods before, so I had an idea that I would like this variety. I love that these are gluten free so I can enjoy it with my family instead of having to make a separate meal for myself. I was surprised at how far this went. I have a family of 6, so I wasn't sure if it would be enough for all of us because it said it serves about 3. My husband made some stir fry veggies and we had it on top of rice. It was a good amount to feed my whole family! Most of my kids enjoyed it, but my oldest didn't like the flavor combination. It is definitely a meal that I would have again!

reviews.title: Delicious!
reviews.text: We really enjoyed the Hawaiian-Style Chicken. It wasn't overly sweet and didn't taste too much like pineapple (which my daughter was thankful for). I would totally buy this flavor again. It's one of my favorites.

reviews.title: Super impressed! Easy quick healthy dinner, that
reviews.text: Super impressed! Easy quick healthy dinner, that the kids loved! Meat is super tender and well flavored. Sauce is like a citrusy teriyaki. We all really enjoyed it and it was an incredibly easy dinner to pull together.

reviews.title: This is such a delicious a, easy and quick meal
reviews.text: This is such a delicious a, easy and quick meal that you can prepare in just a few minutes! I put it over microwave 90 second rice. Dinner is ready in 5 minutes!

reviews.title: Good food
reviews.text: My girls loved the Hawaiian chicken. I served it with rice and it was good.

reviews.title: Great flavor!
reviews.text: I was surprised at how good this chicken tasted. The flavors were bright without being too overpowering. I highly recommend cooking this over the stove instead of the microwave option. Otherwise I feel like the chicken will turn out too mushy. You need the texture that it gets from cooking over the stove. We added sesame seeds and green onions to dress up the dish. Then served with a side of rice and peas. The whole family loved it. *I received free produce in connection with my review.

reviews.title: Tastes Delicious
reviews.text: Got to try out Kevin's Natural Foods today and it was super tasty and flavorful, easy to make, and instructions so simple that even i could follow along and not mess it up. Defintely will be picking up more of these in the future. All Natural and tastes delicious. Its an amazing combo together

reviews.title: Delicious Hawaiian taste
reviews.text: Delicious this Kevin's was unique I was a little hesitant at first however it was very flavorful portions was great I would definitely purchase again

reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.text: Delicious, Easy, and Perfect for the Whole Family! Kevin’s Hawaiian Style Chicken was a huge hit with our family! It was super easy to prepare, which made it perfect for a quick and convenient meal, but it definitely didn’t sacrifice flavor or quality. The chicken was tender, flavorful, and had a delicious Hawaiian-style taste that everyone enjoyed. I was also really happy to see that the chicken is raised with no antibiotics and that it’s gluten-free and soy-free. Those added quality ingredients made me feel even better about serving it to my family. One package was surprisingly filling and was enough to feed our entire family, making it a great value as well. reviews.title: Delicious flavor
reviews.text: I recently tried Kevin’s Natural Foods Paleo Hawaiian-Style Chicken, and I was honestly impressed with how easy it was to prepare. I received this product for free in connection with this review, but these are my own honest opinions. I cooked it on the stovetop, which was really simple. You just open the vacuum-sealed chicken packages, drain the broth, and break the chicken apart a little. Heat some oil in a pan over medium-high heat, add the chicken, and cook it for about 1–2 minutes on each side. Then add the sauce and cook it on low for about 30 seconds. That’s basically it! I wanted to try the chicken by itself first, before adding anything else, so I could really get a feel for the flavor. The sauce has a really good Asian-inspired flavor that reminded me of a ginger-soy type of taste. The chicken was flavorful on its own, and I could definitely see having it simply over rice with a side salad when I want something quick and easy. For this meal, I decided to turn it into a Mediterranean-inspired Hawaiian Chicken Power Bowl with brown rice and a bunch of sautéed vegetables. I used broccoli, bell pepper, snap peas, carrots and red onion, then topped everything with the Hawaiian-style chicken and finished it with green onions, sesame seeds, cilantro and a squeeze of lime. I really liked how versatile this chicken is. You can keep it super simple or use it as the protein in a more complete meal like I did. I also love that it doesn’t take long to prepare, which makes it a great option for those nights when you want a home-cooked meal without spending a lot of time in the kitchen. Overall, I really enjoyed the flavor and especially the convenience. I would definitely buy this again, and I’m already thinking about other ways I could use it!
