The sauce has the right balance of savory and sweet and really elevates this dish. We served on brown rice and loved every bite. If I had one critique..it would be that there isn't enough for the price. But super good and we will buy this again.

reviews.title: Quick AND healthy do exist!
reviews.text: Paired this with iceberg lettuce, cucumbers and sesame dressing alongside honey citron & ginger tea and served over rice; it was perfection! The beef is the perfect texture and has a flavor that will leave you drooling! The directions are clear, easy to follow and will be finished in 5min!

reviews.title: Delicious, Versatile & Cooks Quickly!
reviews.text: I recently purchased this Korean BBQ style beef and sautéed it with peppers, onions and the sauce that it comes with. I served the beef and vegetables over rice and my family absolutely loved it! This beef was very tender and I was pleasantly surprised by how much beef was in the package; it is more than enough for a family of four. I would definitely buy this meal again because it is a healthy, delicious meal that can be prepared very quickly for busy weeknights or a quick weekend lunch/dinner. This beef can be served on its own or paired with vegetables or noodles/rice/potatoes for a variety of meal options. I will definitely be buying this meal again!

reviews.title: I was skeptic but pleasantly surprised!
reviews.text: Honestly, I was skeptic at first but bought it in a pinch to feed my husband and I while travelling and we were tired of eating out everyday, especially since I have Celiac and find it hard to eat out. I bought corn tortillas, sliced cheese and brocoli sprouts and made delicious beef tacos. Didn't need any salsa or hot sauce and was able to make what looked like a gourmet taco meal from my hotel microwave! Made the same thing the next day! The convenience, clean ingredients, celiac safe AND the great flavor really checked off the boxes for us.

reviews.title: Delicious and really simple to make
reviews.text: Delicious and really simple to make. I mixed it with broccoli and just like the package says 5 minute meal. Great for busy schedules and you wants a quick clean meal. LOVE IT

reviews.title: Bought the Hawaiian Chicken and loved it all
reviews.text: Bought the Hawaiian Chicken and loved it all though the weight was off by 3 ounces. Decided to try this, since the kids were home bought 2. Yuck. The quality is awful. Meat is gummy others have referred to it as dog food appearance, I agree. Again your weights are off. In this economy chosing to buy quality and being shorted on product is very bad. I bought 4, 2 went to the dog- she loved it, Hawaiian Chicken winner off with weight, honey garlic winner but again off in weight. We weigh everything due to diet.

reviews.title: Convenience isn't everything
reviews.text: The sauce isn't bad. The meat feels glued together. There is something that tastes strongly of chemicals, maybe from the packaging. I would sacrifice convenience to preserve the meat texture and quality.

reviews.title: Taste is good. Serving size disappointing.
reviews.text: Taste is good. I’m not sure I appreciate the chewy texture others do. However, packaging states 16oz, however when you weigh it, it’s only about 10oz. Can barely feed my husband & myself.

reviews.title: Nothing like the packaging presents
reviews.text: Listed as beef strips, but looks more like ground beef. Very misleading from what the package represented.

reviews.title: Second Dog Food !
reviews.text: Husband was disappointed I bought this and opened to see what others have noted. Does NOT look like the package pictured. It indeed looks like gray ground dog food. Will not buy again.

reviews.title: Gray dog food
reviews.text: It comes out of the package looking like gray dog food. You can kind of preserve chunks but certainly not strips nor anything like the photos. The sauce is ok. You need a lot of it to make it palatable. The alleged average score is not credible for this product. Discontinue or recreate this.

reviews.title: Way better than you think it will be
reviews.text: I first tried a Kevin beef and broccoli at Costco. It was pretty good, I do choose to cook the beef longer than recommended. I then tried the beef bulgogi. Wow. Amazing. Better than any Asian food I’ve ever had making it at home that doesn’t costs hundreds of dollars. I’ll be a regular Kevin’s customer for convenient easy to make dinners when I get home from work and my lady is already asleep. This is better than you think it will be. I just wish I could try more meals at my grocery store. There’s a few chicken ones, I haven’t tried those. Probably will I’m just a beef guy.

reviews.title: Kevin beef
reviews.text: Had this for supper. Very good. Bought at Costco don’t remember price but little high for what you get. Would have liked more meat.

reviews.title: So Good
reviews.text: Bought this at Costco a few days ago and decided to finally try it for a quick meal. It was so amazing. The flavor was great and added some grilled onions to it which made it even better. Definitely trying other flavors and buying this again!

reviews.title: Disappointing - Meat was very grisly and very tough to chew
reviews.text: I'll start with the good. The flavor was decent but hardly "Korean BBQ". More on the lines of Hawaiian BBQ- sweeter, not spicy at all, but still tasty. The meat, however, was hard to get through... it was so tough, I ended up giving most to my dog. I get the idea of sous vide, but it really doesn't do much for making a tough cut of meat tender. I think you'd be better off pressure cooking the meat before packaging.

reviews.title: Yummy!
reviews.text: We enjoyed this over rice and veggies. Will buy again

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: Meat was mushy even with searing per the instructions. Sauce was overwhelmingly sweet and not a Korean BBQ marinade at all - why put lemongrass in it (not a traditional KP bbq ingredient and threw the taste off). Had high hopes but left confused.

reviews.title: Korean BBQ Beef
reviews.text: This product is a huge disappointment! What kind of beef is this?? Grisly, veins, muscle??? I ended up throwing half the meat away. I had a bad batch the first time I bought this product yet decided to give it another try. Never again!

reviews.title: Yuuuum dog food
reviews.text: Literally dog food. But nobody will ever read this review because Kevin's filters only positive ones

reviews.title: NOT korean style at all
reviews.text: As a Korean, I find it frustrating that this product is marketed as “Korean BBQ style” when it doesn’t accurately reflect the flavors of Korean cuisine.

reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text: The steak is chewy and don't get me started on the "Korean bbq" taste. Literally tastes like normal BBQ sauce. I had to doctor it with my own Asian seasonings and I still couldn't mask the crappy flavor. Glad I got it on sale or I would be more annoyed. Talk to a real Korean about how to flavor your food and try again.

reviews.title: Yucky
reviews.text: We had high hopes for a gluten free and healthy quick meal. Thankfully we got it on sale at Costco, because that is still overpriced for this meal! Most of the pieces had to be spit out because they were tough with the wrong texture! We will never buy this again. Such a big bummer!

reviews.title: Very Dissatisfied
reviews.text: I had hopes for this meal, but none of my family liked it. Money down the drain.

reviews.title: disappointing
reviews.text: I had been looking forward to this. Definitely not steak tips as advertised, they were really small bits of beef rather than tips. Followed the directions - the pieces were chewy, had to spit out a couple of pieces. Bought it at Costco on sale. I'm so glad I didn't pay full price for this.

reviews.title: Dog food Scraps
reviews.text: This was one of the worst premade products I have ever had. It’s so bad, that this is the first review about any food item that I’ve ever written. 1/4th of the package weight is the sauce. So the 2 lb package for $18 (hawaii price) is actually more like $11 a lbs instead of $9 a lb. That would be fine if the meat wasn’t absolute gristle. Their “sous vide” method gives it look like dogfood and a texture something like beef jerky that was boiled, dried again, and steamed. It’s not even seasoned. Sous vide is for even cooking of usually larger things… not thin scraps of meat. This “sous vide” is not a culinary offering as much as it is a time and cost saving measure. Why would they cook and season it properly and then Vacuum seal it, when you just can boil the unseasoned meat and pack the sauce on the side For $11 per lb, go buy strip streak and cut it yourself. This is a company taking scraps of an already cheap cut and ripping off its customers. Absolute garbage and they should be embarrassed. I don’t even want anything from them… I just feel like people need to know how much this company doesn’t care about you.

reviews.title: Not great
reviews.text: Recently had the Hawaiian chicken and it was super good so decided to try this flavor. Bought both packages at Costco so makes meal prep all week easy since it’s bigger packages. This Korean BBQ Beef missed the mark. Great flavor! Usually that’s the issue. Not with this. The steak is dense (hard to even separate the block, had to hand tear as plastic silverware kept bending), stringy, grisly, and not at all tender. This would be really good with a different cut of meat that is more tender as the flavor is really good!

reviews.title: Yeeeeaaaa………….No
reviews.text: I was looking for something to pair with my eggs and I know Korean style beef is usually tender, so I picked this up today just for the meat to be very chewy and I came across pieces of fat. I know that could be normal with meat sometimes , but it says it was sous vide? So that plus the fat I don’t know but maybe that was just my experience

reviews.title: Beef Scraps
reviews.text: My meat looked like a clump of leftover scraps. No solid "slices" of beef. Not one solid strip larger than 1/3 of an inch. The beef in here was one small step above ground beef. Won't ever get again. Disgusting.

reviews.title: Absolutely Not
reviews.text: I don't know where to start: The false advertising of 32 ounces of meat, or the grey meat being vacuum sealed into a puck instead of strips - perhaps the vaguely basic thickened soy sauce and sweetener? Even on sale at CostCo for $15 I would have been better off buying a steak and doing it myself, the only thing keeping me from returning it is I need something to eat for a quick lunch throughout the week.

reviews.title: Delicious and Diabetic-Friendly
reviews.text: Just tried this one for the first time. My super-picky, diabetic husband kept RAVING about it! Quick to prepare, and absolutely delicious! We will definitely be looking for more flavors!

reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text: Thank you so much for this delicious beef dish! We eat this once or twice a month when I just can't spend time cooking. I do wish there was a bit more sauce as I like to add veggies and put it over rice. It is perfect for the 2 of us. Luckily I don't eat much. Never any left overs. We have tried other Kevin's meals they have all been great. I enjoy when the shop brings in another flavor.

reviews.title: Bulgogi but
reviews.text: I have wanted to try this brand for a long time. Perhaps now that Mars owns them (2023 aquisition) they have a better and broader placement in grocery stores. I bought the Korean BBQ beef because there aren't many local places to get this. I think it was over sous vide - some of the beef was kind of mushy. Some of the beef was tough and/or stringy. Not all of it but enough I probably wouldn't try this meal again. I did purchase their Turkey, gravy, cranberry meal so we'll see how that fares. I think this is a great idea, an alternative to the delivery fresh meals at a better price with less waste.

reviews.title: SO easy—and delicious!
reviews.text: As someone who suffers from chronic fatigue, I'm constantly looking for easy ways to get a healthy meal on the table. When my local grocery ran a sale on Kevin's entrées, of course I wanted to try some. Wow, am I glad I did! I just sautéed some fresh (pre-riced) cauliflower in grapeseed oil, threw in a handful of (pre-shredded) carrots, a splash of rice vinegar and a little tamari, then put the BBQ beef on top with a tablespoon of chopped chives (I had to chop those, which was the hardest part lol). The whole thing couldn't have taken me more than 15 minutes, and it was absolutely delicious. Thank you so much for the assist! I'll definitely be buying this again.

reviews.title: My own DELICIOUS version of Beef with Broccoli
reviews.text: I purchased this at my local Smith’s grocery store on sale, having never tried it before. I cooked it up in toasted sesame oil. I also added a microwavable batch of sticky rice and some steamed frozen broccoli. I mixed the broccoli in with the beef and sauce toward the end of the heating process, and poured it over a scoop of sticky rice, added some more toasted sesame seeds for garnish with some red pepper flakes and YUM! I ate half of it yesterday and the other half reheated in microwave today… enjoyed with my chop sticks I felt like I was getting a restaurant quality meal for considerably less money!

reviews.title: Delicious!
reviews.text: This is the first time I’ve tried Kevin’s and it definitely won’t be the last! It was delicious and oh, so easy!

reviews.title: Yummy yummy for my tummy
reviews.text: One of my favorite dishes is beef Bulgogi. So when I saw this I knew I had to try it. I loved it! So much so that I ended up eating the entire thing myself instead of saving some for my lunch the next day. I will definitely be buying this again!

reviews.title: Yum!
reviews.text: Just had this with corn tortillas and a pickled cucumber salad I did on the fly and wow! Delicious! My family loved it 😋

reviews.title: I can’t take hot peppers so when I saw
reviews.text: I can’t take hot peppers so when I saw this Mongolian style beef and I read the ingredients that there was no peppers in it. I was all excited but still this is really hot for me so do you guys have red peppers in this cause it’s not listed in the ingredients?

reviews.title: Tasty? Sort of but tough
reviews.text: Bought at Whole Foods $16 not right. Meat was a bit tough. Overall, too salty. Won’t buy again.

reviews.title: Upset I didn't buy more!
reviews.text: I purchased this maybe a year ago or more, threw it in the freezer and didn't give it much thought. Took it out of the freezer the other night and tried it. I am OBSESSED!!! It's so so delish! I went to the store the next day looking for it, with the plan to purchase all they had, I loved it so much and to my surprise, there was none! I have searched all over my area, at different stores and no one has it anymore 🥺 please restock or send me 20 packages of the Mongolian Beef please and thank you!

reviews.title: Super tasty but a little sweet
reviews.text: Really enjoyed this as a quick meal with a side of rice and broccoli. I did find the meat a little tough and the sauce a little in the sweet side but overall a great quick meal!

reviews.title: Mongolian beef
reviews.text: I tried this today. I found the sauce to be very flavorful but was disappointed with the beef; it was extremely tough. A longer slower cook time would probably correct this. I would not buy this product again.

reviews.title: So disappointed
reviews.text: I should start by saying that I am a big fan of the Kevin’s products. This is a different matter . The flavor is exceptional but the beef was like leather. It took forever to chew. I can’t help but hope this was a fluke bad batch. Everything else I have tried has been delicious.

reviews.title: Delicious!
reviews.text: Had this today for the first time - so good! Not too spicy at all - just right - lots of flavor and very tender. Will definitely purchase again.

reviews.title: Mongolian Beef will burn your mouth
reviews.text: My family and I could not eat the Mongolian beef cause it’s ridiculously spicy, which is not stated on the packaging. They need to list chili flakes on the list of ingredients. Our mouth was burning for a while after we had that initial first bite.

reviews.title: Too good to be low calorie
reviews.text: This dish is amazing! I stirfry snap peas or asparagus with garlic and ginger then add the beef. I have a hard time believing the calories count is only 180 prepared for 5oz!

reviews.title: Delish but spicy
reviews.text: This Mongolian beef has excellent flavor, but just a bit too spicy for my taste. We had it with rice, which calmed the burn. I recommend this entree but be aware of the heat.

reviews.title: Your Sirloin Tips don’t look or taste as good as the package photo!
reviews.text: This was the first time I tried any of your products. The picture on the package was very enticing. Unfortunately the product inside bore no resemblance. I couldn’t eat the steak. It was tough, chewy, had gristle. In my opinion, sirloin may be a poor choice as it’s not a tender cut of beef. It seems the more recent reviews are more critical which may be that you have changed something in your quality. Based on this purchase, I wouldn’t waste money on trying another Kevin’s product.

reviews.title: Taste was ok, beef was ok. Contains coconut!!!
reviews.text: Taste was ok, beef was ok. There should be larger warning on the label in front about the allergens. Coconut affects a lot of people who have peanut allergies. Caused a pretty bad reaction for my son.

reviews.title: It’s the best ready to eat frozen meal quick to prepare
reviews.text: It’s the best ready to eat frozen meal quick to cook in 5 to 10 minutes’ it’s one of our favorites . I usually buy 2 packages whenever it’s on sale that’s the only way I can afford it. It’s much better and healthier meals so when it was on sale at Publix so bought variety meals which I can keep in my freezer for at least couple of months. Than you for making our life easier especially in our kitchen.

reviews.title: Sirloin Steak Tips A+
reviews.text: Loved everything about the sirloin steak tips. I cooked the beef in a frying pan w olive oil... to just well done. While also cutting the meat into much smaller pieces. Added the gravy and cooked only until heated because I didn't want the sauce to dry up. Then served it on rice. Perfect. Tender beef lightly salted. I find it interesting that other reviews said it needed more salt... well, use your salt shaker. That's a ridiculous complaint. I will definitely make this again. I had half for dinner reserving half for next day's lunch.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: I pretty much live on chicken, so I decided to try this as an alternative. I was quite disappointed. I rarely salt anything for health reasons, but felt this needed it. Despite following the directions carefully, the meat was chewy and not particularly flavorful. The label said three servings, but that’s a stretch. I divided it into two portions. I wanted to love it, but for about $15, I would not buy it again.

reviews.title: very disappointed
reviews.text: My family loves all your chicken dishes and I thought I would try a beef dish. I tried your sirloin steak tips with gravy and was very disappointed in the quality of the meat. It was very chewy and had no flavor at all. I guess I will stick with the chicken .

reviews.title: JAW WORKOUT
reviews.text: If you want strong jaw muscles this is the recipe for you. I dont know what Xanthan gum is but with how this chewed id bet it is the main ingredient, not beef. Gravy tasted fine.

reviews.title: Serving size inaccurate
reviews.text: This says three 5oz servings. I was splitting for meal prep and only had 8oz TOTAL. Not 15oz. The beef was tough and lacking flavor. Flavor is one thing, but to charge for a quantity that's not delivered is deceptive/theft.

reviews.title: Delicious but Xanthan Gum is a Problem
reviews.text: I was excited to try your Sirloin Steak Tips with Gravy and thought I'd found a quick meal solution. It was delicious, but xanthan gum causes gastrointestinal distress in some people including me. (BTW, I'm not sensitive to other food ingredients.) I thought it wouldn't be a problem since it's low on your ingredient list, but I was wrong. Such a shame. I don't understand why companies use xantham gum instead of better thickeners/stabilizers. Perhaps it's cheaper. Sadly (for both of us), you've lost me as a customer.

reviews.title: Horrible Steak Tips and Gravy
reviews.text: The Steak Tips are chewy and have no seasoning flavor. Absolutely a waste of money to buy. And the sauce packet needs to be increased. Not enough sauce.

reviews.title: Different that photo
reviews.text: I think it throws people off because photo isn’t accurate but flavor is great! Maybe use a little salt.

reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text: I recently purchased your product, Sirloin Steak Tips With Gravy and found the taste of the gravy ok but I could not chew, much less swallow your "tender "sirloin tips. You say"fully cooked with gourmet cooking technique called sous-vide?" Change everything with your meat because the meat that was in my dinner, was nasty and darn sure not tasty!! If this is the way the rest of your dinners are, there are other companies that must be better??

reviews.title: Grade D- Beef
reviews.text: My college had food delivered to the dining hall labeled “Grade D Beef - Fit for Human Consumption”. All of my meals in college were better quality than the beef in this package.

reviews.title: What happened to the meat?!
reviews.text: Obviously some bean counter in the Corporate office decided to pad his bonus by sacrificing the quality of the meat. The first two times our family had this meal, we all enjoyed it very much. Two days ago, we had it again, and were shocked at the tough, gristly meat. I ate three bites and had to spit the last one out because I couldn't chew it. The whole family complained and were disappointed. I'm never buying the beef meals again, because I doubt they've confined the poor quality beef to just one entree. I will keep buying the chicken unless they ruin those, too.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I may be the exception, but this meal was the worst, tough pieces of meat full of grizzle.Very disappointed. No resemblance whatsoever to the photo on the box. In the future I’ll stick to the chicken entrees.

reviews.title: First time trying these delicious beef tips!
reviews.text: I baked potatoes and had fresh broccoli with these. They were delicious and my husband and I ate all of it! Yuka gave them a rating of 69 out of 100. So glad I tried them. Can’t wait to try the chicken one! I couldn’t take a picture because we ate it too fast!😊

reviews.title: Lone Star Hash
reviews.text: I make an excellent hash with Kevin’s Steak & Gravy as a base. Sweat 1/2 onion; 1 4oz. can Hatch mild Green Chilis; the Kevin’s steak cut into small pieces with juice; 2 tbs. chili powder (to taste); 1 tbs. paprika…cook the mix a bit, then add the gravy package; 20 oz. boxed chicken or beef stock; 1/2 cup long grain rice; 3 cups diced Idaho potatoes. Cook covered in 12” skillet ~20 minutes. Serve over unsweet corn bread.

reviews.title: SO Good!
reviews.text: This is the first one I tried and was blown away. The beef is perfect. The gravy is perfect. Served with green beans on the side and on top of a small amount of buttered noodles. Family loved it and bragged on the dinner. I haven't told them yet that I didn't actually make that.

reviews.title: Beef tips
reviews.text: I add chopped onions, potatoes, red pepper and a little ketchup to sauce to sweeten it up, served with side of cauliflower or cabbage, delish
First time buying the steak top meal and it's better than I expected! Super easy to cook and a quick meal! Added broccoli and rice and it was perfect. Will definitely buy more products from Kevin's

reviews.title: This was absolutely delicious!!! It was sooo good
reviews.text: This was absolutely delicious!!! It was sooo good. I was skeptical at first because rarely do I find a frozen/refrigerated food that is good. But this one certainly is. I will be buying again. My whole fam and friends loved it. I even added my own veggies and noodles to go along with it.

reviews.title: Wow what a delicious beef flavorThis is good get it! is this one
reviews.text: Wow what a delicious beef flavor is this one right here. I loved how soft and tender the beef was. The garlic flavor taste amazing! I pit it over egg noodles with that meat and sauce.

reviews.title: Needs a lot of rescuing, doesn't deliver 16 oz of food.
reviews.text: First, they show 16 oz net weight, so I weighed the sauce and meat packages. Sauce was 5.55 oz, Meat 11.2 oz, but right away you're told to drain the broth, which in my case was over 3.6 oz, so the total was closer to 13 oz. Not even considering the slight weight of the pouches, or dehydration during cooking, that's still about 20% of a pound underweight. Second, the appearance of the beef in the pouch is like a lump of clay. They suggest using tongs to separate the beef. On the package they look like tidy little slices, but really, they're so pressed together that they don't want to come apart. I finally used to forks to tease apart what I could, and none of the resultant pieces were "slices," more like lumps chunks. Cooking did nothing to help. Third, there's too much sauce for this little amount of beef. It's about I added about two cups of stir-fried asparagus, baby corn, baby carrots and mushrooms, and it was still dripping in sauce. Fourth, that's what I mean by "lots of resucing." It needed the added flavors. Fifth, neither honey or garlic flavors can be detected in the sauce, and it's not surprising. In a list of 16 ingredients, Honey is fifth, behind two doses of water. Garlic is seventh (roasted) and ninth (dehydrated). As others have pointed out, the orange juice concentrate, number six on the list, is the strongest flavor. Sixth, the texture of the beef is horrible, tough and chewy; the flavor is like an overcooked pot roast.

reviews.title: Best one
reviews.text: I really love this one. My husband likes the teriyaki one, but I think that one has too much salt for me since I don’t really eat with a lot of salt but this one it’s perfect the honey mixed with the meat we make just simple rice bowls with it cause we try to eat pretty healthy and that’s kind of like a nice yummy treat and it doesn’t have a lot of salt so I’m really enjoy it.

reviews.title: This should be called orange beef
reviews.text: Very potent orange flavor; otherwise, lacking in flavor. I do really enjoy other Kevin's products so I was very disappointed in this. I also don't love orange flavor so I wouldn't have bought this if that was made more clear.

reviews.title: HUGE hit at our house
reviews.text: This is our absolute favorite of all the Kevin's products we've tried. I sautee some red and yellow bell pepper and onion before searing the meat, then stir back in with the sauce. We serve it over rice or noodles, and have also added crushed peanuts on top, or stirred a spoonful of peanut butter into the sauce while simmering. Absolutely delicious. My picky picky husband asked to have it again a week after we first tried it. A sure winner, and so much healthier (and FASTER) than take out!

reviews.title: Terrific Thai Style!
reviews.text: We were pleasantly surprised how full of flavor and natural Kevin's Thai-Style Basil Beef tasted. It was simple and convenient to prepare, and was full of natural and healthy ingredients. We're looking forward to trying the other dishes.

reviews.title: tastes amazing and so easy
reviews.text: This tastes great! It was really easy to make and add to meals. The flavor was better than I expected.

reviews.title: Amazing flavor!
reviews.text: I was really excited when I initially discovered the Kevin’s brand. It’s so hard to find prepared meals that are dairy free and that still have a great flavor. This Thai style basil beef didn’t disappoint! Just warm it up and it’s ready to go! The sauce flavor is fantastic. It has spice to it without being hot. I served mine with rice and sautéed veggies. It also made great leftovers. The only reason it didn’t get 5 stars was due to the beef. It really doesn’t look like what the package shows. Due to the sous vide cooking method, the beef is tender and juicy, but it ends up looking and more like a ground/processes texture than sirloin strips as shown in the photo. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

reviews.title: Yum
reviews.text: This is delicious and helps me with my meal prep!

reviews.title: Kevin’s Thai-Style Basil Beef was so Yummy!
reviews.text: Kevin’s Thai-Style Basil Beef was absolutely delicious! My family really enjoyed it. At first, I was hesitant to cook it because it looked a little scary looking in the bag but once you start frying it in your skillet, it gets better. I added some of my own spices, some mushrooms and the sauce that it came with and it was exquisite! I definitely recommend this dish.

reviews.title: Worth a try
reviews.text: I purchased this through an offer via trybox. I cooked it up for my family. The preparation was super simple. I served it over rice for a family of four and it fed all of us and everyone, including the teenagers, cleaned their plates. Overall I enjoyed it but do wish it was a little bit spicier and the beef was a little bit hard to break up but other than that it was a quick, easy meal. I also appreciate that it's made with grass-fed beef!

reviews.title: Easy & Delicious
reviews.text: Loved how easy it was to have a delicious family meal. Super easy and convenient to cook and we served it over rice. My favorite part was that the meat came split into two packages so if you didn’t want to cook it all in one sitting, you didn’t have to. It did have a little bit of a spice to the sauce, but it was tolerable. Looking forward to purchasing again.

reviews.title: Easy Peasy Incredible!
reviews.text: We recently took a camping trip and decided to load up on some new flavors of Kevin’s. These offer us healthy, convenient, delicious meals, and let me tell you this did not disappoint. We ended up making rice bowls, utilizing this particular flavor, paired with peppers, onions and even some avocado. The Thai packed a punch. It was soooo yummy and the easy clean up makes it a mom favorite.

reviews.title: Easy weeknight meal
reviews.text: I received this item for free in exchange for my honest review. The flavor was pretty good and a nice change of routine. The beef was cut into a large variety of chunks which was ok since it was precooked and just needed to be browned then mixed together. It went well on some jasmine rice, but probably would have been better with some veggies mixed in. It's was enough for one meal for our family and a little extra. I'd consider purchasing in the future.

reviews.title: Perfect meal for my family!
reviews.text: Perfect meal for my family! It's tasty and has a little bit of spice to it. A little kick really makes the taste amazing. The beef is super tender and delicious and the meal is so easy to make. Will definitely buy it again!

reviews.title: Easy and the sauce rocks!
reviews.text: I picked up Kevin's Thai Basil Beef from Costco, and overall, I give it 3 out of 5 stars. The preparation could not be easier, and the convenience of having the beef and sauce packaged in separate portions made cooking a breeze. The standout feature is definitely the sauce—it’s rich, flavorful, and brings a really tasty blend of spices to the dish. However, the beef itself was just okay; while some bites were decent, several pieces were unfortunately quite tough and chewy. It’s a solid, convenient weeknight option if you love a great sauce, but the meat quality holds it back from being a complete hit.

reviews.title: Tender and full of flavor
reviews.text: I was provided this product for free for an honest review. It’s hard for me to find pre made foods healthy and on the diet I follow. This Thai basil beef was tender and flavorful. It had just enough spice to give it the right taste without overpowering anything. This beef makes me hopeful to give the other dishes a try!

reviews.title: Kevin’s Thai Style Basil Beef was delish!
reviews.text: We were able to purchase and try the Kevin’s Thai Style Basil Beef and it was delicious! The flavors were complex but not overwhelming. I loved that it wasn’t too sweet as Asian dishes can often be. It was also incredibly easy to prepare which important to this buys mom! Will definitely be purchasing again.

reviews.title: Sirloin Steak Tips w/gravy
reviews.text: So delicious! Tender beef and perfectly seasoned gravy with a potato and salad, this will become my favorite meal!

reviews.title: Busy Night Dinner
reviews.text: For busy nights the Kevin's chimicuhurri beef was ready in less than 10 minutes. The beef was tender and flavorful with a tangy subtle zip. We used the beef to make nachos and everyone was happy and the pan was empty. I purchased it at Costco and there are two packages so it was perfect for our family of two to have on two different occasions. I received a reimbursement for my purchase in exchange for my honest review. #sponsored

reviews.title: Hardly worth the expense, unfortunately.
reviews.text: Had very high hopes for this dish as a quick dinner solution. First, the packaging is misleading, perhaps an assumption on my part but when I read 32oz 2 lbs I am assuming that is beef. After draining the beef before putting in the pan to sear it weighed in at 15.5oz only. As someone who is very health conscious about the foods I buy, I really look at macros. This platter doesn't give the option to see the calories from the beef and chimichuri separately, incase you wanted to forgo one of the sauce packs there is no way to calculate calories that way, inconvenient to say the least. Finally the biggest turn off was the look of the beef itself. 2 big lumpy grey potato sized lumps. When you go to break it up, it almost looks like ground beef and weird random chunks, NOT even close to the picture on the front. The level of browning achieved on the front picture is literally not possible unless you dry out the meat completely. The chimichuri sauce.... for some reason is sweet. Not a hint of garlic parsley or cilantro. No vibrant flavors to elevate the meat.Now the meat itself was tender, but tender because its been over cooked, almost like stewed meat. There were 3 big gristly chunks that had to be spit out.

reviews.title: Absolutely loved this meal
reviews.text: Absolutely loved this meal. We created our own Gyro using the Chimchurri Beef, Tzatziki sauce, sweet peppers, and onions. Absolutely delicious!

reviews.title: I’m not one usually give a review
reviews.text: I’m not one usually give a review and we love this brand as a family but when we purchased the Chimichurri Beef we fully expected the meat to be slices and not wild chunks of beef. The flavor was good but the presentation and beef outcome had extreme lack luster. How can you show slices of steak on a photo and the outcome was more like a can of dintymore. Again, we enjoy this brand about 90% of the time but this unfortunately fell into that 10% of disappointment.

reviews.title: Chimichurri Heaven!
reviews.text: This was EXCELLENT! This took less time than it took to make my rice! Dinner was ready in minutes, not hours. Steamed some broccoli on the side and we were good to go! Such a great idea for a quick and delicious meal for my family! THANK YOU!

reviews.title: Fast, easy and delicious
reviews.text: I normally cook everything from scratch but decided to try this after reading the ingredients at Sprouts. Sautéed some diced sweet onion in olive oil and butter and added jasmine rice for a base. I sautéed the beef per the instructions and finished it in the included sauce. Topped the rice with it along with some chopped fresh Cilantro and it was excellent!

reviews.title: Full of flavor
reviews.text: I love every single Kevin’s meal that I try. I think the chimichurri beef became one of my faborites so far. Full of flavor and good quality meat.

reviews.title: Quick, easy to prepare and no added ingredients
reviews.text: This was our first time trying this meal and our family had mixed reviews on it. Hubby and I felt the sauce itself was a bit too sweet but did enjoy the taste of the beef itself. My daughter wanted a spicy sweet kick to it and our son enjoyed it exactly as. Overall, we did like it and personally I loved how quick and easy it was to cook. We would definitely try more options going forward.

reviews.title: Yummy!
reviews.text: We tried the teriyaki beef last night and were both impressed with the flavour and texture! Added some frozen stir fry veggies and rice to make a complete meal. Hubby doesn’t usually like frozen entrees but said this one was great.

reviews.title: The beef is hit or miss :(
reviews.text: I always have a good experience with the chicken, but the sous vide beef options are hit or miss. There is so much bristle in there i end up only getting about 2/3 of the meat that's edible! And for $13 it should be better quality. But the sauces are always good

reviews.title: Beef may be sirloin but it’s stringy and has a lot of gristle
reviews.text: I really want to love the beef dishes but this is the third time I’ve bought one and it’s the worst yet. I dumped the whole thing because I couldn’t pull out any meat that wasn’t attached to long strings of gristle or tough connective tissue. Customer service implied that sirloin is high quality and that the quality controls in place should mean the beef is edible, BUT sirloin is only as good as its rating (select, choice, prime)—which was not specified, and clearly quality control doesn’t mean trimming the inedible bits off. Sorry, Kevin’s, but I won’t be back

reviews.title: LOVE THIS
reviews.text: I’ve been trying to eat healthier and this was the first Kevin’s meal I tried and it was delicious! Definitely going back to the store to get more!

reviews.title: Beef not up to par; flavor, amazing!
reviews.text: It’d be nice if the “gristle” in the beef was cut out before cooking. It makes breaking the sous vide meat into pieces difficult to impossible, and makes the chewing experience pretty frustrating. I think I pulled 8 pieces of gristle out this time before sautéing the meat in the pan. After that, the eating experience was amazing!

reviews.title: Incredible
reviews.text: This is the best of the best! I’ve only had the garlic chicken and cilantro lime chicken, it’s good to know they sell it at target because that’s where I’ll be going. It’s so tender and full of flavor. It’s just incredible. Thank you for making this.

reviews.title: OMG delicious
reviews.text: I purchased this and then saw the label that said it was soy free. My original thought was another health food. I actually went out and purchased a separate teriyaki sauce. When I opened the package and started making the beef I tried a little bit of the sauce and it is outrageously delicious. Thank you for making such a delicious meal. If I could find the teriyaki chicken, I will get that too.

reviews.title: Very tasty

reviews.text: Not good at all. Returning!

reviews.text: Bought this for dinner tonight and was surprised by the texture and color of the beef. It was definitely not strips, looked grayish, and had the texture of canned dog food. Also, very pricey for small amount.

reviews.title: Fajitas taste good, instructions not so much
reviews.text: Followed the instructions to heat a pan to high for 1 minute then add tbsp of cooking oil. Almost caught my kitchen on fire and ruined my pan. Definitely do not need to heat the pan on high for this otherwise fajitas tasted amazing just ruined a pan and potential apartment complex fire.

reviews.title: Yummy
reviews.text: I tried this flavor for the first time, followed directions as instructed and i think it takes longer than 7 minutes, maybe 10 not bad at all. A lot of Kevins products are delicious, we all have different taste buds so I dont believe some of the bad reviews. It is a meal for two and my box had a lot of carrots, few broccoli and cauliflower but I dont mind adding few extra veggies myself. I really liked this flavor I thought it was delicious. The only thing I think that it doesn't need is a lot of the Sauce, I thought it was a bit much but its not a deal breaker will definitely buy it again and use less sauce. I love that all of his products are healthy and clean ingredients so THANK YOU!

reviews.title: Quick Dinner - NO!
reviews.text: This was the worst excuse for a dinner for two - 3 pieces of broccoli - maybe 1/2 carrot sliced and 3 pieces of cauliflower - Chicken was clumps and felt likt it had just come out of a can - was disgusting - no flavor - will never purchase again-

reviews.title: Tasty but sparse
reviews.text: The directions did not match the product- it read separate strips but they were chunks but that aside the meal was tasty but the veggies were sparse. I had add my own veggies. I would suggest to increase the portion of the vegetables as this barely fed 2 persons

reviews.title: Absolutely the best fajitas in under 15 minutes!
reviews.text: Absolutely the best fajitas in under 15 minutes! I couldn't believe it only took 7 total minutes to cook...on the stove, NOT microwave! We absolutely love these fajitas! The only problem now is availability and being able to get them. It seems that a lot of local stores have taken them off the shelves and forget about Amazon because they're worse.

reviews.title: Sauce didn't taste 'fajita-like' to me
reviews.text: Think I may have tried a Kevin's product before, but regardless, was disappointed in the "Chicken Fajitas Skillet Meal Kit". Positives, the ingredients did seem fresh. Negatives, the vegetables were not substantial at all, and the biggest disappointment was the lack of a 'fajita taste'. The sauce was sort of tomato-like. Full kit made three flour taco-size tortillas. Gave it a shot, but will not purchase this one again.

reviews.title: We randomly try you food
reviews.text: We randomly try you food. The meal was very lacking in a fajita flavor.

reviews.text: This is definitely our favorite kevin's meal but agree with others the portions are super small. Wish we could buy the sauce like other sauces!

reviews.text: Taste great but I would love to know what standard of measure you use because if there is 2 and a half cups of food in that pkg I will give you your $10 back!

reviews.title: Love but small
reviews.text: We really enjoyed this but won’t buy again as it’s not enough for 2 people. We would love to buy this sauce.

reviews.title: Liked it a lot!
reviews.text: This was my first Kevin's and it was delicious! If you're eating properly, as on Weight Watcher's, it was enough for two. I put it in 2 whole wheat tortillas and enjoyed them for a whole meal because I did not have breakfast. The sauce was perfect and delicious! Will have to try other Kevin's.........

reviews.title: Love it
reviews.text: This is the first time trying the fajita and it was delicious. The portion size was good for me since i am the only one eating it and it will last 2 days for me. The vegetables were a bit too big but i cut them up in small portions and enjoyed my meal on flat bread. I will try the other ones.

reviews.title: Very Small Portion Size
reviews.text: As someone has started already, this kit barely feeds one. We added more veggies and chicken from another Kevin’s Chicken with rice and beans to make it a full meal for two. I love Kevin’s Chicken but this was not worth the price.
The few veggies we had were cut too big. The package says it feeds 2.5, it barely feeds 1 It's not worth the price and low quality

reviews.title: Fantastic, delicious ,so easy to make and you just have to buy some tortillas.
reviews.text: The best packaged fajita dish I have ever eaten. All the ingredients refresh. It took about 7 to 10 minutes to cook and I ended up eating them. A couple of days after they were fantastic.

reviews.title: Favorite
reviews.text: This is my favorite Kevin’s meal. 10/10!

reviews.title: General Tso Stir-fry
reviews.text: Flavor and beans amazing, far better than anticipated. Quality of chicken far better than I thought it would be. Only reason for the 4 stars is the amount of chicken in the picture is very deceiving.

reviews.title: delicious
reviews.text: I got this from target and i should have took a picture. It came out just like the picture and it was soooo good.

reviews.title: I agree with the review too much orange
reviews.text: I love that the product has quality ingredients and fits into clean eating. The variety of options are great and I've tried a few items that I enjoyed. For this particular product, I agree with the review about the orange flavor being overwhelming. I was expecting more of the soy flavor based on the title of the package. I "saved" the overly sweet sauce by adding umami seasoning powder and red pepper flakes. The chicken portion is smaller than what I would use if I made the dish from scratch but was sufficient. They're were a good amount of green beans but the texture and color of them wasn't my preferred for stir-fry. To give you an idea of serving size adequacy, I made two packages and had a serving and my husband wiped out the rest for his dinner. So based on a price of $11 per package, size and flavor this just wasn't a win for me and not an item I'd try again.

reviews.title: This dish should be called lots of soggy green
reviews.text: This dish should be called lots of soggy green beans with a little bit of chicken! About 1.5 servings in this prepared! Very disappointed in this product. Won’t be purchasing this again!

reviews.title: Holy Orange
reviews.text: I love Kevin’s meals but there should be more of a mention of orange! Nothing on the packaging screams orange at you. A little orange garnish sure. And “a hint of orange” is mentioned in the description. But I couldn’t eat this. I hate orange and it’s all I could taste it’s really disappointing

reviews.title: Dinner for the Chief
reviews.text: My husband works long hours. He is trying to cut back on meat. This dish he enjoyed so much he thought I bought it at a restaurant! Would recommend as a quick preparation dish. One pot is all you need.

reviews.title: Yum!
reviews.text: It was really good and quick!

reviews.text: Easy and quick to make. Good portions. Good overall flavor, just too sweet. The sweet seriously over powers everything else. First few bites are okay, but the sweet just keeps building.

reviews.title: Delicious!
reviews.text: I tried this for the 1st time yesterday, and I'm HOOKED! Absolutely fantastic! I did add some chopped onions because I lovem them. Otherwise perfect as is!

reviews.title: Easy & delicious
reviews.text: I tried this today for dinner & both my husband & I loved it. Good protein/ carb ratio Side salad & that’s it.

reviews.title: Easy and so tasty!
reviews.text: I tried your cauliflower mash recently & we loved it. I saw the honey garlic chicken at Market Basket & gave it a try for lunch today. This was so simple to make & so much flavor. I will definitely be checking out more of your products. Plus, one pan for an easy clean up. I might make this & throw away the box & serve it to my husband. He will think I slaved over the stove. (HaHa) Have a great day, Sharon

reviews.title: Orange Chicken
reviews.text: Absolutely delicious! I just found your products the other day at my local Albertson's and I am so glad I did. Gluten free, healthy, great flavor and I LOVE that it is low sodium. So many frozen meals have such high sodium content I am not able to eat them. I bought some other flavors and can't wait to try them too! I will definitely come back and write a review for each one. Thanks for this great meal. So glad to have found your products.

reviews.title: Delicious quick meal!
reviews.text: While I did add extras like onions and more garlic and some red chili powder - I thoroughly enjoyed the dish! My one teen “wasn’t hungry”, but encouraged him to eat a tiny bit… text message came… “Can I have some more pls?!” My littlest (who doesn’t normally eat green beans) - asked JUST FOR GREEN BEANS! Middle child (also teen) ate it for breakfast this morning. Seeing how they devoured it has me searching our local Costco for this meal again! I was pleasantly surprised at the ingredients being clean. Thanks for a good product. I did add over some rice to make it a complete meal for the family.

reviews.text: I love this meal! It's so easy and delicious. I'm endlessly sad that my Costco locations discontinued it ☹️☹️

reviews.text: Loved it!!!!

reviews.text: This was AWFUL. I threw the entire meal away, the meat looks like actual dog food and smelt awful, I was trying not to gag while cooking it, the sauce was absolutely horrific along with more terrible smells. reviews.title: Ehhh

reviews.title: This is bad…
reviews.text: My first Kevin’s meal and my lasts Small portion, not worth the $22. Furthermore the sauce is bad, not traditional broccoli beef flavor at all. The meat has canned dog food consistency and the broccoli was precooked to mush. Do not try. I doubt I’ll try another Kevin’s meal.

reviews.title: Pretty Bad!
reviews.text: It’s hard to disappoint me when it comes to food because I pretty much like everything, however, this was not good at all. I always have leftovers because I hate wasting food and it’s an easy meal for the next day, but I had to throw this one out.

reviews.title: The portion size is a joke
reviews.text: This packaging comes in a box that says 2 pounds on it. There is about 0.5 pounds of fluid you have to drain from the beef and the broccoli and what’s left is a 0.5 pound of meat and 1 pound of broccoli. Not even able to feed a family of three with a child. I will not be buys this rather expensive package ever again.

reviews.title: Recipe needs some tweaking
reviews.text: The concept is good; sous vide cooked beef and broccoli, which makes it quick and easy to put in a wok to heat up and brown. However, I found the sauce too sweet and it tasted a bit one dimensional. This would be much better with a less sweet and more flavorful sauce.

reviews.title: Soggy and odd taste
reviews.text: The beef itself is ok, but the sogginess of the broccoli drowning in a strange sauce (does not taste like ginger or garlic) is not appetizing. The comparison of the box image vs. the actual food is pretty disappointing.

reviews.title: Delicious!!!
reviews.text: Quality ingredients and super easy preparation make this a fabulous and healthy meal!! Kevin’s Beef and Broccoli is my new favorite!!! Full of flavor and absolutely delicious!! Highly recommend!!

reviews.title: Holy Moley this is so yummy!! 😋
reviews.text: Wow, better than restaurant quality! This was such a refreshing find for me because I'm gluten free and my choices are limited. This quick five minute meal is of superb quality and you won't be disappointed if you try it.

reviews.title: Absolutely Delicious – A New Go-To from Costco!
reviews.text: We picked up Kevin's Beef & Broccoli Stir-Fry from Costco and absolutely loved it! The beef was super tender, and the sauce had the perfect balance of savory and slightly sweet. It tasted just like something you'd get at a good restaurant, but way faster and easier to make at home. We threw it in a pan for a few minutes and dinner was ready — perfect for busy nights. Definitely going to keep this stocked in our fridge. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.text: This product is one of my family's favorites along with the chicken stir fry. Purchased it at Costco in Mesa, Arizona and now it's gone!! I am so disappointed.

reviews.title: Kevin's Beef n Broccoli
reviews.text: Simple to make, literally minutes. Served over rice, and it was a meal that I'll buy again. Delicious!!

reviews.title: Sooooo good!
reviews.text: This meal far passed my expectations and tasted so good. I love the clean ingredients and how fast it's ready to eat. I love all Kevin's products I have tried.

reviews.title: Yum!
reviews.text: This Chicken Green bean stir-fry from Kevin’s at Costco was really good! It was super simple to prep as well. We made ours over noodles but you could eat it plain or over rice. We were super impressed with it for a simple/easy lunch. We found these in the refrigerated section at Costco. 🙂

reviews.title: Another Kevin’s Hit!
reviews.text: I’m a big fan of Kevin’s products because they are so easy and convenient, but still feel fresh and healthy. The flavor of the sauce was excellent (but a little spicy!) and it was a very tasty dish. My only issue was the sous vide chicken - while it was tender and tasted good, the look of it coming out of the package really gave me some hesitation. But it didn’t end up tasting really good.

reviews.title: Has a little heat but it’s good!
reviews.text: We really liked the Sichuan Chicken & Green Bean Stir Fry! It had a good amount of heat and tasted a lot like Chinese takeout. It was a little too spicy for my toddler, but my husband and I really enjoyed it. It was also quick and easy to make!

reviews.title: We love Kevin's!
reviews.text: We love Kevin's Natural Foods products! We have had them in the past, but this one was a new one (Sichuan Chicken Green Bean Stir-Fry). I love them because they are so easy to make and they have such good ingredients. It took 10 minutes to cook and we served it over rice. The chicken and beans were great. We were not a fan of the sauce on it as it was too sweet for us. #sponsored

reviews.title: ALL THINGS KEVIN!!
reviews.text: I have yet to find anything made by Kevin’s that I don’t like! Seriously, it’s all so darn good and this one just got added to my list of faves! Seriously try it! I’m not a fan of pre-made foods but when I do make them (lazy cooking nights, sports or whatever) Kevin’s is my go to!

reviews.title: Disgusting
reviews.text: Not worth buying. Sauce overwhelming. Green beans not tasty. Chicken mushy

reviews.title: My favorite Kevin's meal I hope it gets restocked soon
reviews.text: My favorite Kevin's meal tastes great good ingredients and quick to put together. Hope Costco gets it back soon as I got it a few times and have missed it the last month. Would be a shame if Kevin's decided to discontinue their best meal.

reviews.title: Love Everything…. But Portion sizes
reviews.text: It is delicious and so convenient for me. I work full time and go to school and I love have quick meals to prepare, rather than get take out. However —- The box indicates that a serving is a cup and that there are 4.5 cups in a box. I was able to get 3 cuts of food from this.

reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.text: This product is one of my families favorites. Purchased it at Costco in Mesa, Arizona and now it's gone!! I am so disappointed.

reviews.title: Why Poblano?
reviews.text: It would have been much better without the poblanos or with NM green chile instead. I hate poblanos.

reviews.title: Delicious easy morning breakfast!
reviews.text: I love to start my day with a couple of eggs! I found this Kevin’s Natural Food product at Target in the freezer. It was so delicious and easy to add to my eggs. What a great way to start my morning!

reviews.title: So easy and delicious!
reviews.text: This meal was so easy and delicious! Loved that I was able to enjoy it at home but tasted like I was eating out...if I could give 10 stars, I would!

reviews.title: Overall just really good! I bought it on sale at
reviews.text: Overall just really good! I bought it on sale at Dillon’s for $5 and one bag fed three adults 2F 1M. It’s originally 3x the price so i probably won’t buy unless it’s on sale because $15 is just too much… like its not THAT good and you don’t stay full for long so definitely better for lunch than dinner too.

reviews.title: Cauliflower love
reviews.text: Love love love! A healthy meal you can make as fast as a pizza! And gluten-free! Omgosh! Thank you Kevin's!!!!

reviews.title: Good product
reviews.text: I really enjoyed this cauliflower pasta with chipotle flavor! It’s a great way to add more vegetables to your meal while still enjoying a delicious pasta dish. The chipotle flavor gives it a nice smoky and slightly spicy kick without being overwhelming. It’s creamy, flavorful, and surprisingly satisfying. A tasty and convenient option for a quick, healthier meal!

reviews.title: I work night shift so I frequently look for meals
reviews.text: I work night shift so I frequently look for meals that are easy to prepare and are generally healthy. I was skeptical because I have tried cauliflower pasta in the past and not liked it. I made this today and it was absolutely delicious and done in about 6 minutes from start to finish! I will definitely be trying more.

reviews.title: Great for what it is
reviews.text: Great for what it is. If you doctored it up with some peppers and onions I think it would be a lot better. It tastes good though on its own

reviews.title: Love, love, love this one!
reviews.text: Love, love, love this one! Even my elderly father enjoys it. I made it once and was so impressed, I bought it again. There isn't a lot of chicken, so I added a cup of cottage cheese to the chicken and sauce, prior to adding the noodles. There is plenty of sauce, so this is easy to do. I also threw in some cherry tomatoes, but I bet sun dried would work great.

reviews.title: The only thing palatable in this was the chicken
reviews.text: The only thing palatable in this was the chicken. I couldn’t even force down one serving, and unfortunately will be throwing the rest of it away. This was a huge miss for me.

reviews.title: Not a pesto sauce
reviews.text: The flavor is good but I wouldn’t say it’s a pesto sauce. Pesto has pine nuts and lemon and this recipe does not. It’s more of a straight basil sauce.

reviews.title: Three generations give it two thumbs up!
reviews.text: First time trying the Pesto Chicken Pasta and it was really good. Three generations enjoyed the meal, and that not an easy task!

reviews.title: Sauce has way too much of something
reviews.text: Chicken and pasta was fine. The sauce not so much. Too much basil perhaps. Hubby couldn't eat it and I barely choked it down. Like other products but won't get this one again.

reviews.title: I have always enjoyed Kevin’s meals but this one
reviews.text: Not good at all. I have always enjoyed Kevin’s meals but this one was very disappointing in that the sauce had an unpleasant taste and the meal itself made me very sick to my stomach (extreme digestive upset). I even tried it again the next evening just in case the upset was not this meal, but again, I had an upset stomach all night long. Not sure what happened to this meal to end up in stores but will try another meal in hopes this item is just a one off item.

reviews.title: Dairy free
reviews.text: I was very excited to find out that you had a pesto that was dairy free. However, the sauce was not appealing, and the chicken had a very odd texture. I think this one needs to go back to the kitchen for a redo.

reviews.title: FABULOUS
reviews.text: This one dish cemented my love of Kevin's products. I randomly pulled it out of a freezer at the grocery store and was blown away by the flavors and ease of preparation. I will say that the pesto is strong in this one, particularly the garlic. The reviews indicate people either love it or hate it. I am a staunch garlic lover (regularly doubling the amount called for in recipes) so it is right up my alley. But that may not be you. I have also loved other flavors, so don't despair if this one is not a perfect fit.

reviews.title: So bad it made me write a review
reviews.text: I truly never ever write reviews, but this was so bad I had to look up if other people had a terrible experience with it. We literally just quickly finished the chicken to at least get some protein and then tossed the rest. The sauce is BAD. Like I’ve ever tasted a combination like that before. Will never eat this flavor again.

reviews.title: Delicious!
reviews.text: Like all of Kevin’s meals, this did not disappoint!

Package looked good, but the result of the product was not good. Only giving it 2 stars because the pasta and chicken part seem to be good, the sauce is just whack. Also 2 stars for convenience. Will not purchase this again.

reviews.title: Way better than expected
reviews.text: I can’t figure out the poor reviews. I think this is super tasty. I cooked it on the stove top for a bit longer at every step than the directions suggested. Pasta was delish especially for gluten free. Sauce was plentiful and hearty. Chicken is cooked sous vide style and therefore must be drained and broken up a bit. Definitely not raw as one review suggested. All told it took 7-10 minutes to cook to my liking. One thing that was strange - box says six servings of 1 cup each, but I only got 4 1/4. Makes it hard to track nutrients.

reviews.title: Tasted HORRIBLE
reviews.text: I wish I hadn’t bought this when I saw it. I love Kevin’s dishes but this was not working well with the garlic flavor and everything together. Total disappointment.

reviews.title: Yuck!
reviews.text: Kevin, this pasta was disgusting! My wife spit her first bite out, while I choked mine down so she wouldn't feel bad for feeding me gross garbage. She then immediately dumped the rest of the bag in the trash. On the bright side, thanks for creating this memory for us.

reviews.title: Pesto tastes really strong
reviews.text: I wouldn’t buy this again and I had to throw away. Not sure what the taste was but not good. The chicken I threw away right away as it looked raw. Will try something different from you all soon. Just not this.

reviews.title: Yum
reviews.text: It cooked quick in the skillet and was enough for two. The noodles were nice and chewy which is unusual for GF pasta in my experience. The pesto was great too, not bland or overwhelming. I enjoyed the zucchini as well. Both of us loved it!

reviews.title: Waste of money
reviews.text: We bought this at Costco and decided to give it a try. It was a waste of money...we ended up throwing it all away. The flavor was horrible and it left a lingering weird taste. There was way too much garlic, or whatever it was, and it really didn't taste much like pesto. Disappointed for sure...now to make a dinner that we'll actually eat.

reviews.title: Avoid
reviews.text: The pasta product is good, and no complaints about the chicken. The pesto needs a massive reworking. ENTIRELY too much garlic, in such large chunks I can only assume it was meant to “pass” texturally as pine nuts. The strain of basil used is a very unpleasant one- too much anise flavor- and the kale, I suppose, lends the bitterness of the sauce. Purchased at Costco in a large quantity and I may finally give up on Kevin’s products altogether. Despite Costco’s generous return policy, I will not return food that they’ll just have to trash. Kevin’s concept is great but again and again the flavors disappoint. I have only tried about 5-6 products because often the sodium content prevents me from purchasing. Do better, guys. :(

reviews.title: Nope
reviews.text: Chicken taste like rubber, pesto sauce absolutely terrible ,only pleasant surprise was cauliflower pasta. I tried to add salt to mask the disappointment but even that can’t save this dis

reviews.title: It surprised me
reviews.text: I think it’s the amount of basil in it, maybe? I’m not sure but wife and I had to throw it out. Could not stand the flavor. I ate the chicken and chased it down with sourdough bread, so as to not completely waste my money.

reviews.title: BRO- THAT GOOD?
reviews.text: WOW, unable to express how tasty this is I want to order a BOX, I'm excited to try new flavors, I've never ever heard of this before today Thank you Safeway! Impressivly good, every bite was full of flavor. Great Job this is the first time I ve done a review because you needed to know, RUN to Safeway!!!

reviews.title: Easy, quick and yummy meal
reviews.text: Easy, quick and yummy meal. I ate with a side of fresh local tomatoes. Delicious!

reviews.title: Definitely recommend
reviews.text: First bite, good but unsure. Second bite, obsessed! Now, it may be snobby, but I can tell they use dried basil, which has a distinct taste. However, it is simply delicious. It seems I can't go wrong with a Kevin's meal! I'm trying to pesto chicken meal next.

reviews.title: Convenient and delicious!
reviews.text: This meal was so convenient and delicious! A little light on the portion size but next time we would add in some broccoli or green beans to bulk it up. Flavor was excellent though!

reviews.title: I gave it a shot because I like other Kevin's
reviews.text: I gave it a shot because I like other Kevin's entrees... The cauliflower pasta was great! It withstood the heating up process without becoming too overcooked! I used 1/2 the sauce, and sautéed vs. microwaved... Added some black pepper, red pepper flakes, lemon, and a dash of parm... Really good!

reviews.title: Rash due to GDL
reviews.text: I'm commenting to let you know my wife developed a bothersome rash after we consumed the Basil-Chicken Pasta entree last evening. We regularly enjoy various Kevin's entrees with no problem, so I strongly suspect she reacted to the Glucono-delta-lactone that is not present in other entrees. An internet search says allergies to GDL are rare but can cause rashes, itching, hives and other reactions. We like Kevin's entrees because they are tasty, simple, GLUTEN FREE and contain few additives. Hopefully you will consider removing GDL from the pasta meals and please don't add to your frozen entrees.

reviews.title: Can’t beat the convenience and well rounded macros
reviews.text: Protein to overall calories is great. I’m a bigger guy (6’3”, 225) so I have to eat the whole bag for a meal, so only downside to that is the price. But this tastes great and took me about 10 mins to throw together. I don’t feel bloated or bad after eating it like regular pasta. Will be trying the other flavors and adding this to the weekly rotation.

reviews.title: MUST HAVE
reviews.text: Simply put: AWESOME! I was so happy to have stroganoff back on the menu after YEARS without it. This was seriously so great. I can't recommend this pasta dish enough. The cauliflower pasta has seriously ruined me. I wish they would sell it boxed! *wink wink*

reviews.title: Potential but not there yet
reviews.text: Overly salty. Once you push past that it’s quite good.

reviews.title: Tough beef
reviews.text: This sous vide beef is the worst - threw away 1/4 of it when I couldn't chew it. And, I love stroganoff and used to make it - this doesn't taste like stroganoff. Wouldn't buy again nor recommend it.

reviews.title: Will eat this forever
reviews.text: I just bought this from costco and can't get over how GOOD it is. I never write reviews online and just recommended it to my dad who isn't much of a cook but wants to be healthier. I'll be repeat buying this for a long time, thanks kevins!

reviews.title: A great paleo option for when a quick meal is needed.
reviews.text: It was good. When you’re eating Paleo, it’s understood some sacrifices are made from a normal beef stroganoff recipe with regard to flavor, texture, etc. For when a quick option is needed we thought it hit the spot!

reviews.title: Flavor is coconut (boo!)
reviews.text: I Tried Kevin's Beef Stroganoff and the noodles are great, the beef pieces are ok, but the sauce has almost no beef flavor, but tastes like a coconut sauce. What? Yes. I doctored the sauce by adding salt, freshly ground pepper, a splash of wine and a large dollop of Better than Bullion Beef bullion. Then the flavor was passable but the coconut still came through. I won't buy again.

reviews.title: Pile of grizzled mush , no beef tips
reviews.text: Wife brought this home from Costco . Directions say separate the beef tips and braze both sides . All I had was a pile of mush just a little more together than hamburger mixed with grizzle . I wish I had taken a picture before I added the sauce but was hoping it would taste better than it looked . I hate to be the lone descentre , but I think I got the part that they were supposed to throw out . I have the leftovers of our meal in the fridge , if someone at Kevin's wants to see it .

reviews.title: Awful beef stroganoff.
reviews.text: This is quite possibly the worst thing I ever eaten. I picked this up at Costco on Saturday and made it that night. Nobody in our family ate it. It ended up in the trash. The beef was tough and very chewy and the coconut milk in the sauce overpowered the entire flavor of the sauce. I’ve purchased chicken entrees from Kevin’s line of meals and everybody ate tgem but. It this stroganoff.

reviews.title: Incredible!!!
reviews.text: I got this at Costco to try and went back to buy 3 more the next week! It’s incredible but unfortunately I can’t find it anywhere anymore and it’s depressing :( If I had known I would have bought a freezer full of them!

reviews.title: Phenomenal!
reviews.text: This dinner was FANTASTIC! The flavor was so phenomenal and cozy on this chilly evening. My husband put it together in minutes! My only complaint is that they are out of stock!

reviews.title: Tasty but......
reviews.text: Saw this at Costco and had to decide what to do. I live alone and 6 servings was more that I would want if it was not good. Bought it anyway. Prepared the whole box and decided I could freeze the left over servings. Meal was delicious but I found that it could use some mushrooms. Going to sauté some and add it to the leftovers when I heat them up. I know that mushrooms may not be everyone's cup to tea but packaged separately they can be used or not.

reviews.title: Beef Stroganoff
reviews.text: This dish was phenomenal. The quality of the beef was very good and the cauliflower pasta was outstanding. Will definitely keep this on the menu at home.

reviews.text: The beef was tuff taking back the other beef entree in case

reviews.title: Fantastic!
reviews.text: I absolutely loved this meal! Please package and sell your cauliflower pasta separately as this is the best pasta I have ever tried!

reviews.title: The Best!
reviews.text: My husband and I loved this meal and are so disappointed it was discontinued.

reviews.title: Fantastic!
reviews.text: I was so pleasantly surprised when I tried this. It's so good! I love the pasta. Being gluten free isn't always easy and it's nice when you find a product that actually taste good. The beef was tender and the sauce was good. I did add a little sour cream at the end to give it a little tanginess. A little pricey, but it served 2. Will absolutely purchase again. I would love to see this cauliflower pasta package alone to add to home cooked meals. I would certainly buy it. Also, maybe package it in a single serve size like some of your other product.

reviews.title: The Only Packaged Meal I Eat!
reviews.text: Kevin’s Beef Stroganoff is my favorite. I eat Whole Foods; so, I avoid all packaged meals except this one. I tried the bolognese, but it was too acidic tasting. I bought this at Costco’s one week… then the next week it was gone. They no longer sell it. I’m so disappointed. I legit wrote them and asked them to renew the contract.

reviews.title: Easy, Yummy & Healthy Beef Stroganoff
reviews.text: I tried this and loved it. I am very particular regarding this dish and found this dish to be excellent! Plus, it's easy to make and it's amazing that the noodles are not really pasta and the beef was so tender and not fatty at all! The only downfall is that it's hard to find this in stores.

reviews.title: Delicious!!
reviews.text: Wow! Blew me away how great this flavor was! It was hearty, savory , well balanced and the pasta had a great texture ! Can't wait to try the tomato basil one! Im doing low carb so these are a great option! Keep em coming! Gracias!

reviews.title: Beef Stroganoff - so good
reviews.text: I was amazed at how good this was. I was skeptical reading the ingrediant list that it would taste as good as my home made stroganoff. The cauliflower pasta had a good consistency and the flavor of the sauce was so great. I added some sliced mushrooms. I will definitely try other options. Call me impressed!

reviews.title: Taste only lemon
reviews.text: I love the convenience and how easy it is, but all I could taste was lemon, unfortunately

reviews.title: Actually Horrid
reviews.text: It was on sale for $5 at costco, so I thought it would be a good deal. Big mistake. I tasted the sauce as I was preparing it and it tasted sour, salty, but somehow flavorless. Way too much sodium and way too much acid. I knew the deal was too good to be true. Eat something else.

reviews.title: So salty it’s inedible!
reviews.text: I got this at Costco. I don’t know if there was a bad batch made but mine was WAY too salty, that it’s inedible. I rinsed it several times with water to get the sauce off, so I could eat it.

reviews.title: Too much sodium
reviews.text: This was barely edible. The amount of sodium (38%) was ridiculous and not necessary. Coming from the food industry, I would suggest the recipe goes back to R&D. Bought this at Costco who generally vet their products well, but this was intolerable. Threw half out. Sorry!

reviews.title: Excellent work
reviews.text: I’m always on the lookout for simple pastha recipe, and this one was perfect. So happy I found it — templateonweb.com

reviews.title: Not paleo
reviews.text: If this has dairy how can it be paleo certified???

reviews.title: Best pasta
reviews.text: This is easily one of my favorite pastas ever and I’m not gluten free. You cannot tell it is cauliflower pasta at all and the sauce is amazing. Genuinely the best tasting and best for you comfort meal out there.

reviews.title: Unbelievably good!
reviews.text: I purchased my first Kevin's product yesterday and thoroughly enjoyed it today. The Roasted Tomato Chicken Pasta was just amazing!! Every ingredient from the sauce to the chicken tasted fresh and delicious. I would have never guessed that the pasta was made from cauliflower. As a person who consumes single serving frozen entree meals on a regular basis, I can tell you that the Kevin's meal I had today is absolutely THEE BEST I've ever had!! I HIGHLY recommend this particular meal, and I can't wait to try the Korean BBQ Style Chicken next!

reviews.title: So delicious!!
reviews.text: This was my second meal from Kevins; the first was their delicious chicken picatta. This was equally as savory, tasty, filling, and delicious. The cauliflower pasta was delicious too. I am so happy I found this brand, as I have recently gone gluten free and dairy free and have limited options. I no longer feel deprived of delicious, hearty miles, now that I have found this brand! And it feels good to eat a healthy, clean diet!!

reviews.title: Finally!!! Your meals are so delicious
reviews.text: Finally!!! Your meals are so delicious and I love the low calorie and less processed ingredients you have done something very right thank you !!

reviews.title: I loved this frozen meal
reviews.text: I loved this frozen meal. It was so tasty and I liked that it was healthy and super easy to make. I will buy again! I received a discount in exchange for my honest review.

reviews.title: Bolognese, more like Ball-ognese! 🏀🔥
reviews.text: Bolognese is hands down one of my favorite traditional pasta dishes and Kevin's is one to satisfy! 🤤 It has a rich sauce and it's packed with flavor where as others don't deliver.

reviews.title: Such a great, quick heathy meal
reviews.text: Such a great, quick heathy meal. Perfect for week nights!

reviews.title: Kevin's Dinner Fans!
reviews.text: We are retirees looking for quick prep, healthy meal options. Very good homemade taste, good texture, exceptional macros for a frozen dinner. We just became Kevin's fans & will be trying other Kevin's products.

reviews.title: The beef bolognese bowl is my favorite
reviews.text: The beef bolognese bowl is my favorite. It is very delicious and filling. The sauce is creamy and rich. The pasta is very well cooked. It’s my go to lunch when I’m at work.

reviews.title: You can’t go wrong!
reviews.text: I absolutely love the beef bolognese and it perhaps is my favorite out of all of them! It’s delicious and a super quick, healthy meal.

reviews.title: Quick and easy, surprisingly good
reviews.text: Quick and easy, surprisingly good for a pre prepared meal! Makes it easy when one kid wants pasta and the other wants something else. Weekly staple in our house.

reviews.title: great
