reviews.title: Flavor is way better than the look!
reviews.text: I love that Kevin’s has the gluten free pasta options. While some have mentioned that the look wasn’t bright red like the box, the flavor is actually very authentic and doesn’t have that absence of flavor that so many frozen meals have. I also throw some basil and Parmesan on top and it takes it to the next level. Got surprisingly full!

reviews.title: Tastes better than it looks
reviews.text: Definitely doesn’t look like the picture BUT it tastes good! Would definitely purchase again.

reviews.title: Delicious and tasty!
reviews.text: Delicious and flavorful, these are a wonderful choice for families.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: I am a long time Kevin’s fan and was so excited when I saw this. I just popped it in the microwave and, man, what a disappointment. The noodles are brown and flat, the sauce is SO watery, it looks NOTHING like the photo. When are food companies going to be held accountable for having very inaccurate photography on their packaging? The taste is fine but it would be a heck of a lot cheaper to just make and freeze my own using organic ingredients from now on.

reviews.title: YUM!!!
reviews.text: I don’t think I’ve ever had a frozen meal that tasted this good! The sauce was absolutely delicious, and the cauliflower pasta was perfect! I’ve never had cauliflower pasta before, and it tastes exactly like regular pasta. I can’t understand the negative reviews regarding the look of the meal after cooking. Mine looked very much like the picture on the box. I am on a GLP 1 medication and I’m always looking for high protein meals. I will be buying this again and again!

reviews.title: Malfunction Meal
reviews.text: Bought meal in Anchorage Alaska from Fredmyer, when I went to open the meal it was sealed on both sides, so I didn’t get to eat it cause I was nervous that it could have other things wrong from the malfunction. Not sure if this was a one off or there might be a batch issue. I would’ve just emailed direct but didn’t see anywhere to do such. I was really looking forward to eating this since I have celiacs and everyone was eating pizza so I just got to watch them eat while I had nothing. Sincerely, now having to figure out what to do with this hot bag..(no seriously, do I return it to the store? It feels like that might be weird to show up with).

reviews.title: Preview Does Not Match Product
reviews.text: I do not expect frozen meals to look exactly like the picture on the box, but this is ridiculous. The product looks absolutely nothing like what is pictured on the box. They need to update the picture, add a disclaimer, or (even better) improve the product so the photo is accurate.

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: I have recently been needing a quick and easy protein packed meal, and this is delicious. I was shocked. I usually don't like frozen meals and now I find myself searching where they have this one in stock. I have tried a few other flavors of Kevin's. This one was my fav by far!

reviews.title: So disappointed
reviews.text: Imagine my shock when I cooked this meal and it didn't even remotely look like the picture or even like any bolognese I have ever seen in my life. I am a big fan of Kevin's frozen meals, but this one was so disappointing.

reviews.title: Disappointed.
reviews.text: I tried this meal at lunch. Based on the picture was very excited and expected it to be amazing. The pasta was underwhelming, unflavored and brown. The beef had no flavor and gave me a sensation of bad stuff. I would love to work with you closer to establish a tasteful and healthy meal. Thank you!

reviews.title: Bb
reviews.text: Your Kevin’s frozen bowls-Beef Bolognese was tasty! I was skeptical! My husband and I are on specialty diets and we have been using the App-YUKA and your product scanned excellent! The sauce had flavor and the Cauliflower pasta was good! Kudos to you!

reviews.title: The best!
reviews.text: This one is fantastic, probably one of my favorites. I added a little parm cheese but all the flavor is there.

reviews.title: Surprisingly Delicious
reviews.text: I got the beef bolognese hoping it would be good but the cauliflower pasta and chunks of tomatoes made me a little bit worried. I just had it for dinner and it was really good. The cauliflower pasta takes on the flavors from the sauce and doesn’t fight against it. The sauce was flavorful and well seasoned. The tomato incorporated well with the sauce and wasn’t rubbery or slimy like it can be in some pasta sauces. They’re diced small enough to add flavor without too much texture. It’s pretty filling and makes a good lunch or dinner. I have celiac disease so having an easy microwave dinner is always nice. I will definitely buy this again.

reviews.title: Best Frozen Bolognese
reviews.text: I make my own 6 hour bolognese sauce from an old recipe so I wasn’t expecting much. I thought this was astonishingly good and will buy it again. I was also strongly favorably surprised by the pasta. This is a great item.

reviews.title: Must have in the freezer
reviews.text: This pairs extremely well with my favorite glass of red wine, and the beef, pasta and sauce are filled with great flavors and texture, don't worry red wine is healthy, too, in moderation. It all looks and tastes fantastic! After a joyful day of WFH this dinner is almost like dining out & in a peaceful setting, rewarding my work well done with your great works, Kevin and team, thank you!!

reviews.title: Can't believe this
reviews.text: Absolutely had to see if this pasta was worth a flip, and my gosh! This is like a restaurant meal. It's in line with the size of everything else as far as calories go (I could do with a little more kcals) but the health aspect is unbeatable. Nothing else comes close as far as ingredient purity, taste, and the best is its not laoded with stuff thats not good for me like all the others with have crummy pasta or rice as the centerpiece and a bunch of chemicals for flavor. FIVE STARS for food PURITY.

reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.text: I added a little extra garlic to this and it was delicious. Love that it’s gluten free also. The only negative is that it was a bit high on the sodium but other than that it was great.

reviews.title: Shockingly Good
reviews.text: Bought this thinking it would be a quick dinner in a pinch. Didn’t expect much of it as most frozen meals are unimpressive. I was so wrong! It is absolutely amazing.

reviews.title: Wow!!!!
reviews.text: So good! Most gluten free pasta is chewy; in a frozen meal it's even worse. Usually crunchy even... I would never know this meal wasn't take out...I'm so pleasantly surprised! Thanks Kevin!

reviews.title: Love everything Kevin makes
reviews.text: I’ve had so many entrees and sides and they are all delicious. Today I tried the frozen bowl of beef bolognese and it was so tasty! Can’t wait to try the rest!

reviews.title: Beef Bolognese Frozen bowl
reviews.text: Kevin you got it all perfect with this! The sauce, the noodles the portion cannot be beat! My husband is diabetic and it doesn't raise his blood sugar! Yaaay! We ate it for dinner a few times during the week to lose a couple pounds... works gr8! Our favorite go to and the dog can't wait to like the bowl after we're finished! Best product ever... quick & delish! We are also a fan of your Thai Coconut Chicken sous vide refrigerated. Thank you very much!❤️

reviews.title: Delicious...even for non-microwave users!
reviews.text: This is NOT your typical frozen meal full of a bunch of stuff you shouldn't eat and can't pronounce!😔 I am a sufferer of Microwave sickness, so I can't use a microwave without extreme dizziness. So, I removed the plastic, covered it with aluminum foil, and put it in my Hot Logic Portable Food Warmer, straight from the freezer. It took about 90 minutes, which is typical, but it was perfectly heated! I just need to start about 90 minutes before I'm ready to eat!😀 I can't wait to try their other frozen meals, sauces, and refrigerated dishes. Thank you, Kevin and Kevin's Natural Foods! I'm sharing these wonderful meals and sauces with friends and family!👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻

reviews.title: Surprisingly Good
reviews.text: I'm gonna be so real, I thought this would taste horrible. It's actually quite good! The cauliflower pasta doesn't taste super vegetable-y, which was my biggest fear. I bought it for the high protein and fiber and low(ish) sodium content. Great product!

reviews.title: love!!!!
reviews.text: I just found Kevin's meals in my supermarket this week. I am on a diet and noticed the good ingredients and high protein value. Well , I tried the beef bolognese and fell in love!!!. I can't wait to try the other dishes.

reviews.title: Delicious Bolognese!
reviews.text: This may be one of the best tasting freezer meals that I have ever had! I grabbed a few to keep in the freezer in our office break area, for when I don't have time to pack a lunch or run out to eat. Now I am actually looking forward to having lunch in the office!

reviews.title: Surprise!
reviews.text: What a great frozen entree! Great flavor, easy to prepare, a generous portion for low calories, fresh tasting. Tastes more like a delicious next day leftover, rather than something that's been in the freezer. I didn't even realize it was gluten-free.

reviews.title: SO GOOD
reviews.text: This is one of my favorite things to eat. It is SOO good. I have celiac and this is a real treat for me. Please never stop making this Kevin’s!

reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text: Kevin I can’t thank you enough for making these meals!! Our family doesn’t like to eat out due to seed oils so your meals feel like such a treat. This beef pasta is so good and is the ultimate because I literally just have to put it in the microwave and no bad ingredients. Thank you so much we are nut and gluten free (nut allergies) and it’s hard to find items

reviews.title: Love this!!!
reviews.text: Finally a GF frozen pasta dish with flavor and noodles that aren't mushy! I just added a little mozzarella to melt into it and it was amazing!!!

reviews.text: This is a great meal. I ever put a some cottage cheese on top for a sour cream replacement (You do not need it, I just like the taste). I will purchase again.

reviews.title: I love the Chicken chipotle bowl! It is so tasty
reviews.text: I love the Chicken chipotle bowl! It is so tasty with nice chunks of chicken . I too have autoimmune issues and this food didn't cause me to have any issues. Thank you.

reviews.title: So so good! I absolutely enjoy Kevin’s meals on
reviews.text: So so good! I absolutely enjoy Kevin’s meals. Specifically this one is one of my absolute favorites. I see myself repurchasing over and over again please continue coming out with more varieties. You definitely have a customer for life!

reviews.text: SO good! So much flavor and just enough to keep me full!

reviews.text: This product was so delicious and was a great way to have a healthy quick lunch at work!

reviews.text: This item is is so tasty! Will buy again.

reviews.title: I absolutely loved this product
reviews.text: I absolutely loved this product. The flavor was amazing. This was a whole meal and it filled me up.

reviews.title: I love the quality of the chicken but…
reviews.text: I love the quality of the chicken in Kevin’s products but I prefer the refrigerated larger packages. I don’t think the frozen bowls have enough chicken in them. I’ll cook my own rice to go with your other products

reviews.title: Tasty, healthy meal
reviews.text: The Kevin’s chicken burrito bowl is a healthy, tasty meal for nights when there is no time to cook.

reviews.title: Delicious!
reviews.text: Delicious! Love this for an easy, better-choice meal option!

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Amazing

reviews.title: 28g of Protein?
reviews.text: I'm giving this one star based on the questionable amount of protein in the finished dish. The box claims 28g of protein, which I'm assuming comes mostly from the chicken. As you can see in the photo, the pieces of chicken are sparse and as big as the tip of your thumb. Flavor was good, but it missed in delivering protein.

reviews.title: Frozen burrito bowl
reviews.text: This is a dish with mostly rice, small amount of chicken, nearly no veggies, and what looked like a tablespoon of sauce. It is bland and is hard to imagine a high protein content. I bought two and they were the same, so I do not think this was a fluke. I also bought an Asian dish, also skimpy and also not very tasty. Will not buy again.

reviews.title: No Bueno
reviews.text: I've gotten several of the freezer/cooler meals. The most recent was the chicken burrito bowl and it was just, not good. I've gotten other items and they we're ok, really only as last-resort work lunches. Likely wont get again.

reviews.title: Absolutely love it!!
reviews.text: This was the first of Kevin's I tried and absolutely love it! Great flavor and plenty of food for a lunch meal. I will DEFINITELY be getting this one again. Anxious to try some other flavors

reviews.title: My 2nd favorite!
reviews.text: This was bogo along with the bolognaise one. I had never had this brand and now I'm obsessed. I wish more stores had better deals on them because they can be pricy. I have tried a few other frozen meals by Kevin's but I only like two so far. I am excited try the other products they have. I just wish they offered a discount so I could taste and review. I am a big reviewer and will always give my honest opinion.

reviews.title: Loved it but...
reviews.text: I loved the chicken burrito bowl but I wish you eliminated the chicken and put in black beans and/or corn. I would prefer a veggie option and probably get the same protein.

reviews.title: Great - Alternate cooking option
reviews.text: Ok so these were on bogo and I am so glad I did. This was so good!!! I cooked in microwave for 3 minutes and then removed the plastic cover added a splash of milk and put it in the air fryer for 3 minutes at 350 degrees. It was amazing!

reviews.title: Pretty Good!
reviews.text: This one is my second favorite. Highly recommend. Packed with flavor and filling.

reviews.title: Better than Chipotle!
reviews.text: Packed with flavor, perfect portion for a 30 min lunch. Not too much not too little. This is my favorite so far AND I can pronounce all the ingredients! The bowl goes in a compost bin and viola, satisfying lunch and helping Mother Earth!! Thanks Kevin!!

reviews.title: There are NO instructions for heating without a microwave
reviews.text: I would LOVE to try the bowls I bought online from Thrive Market, but there are no alternate heating instructions for those who don’t ruin their food my nuking it.

reviews.title: Tasty, but not enough
reviews.text: Tasty, great ingredients, but very small portion and almost $7 at the store I bought it at. Better off going to chipotle to get 3 times the amount of food for only a couple dollars more

reviews.title: Delicious and tasty!
reviews.text: I have tried some of Kevin's other products and they were absolutely great. While I was recently in the store, I noticed the Kevin's frozen bowls. reviews.title: Dear God, Thank You for Kevin’s Meals!
reviews.text: Once again, this company has nailed it. As a person with celiac disease, traveling can be stressful when looking for something to eat. I can’t just stop at McDonald’s like everyone else does (I probably wouldn’t if I didn’t have celiac disease; just trying to illustrate my point). Today I discovered Kevin’s Chicken Burrito Bowl and Orange Chicken. I can’t sing the praises of these products enough. They’re safe for me, they’re NEVER over seasoned, and they don’t taste like the container they’re packaged in. You have no idea what it means to be able to eat safe, healthy, delicious food that’s easily heated up in a microwave. My husband does not have celiac disease and he loves these too. They allow us to travel freely (well, we have to book rooms with a microwave, and so far, casinos are they only hotels without) and have a healthy meal at the end of a long travel day. Kevin’s truly makes our lives easier because we don’t have to have that awkward and frustrating conversation with wait staff in so many restaurants.

reviews.title: Best frozen dinner I've ever had
reviews.text: Honestly, I hate frozen dinners. I don't buy them. I usually grab a couple to keep handy for my husband. I stumbled across the chicken burrito bowl while looking for something high in protein that he might eat. I was super impressed that the ingredients list didn't look like an inventory list for a chemist and that I recognized everything listed on the side of the box. Not being interested in much that was in my refrigerator, I decided to give this burrito bowl a try. It was an absolute win. It tasted like real food that I would make at home. I could taste the ingredients instead of some gloppy mess of mushy, unidentifiable sauce and rubbery protein. It had real flavor. I'll only be buying this brand going forward, thanks to its commitment to fresh, natural ingredients! Thanks for making "chicken" chicken again!

reviews.title: Kevin’s Feizen Bowls are Fantastic!
reviews.text: I have been very pleasantly surprised by Kevin's Frozen Bowl: Korean BBQ-Style Chicken. It was incredibly easy to prepare, making it a perfect option for a fantastic dinner without sacrificing quality. The standout for me was the chicken. Kevin's Natural Foods uses the sous vide cooking technique, and it really makes a difference. The chicken breast strips were exceptionally tender, juicy, and flavorful-nothing like the dry, rubbery chicken you often find in frozen meals. The Korean BBQ-style sauce was delicious, offering a great balance of savory and slightly sweet flavors without being overpowering. The broccoli and carrots still had a nice texture, and the brown rice completed the meal well, making it both satisfying and wholesome. I've now tried several of Kevin's Natural Foods meals, and every one has exceeded my expectations. The quality, taste, and convenience have been consistently impressive. This is definitely a meal I would purchase again, and l highly recommend it to anyone looking for a healthier frozen meal that doesn't compromise on flavor or quality.

reviews.title: One delicious frozen entree
reviews.text: This is one delicious frozen entree. Both my wife and I have had and it has definitely opened our eyes to the Kevin's line of products. Tasty, low in cals, high in protein and veggies. Deeelicious. Have bought it again and will buy it again.

reviews.title: A great dinner solution
reviews.text: This is such a great dinner solution for me! Perfect for an easy, delicious and nutritious dinner! I eat this at least twice a week!

reviews.title: I would not recommend this frozen meal
reviews.text: 1 out of 10 I would not recommend. The quality of the chicken is poor and very tough. There’s very little sauce. After you’ve microwaved the bowl it’s more like Parmesan basil soup. Add your own seasoning because there isn’t any. There’s no way the people who sell this tried it and said yes let’s put it in Whole Foods of all places. I’m now questioning Whole Foods quality control.

reviews.title: little to no enjoyable taste, BLAND!
reviews.text: I have enjoyed all your frozen, individual dinners! This was a huge disappointment because it had very little flavor. I loved the huge portion of chicken, and the veggies were fresh. It's the sauce? How about adding some onions or garlic and some additional herbs? I like basil but couldn't taste it. I shop at Costco and I always look in the frozen section for what Kevin meals they have. As a senior citizen, as we get older we lose the ability to taste things as we used to do. Please jazz this sauce up, with more flavors and more sauce. Dee

reviews.title: Pretty Dang Good
reviews.text: I liked this pretty well and would eat it again. The chicken was a little chunky and the sauce a little watery, but overall still pretty tasty. I am limited with my eating options as I have to watch sugar and carbs. And as you can see from image (should have done a before…lol) I cleaned my bowl. I am a teacher and also have very little time to eat. 😘

reviews.title: Chicken, Basil Parmesan
reviews.text: I tried this for the first time. I was pleasantly surprised at how delicious it was! Thank you!

reviews.title: Not good!
reviews.text: First of all, the flavor of the Parmesan Basil Chicken was so-so, too salty, heavy on the garlic, could not taste any basil. Sauce was watery, chicken was so dry and flavorless, wasn't sure if I was eating chicken or pieces of compressed sawdust. This was the second Kevin's bowl meals that I have tried, don't remember what the first one was, I do remember that it was not very good. Thought maybe it was just that variety, so figured I would give the brand a second chance. Second chance is the last chance, will not be buying any more of this brand. Very disappointing considering the price of over $5 at Walmart! I feel I was being generous giving this product 1 star! Please do not contact me, only provided my email address so I could leave a review.

reviews.title: Delicious but very small portion
reviews.text: I will start off by saying it is definitely one of the best gluten free microwave meals I've ever had and, being celiac, I've tried a pretty wide variety of them. But the huge caveat is that it is not very much food. This would be understandable if I was someone with a larger build, but I'm a 5'2" 100lb woman and I made more food after eating this simply because it wasn't enough for a meal. I know $7 isn't bad, but with the additional cost of needing to make more food to go with it, you're approaching the range of what it would cost to just go out to eat. I would say if you have money to spare, this is a great snack to have at home! But if your intention is to have a meal and save yourself the cost of eating out, this may not be particularly effective.

reviews.title: Best frozen meal ever

reviews.title: Amazing Way to Eat Healthy On The Go & Curb Inflammatory Response
reviews.text: I've tried so many of these food bowls from other companies. Not one of them has the same quality of ingredients in terms of freshness and taste. I stumbled upon Kevin's one day in a natural grocery store when searching for healthier options that work well to-go or for hard workdays, tried the BBQ Chicken one (was amazed, it stood out from the other frozen bowls I had tried immediately. I would go back to buy it and stocked up and quickly realized it was a natural favorite as it was constantly out in the store every time they had restocked. I decided to try the tomato and chicken pasta one with hesitancy but was again, blown away. These bowls are amazing. They flash freeze them (pretty sure) to lock in and preserve nutrients and taste and honestly, it works. It works well. It's the easiest and most convenient form of "healthy fast food" and at a price that people can actually afford. I started and I honestly haven't stopped looking for more and more Kevin's products. I'm just amazed at how good they are. I hope they keep coming out with more and keep testing more products.

reviews.title: Anti inflammatory win!
reviews.text: Being on an anti-inflammatory diet and (mostly) low fodmap diet can feel very limiting. This is the first brand I’ve found that has whole foods, doesn’t have seed oils AND tastes good. I took one bite and immediately looked up this website. This is a weeknight game changer for me. I can’t wait to try everything else!

reviews.text: I stumbled upon this on a recent trip to Costco and thought I'd give this a try since it's less than $4. A cheap, solid option for lunch at the office (or at home). I was pleasantly surprised at how much I liked this since I usually don't really like warm-and-serve meals like this. It was delicious, surprisingly well-seasoned without being overly salty, and full of flavors. I think the fire-roasted tomatoes used for the sauce gave it an extra bit of flavor. I would definitely purchase these again, and I can't wait to try some of the other varieties. 5 out of 5 stars!

reviews.text: PROS: Dinner is ready in less than 15 minutes. Meal is gluten-free, soy-free, certified paleo, grain-free, and chickens were raised without antibiotics. There's 0g added sugars. CONS: The chicken was dry and just didn't taste good. It says there are 4 servings, but there's maybe 2 adult servings...for my household, it wouldn't even be 1 serving for my husband or adult son. To make the meal more filling for me and 2 of my younger teens, we added steamed jasmine rice to the meal. The sauce is good even if it's not quite the same as homemade teriyaki. However, my biggest complaint is the chicken quality and flavor was just not good. I'd much rather dark chicken meat. If the chicken could be packaged separately from the veg and cooked first since it takes longer to get to temp than the veg, then that would help, but it's not packaged that way.

reviews.text: The Teriyaki-Style Chicken was just ok in my opinion. It comes with frozen chicken, carrots, broccoli and cauliflower. There was unfortunately no rice or noodle provided so I cooked white rice to serve with this dish. The amount of ingredients in the dish was evenly distributed but would not have been as filling without adding rice. I did have to add salt to this dish but even then the flavor fell flat. It's not a bad tasting dish it just needs more teriyaki flavor. I am curious to try their other meals. My family enjoys learning to cook and cooking our own meals at home and meal prep for convenience and portion control. I think these frozen family meals are a good option if you are short on time, space, or want easy healthy meal prep without spending too much time cooking.

reviews.title: Healthy Teriyaki Chicken!
reviews.text: I had the opportunity to sample Kevin's Natural Foods family meals and chose to try the Teriyaki Chicken. Overall, I really enjoyed the flavor, which had a balanced savory and sweet taste without being overly cloying or strong. The assortment of vegetables (cauliflower, carrots, broccoli) paired nicely with the chicken meat, and everything came together easily on the stove. The fact that the meal comes frozen was both a positive and negative: while the frozen nature makes it convenient to store and use when needed, the ingredients in the bag were fairly clumped together and it was a bit difficult to tease apart the sauce packet as well as the individual pieces of the meal. Unfortunately, my bag also seemed to have freezer burn that I assume resulted from mishandling at the retailer, and this negatively impacted the texture of the chicken (it was dry and tough). I'm guessing if I got another bag that didn't have the "frostbite", the chicken quality would be much improved. The meal is also a bit expensive for what you receive (portions seemed large enough for 2 or maybe 3 adults), but it's somewhat understandable given the focus on quality and clean, healthy ingredients. Overall, I think this meal is a great option when you need something easy to prepare but still appetizing and nutritious. It is particularly suitable for those who prioritize nourishing, wholesome, and clean eating.

reviews.title: Great flavor, good textures, super easy to prepare...but definitely not enough for a whole family.
reviews.text: I have celiac disease. That makes it difficult to find a quick, convenient family size meal that I can make for dinner that we all can safely enjoy. Kevin's is a brand I trust, having tried some of their products before, so I was really excited to learn about their new line of frozen family size meals. One of the new flavors we decided to try is the Teriyaki-Style Chicken. This meal was incredibly easy to prepare; the steps (only three!) are printed very clearly on the back of the package. It's basically a heat-and-serve meal...at least, in theory. The problem is, this is supposed to be enough for four servings, and as far as I can tell, it is expected to be an entire meal. NO WAY. There might be enough here for four servings of a side dish, but I tend to think of any dish with meat as a main course. There's no way there are four servings of a main course in this bag. Not for normal-sized humans, anyway. Fortunately, when I made this, I happened to have plenty of leftover rice in my fridge, so I was able to serve it over jasmine rice. That bulked it all up enough that it made a tasty dinner for my husband and me. The dish itself is surprisingly delicious! Teriyaki sauce isn't usually gluten-free, so I'm delighted that Kevin's figured out how to offer teriyaki flavor that is safe for celiacs. We both said we'd have liked more broccoli in the mix, but the textures of the vegetables and the chicken were really good--much better, in fact, than many frozen meals we have tried in the past from any brand. Like all Kevin's products, this stuff is certified gluten-free, but you'd never guess that from the taste. It does cost more than most similar family size frozen meals, but sometimes a small splurge is worth it to get dinner on the table quickly and without any hassle. This is a meal I would happily serve again...but only if I already had enough rice on hand to make it fill our bellies. I do recommend it, but more as a "dinner for two" frozen meal rather than supper for a whole family.

reviews.title: Needed for the dinner rotation!
reviews.text: This has become a regular in our freezer rotation. My husband has celiac disease, so finding meals that are genuinely safe and don't taste like an afterthought is huge, and this one delivers. It's certified gluten-free, grain-free, and soy-free, so I don't have to overthink it before serving it to him. It's also the perfect answer on nights when I have zero time or energy to cook, ready in about 10 minutes with tender chicken and a really good teriyaki-style flavor. The broccoli, cauliflower, and carrots cook up nicely too, so it feels like a complete, balanced dinner instead of just protein with nothing else. The family size bag is great for us, enough for both of us with leftovers or to stretch across a couple of nights. Will keep buying this one.

reviews.title: Tasty, needs more meat
reviews.text: I love Kevin’s products, the past year or so, I’ve been trying everything I see at the store, from the soups, sauces, frozen individual meals, family size protein meals. I came across these family size meals last week for the first time and picked this one up and two others. There was not a lot of meat in this, mostly vegetables. For the price, I feel there should be a lot more meat, especially for it being claimed as family size. This was enough for me for dinner and maybe a little left the next day, and my leftovers the next day contained mostly the vegetables that came in the bag. I would love to see Kevin’s increase the amount of meat in these ready to serve meals in the future.

reviews.title: Quick meal, but not completely clean ingredients
reviews.text: PROS: This meal was ready in 10 minutes. I like that the pasta is cauliflower-based, so gluten-free for those who have allergies. It's packed with veggies like kale, basil, zucchini, and tomatoes. For a time crunch, this is a super fast meal one could whip together to serve in a jiffy. CONS: It is not seed-oil-free. There is sunflower oil listed as the 5th ingredient in the pesto sauce). Also, there is xanthum gum and yeast extract, and I know folks with food sensitivities or GAPS diet try to avoid those specifically. Also, the chicken is just not tasty. It's skinless chicken breast, and it just tastes old. My family didn't care for this meal. It says 4 servings, but this could feed just one of the guys in my family, or sparingly, 2 adult portions.

reviews.text: The lemongrass chicken flavor was great. I really enjoyed the sauces — vegetables were a perfect blend. Easy to make, and I am a big fan that it was made to eat clean. reviews.title: A decent product but definitely small

reviews.title: Tasty and Healthy - Win-Win!
reviews.text: Kevin’s Butter Chicken is fabulously tasty and it’s made with real food, no chemicals and additives, so it’s a double win! This is an easy one-dish dinner with chicken for protein, green peas for vegetables, and brown rice for carb. It’s pretty quick to prepare. I found the hardest part was getting the chicken chunks to separate in the frying pan. I used coconut oil for the stir-fry part of the process, and when the meal was complete I felt it enhanced the traditional Indian curry flavor. The tomato curry sauce is on-point in terms of seasoning and, while it delivered mild heat, the spiciness didn’t increase and a drink of water cleared it completely. The aroma in the kitchen made our mouths water, and it tasted every bit as good as it smelled. For busy nights, this meal is a lifesaver; easy to prepare, healthy ingredients, and so delicious! It has 18 grams of protein per serving which is terrific, added sugar free, and also soy-free and gluten-free for those who have problems with that. We liked this butter chicken so well that it’s on my next shopping list already.

reviews.title: Could really use more Spice and less peas, haha.
reviews.text: I recieved this product for free in exchange for my review: This best part about this meal is the chicken quality. Some frozen meals have cheap tough pieces of chicken. This meal did not! This meal had nice white chunks of tasty chicken. For the price point (14.99) at my local Target I would expect nothing less. My husband and I appreciated the inclusion of brown rice to bulk up the meal. we did have Naan on the side just to add a little something extra. My husband and I both would love to see more spice with this meal. The amount of Indian inspired spices were pretty limited. We felt it was feeling bland compared to authentic Butter Chicken. Also.. whats with all the peas? Haha I appreciate the veggies but it had more peas than I would expect for a meal like this. The serving sizes are scant. The package says it contained 4 servings but its honestly more like 2 for adults.

reviews.title: Not bad, but definitely not my favorite butter chicken.
reviews.text: It can be difficult for anybody to get dinner on the table, but it's even harder when you have to feed your family AND you have an allergy or intolerance to certain foods. That's why I was excited to have the chance to try one of the new family-sized frozen meals by Kevin's Natural Foods. Each meal in this new line is much cleaner than most other items in the frozen aisle, and they are all soy-free and gluten-free with no added sugars. I am so happy to see a complete gluten-free meal in the frozen section! We tried two of these meals, including this one, the Butter Chicken. Having already tried another one, I anticipated needing to bulk this one out by serving it over rice, but there's already brown rice in it. I did serve it with a baked sweet potato and I have to say, my husband and I were both properly full when we finished. For a whole family, I think you would definitely need to serve something else with this, maybe some kind of vegetable, and offer the Butter Chicken as a side rather than a main dish. To my surprise, my husband really enjoyed this one. He can be hard to please, but he liked this stuff a lot. Butter Chicken is one of my very favorite dishes in the world, so maybe my bar is set too high, but this one was just okay for me. It has a little bit of a sting of heat in the sauce, but nothing too strong, so I think most older kids would eat this, too. I feel like it could benefit from more vegetables or something else to balance the textures...like maybe slices of onion? As a fast frozen meal, it was really good. It is something I might keep on hand in the freezer for nights when I need to find something easy and fast, and I love that it's gluten-free, but it wasn't my favorite. I still love Kevin's, but I think I preferred the family size Teriyaki-Style Chicken over this one.

reviews.title: Difficult Packaging & Disappointing Flavor
reviews.text: First & foremost, I love Kevin’s products. As a person with Celiac disease, I appreciate their line of options and the convenience, Kevin’s is a great brand! As for this product specifically, there needs to be a better solution for the packaging. They started strong with a nice quality ziploc-style bag, however on the inside, the sauce packet, rice, peas, and clumps of chicken pieces were all frozen together and mindlessly thrown in the bag. Although it’s advised to “break up” the contents of the bag prior to opening, it was incredibly difficult to do so when there are all of the individual pieces of rice and peas sticking to the plastic sauce packet. Not to mention, just throwing the rice and peas in the bag makes a mess. There would be a better way to do this if they individually packaged the rice/peas in one plastic bag, the chicken in another, and the sauce as is. I know that’s a lot of plastic bags, but nearly all frozen foods I’ve used have the same setup, and it makes it far easier to work with. The flavor of the butter chicken could use some improvement. I’m an Indian food lover and I wasn’t getting the same flavors I typically would get with Indian food, even in comparison to the Trader Joe’s Indian dishes you get in the frozen section. It’s hard to identify where the flavor went south, but it’s missing something. Again - no shade to Kevin’s, they just dropped the ball on this one. Thanks!

reviews.text: We don't tend to put much faith in Costco frozen foods in general, but this one was a surprise. I had read the soup may need some additions in terms of vegetables, chicken and spice. We made two large Costco packs for 4 people. In addition we made turmeric rice with carrots and peas and poured the soup over the top. It was surprisingly tasty and delicious and perfect with the rice and especially the peas, which helped make it. Even our kids who don't tend to like a lot of Costco foods were commenting on how good it was. It's filling and has the consistency of gravy so perfect for pouring over the rice. The downside, we all got a terrible case of gas and bloating that disrupted sleep for all of us individually. As yesterday was a snow day and we were stuck inside we didn't tend to eat much, so it was clearly a result from the soup. We cook heavily with onions and garlic, so I'm not certain it was from that or potentially the Xanthan for thickening. The question is, will we try it again since it is so good? Probably, but maybe smaller portion sizes.

reviews.text: I was in love at the first sip. The flavor is perfect! Not to salty, a little heat, but not burning. Tetxure is boss with the coconut creme. I am lactose intolerant so cream soups are usually off the menu for me. Problem is I don't remember where I bought it and suspect the Grocery Outlet. I hope they will keep it in stock. I did a search and it doesn't appear to be available in my area. I must have more!

reviews.title: Best soup
reviews.text: I have only had it once by I now I crave this soup, it’s so good that you can’t stop eating it. Not to mention it’s really helps if you have a cold. It might be better than chicken noodle. Please Costco never run out of this amazing soup.

reviews.title: Best Soup Ever!!
reviews.text: I did not have the highest expectations for this soup but thought I would try it. I could not believe how fresh and delicious it tasted! The chicken pieces were tender and tasty. The soup is creamy and flavorful. I am looking forward to having it again.

reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.text: Found this in My grocery store refrigerated section. absolutely delicious. Couldn't be happier

reviews.title: First time using product
reviews.text: I really enjoyed this soup. It was the first time I've had it. I will definitely keep buying it!

reviews.title: Yummmm
reviews.text: I love this soup! I am hoping they bring it back to Costco cause it might be my fav curry!

reviews.title: This soup is absolutely delicious
reviews.text: This soup is absolutely delicious. It’s rich creamy and full of tender chicken with just the right amount of hatch chili flavor. It’s one of the best ready made soups I’ve ever had. Please bring it back to Costco or any store to buy. I would definitely buy it again and highly recommend to others

reviews.title: Love this soup!!! Please start selling it
reviews.text: Love this soup!!! Please start selling it again😋

reviews.title: PLEASE BRING IT BACK
reviews.text: PLEASE BRING IT BACK TO THE STORES!!!!

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Awesome Flavor...

reviews.title: LOVE LOVE LOVE
reviews.text: This is one of those foods that a person craves. It’s perfectly creamy, a good amount of chicken breast, a touch of Smokey flavor and spiciness. I don’t understand why it isn’t in every store. I was buying two at a time at Vons, but now they don’t seem to carry it.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: I absolutely loved this soup! And my mom has a bowl as well and she said it was the best soup she had ever had. Delicious cheese flavor, great depth, and the hatch chiles are perfect without being too spicy.

reviews.title: I love this soup
reviews.text: This soup is my absolute favorite and none of the stores near me sell it anymore. I can’t find anywhere that carries it. I am devastated because this is literally the best soup ever

reviews.title: DO YOU HAVE A 5 GALLON PAIL?
reviews.text: This soup is AWESOME! The ingredients, flavors are perfect. It's hard to find right now so I hope Kevin will make more very soon.

reviews.title: Delightful soup
reviews.text: I am a homemade soup maker, something about the name and photo on the package intrigued me. Let me tell you that it was delicious, the flavor of the hatch chilies came through and added to the overall flavor.

reviews.title: Soup over rice
reviews.text: I heat pieces of rotisserie chicken in skillet and top with Kevin’s Chicken Queso Soup w/hatch chiles . Serve over rice with veggies on the side makes a nice quick meal. It also works well with Thai- style coconut Chicken Soup over rice. Ten mins or less dinner is served. I like simple tasty dishes, and I have been looking for a way to use the rotisserie chicken I have in the fridge. Love Kevin’s meals and (Soups)
I don’t usually get excited about food, but when I tried the chicken queso soup, I couldn’t wait to get more. My store sold out!

reviews.title: AMAZBALLS!!!
reviews.text: Never would I have thought this was going to be so amazing!! Especially fur gluten free and the protein content. Soup never separated after it was reheated. Going va k to the store to stock up!!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.title: the perfect wintertime soup
reviews.text: I did not expect to love this soup as much I did! Will definitely be buying more and trying other flavors and products!!

reviews.title: Yummy!
reviews.text: I was not expecting how much i would love this soup. I've been trying to find gluten-free soups and decided to try this flavor. So worth it. I will have to buy more.

reviews.title: Omg amazing!
reviews.text: I can't wait to stock up on all the flavors. Esp. To try the beef veg and chicken Thai. Good thing i left a few drops in the container. So good.

reviews.title: I would give more than 5 stars if I could!
reviews.text: This is absolutely my favorite Kevin's soup. I'm glad that I decided to try a couple more flavors after not enjoying the chicken cauliflower one. Because this one is fantastic!

reviews.title: On fire! In a good way.
reviews.text: This sauce is incredible! So far we have used it as a dip for sweet potato fries and keto Coconut Chicken bites. Looking forward to trying it as a marinade for other dishes, such as pork tenderloin. It has a fabulous “kick,” maybe a bit too spicy for some, but just the way I like it.

reviews.title: Really great!
reviews.text: This was a very great surprise! Very good and subtle taste. I will order again!

reviews.title: Delicious & Unique
reviews.text: What amazing flavor! The perfect way to add some deliciousness to what can be an otherwise boring, clean diet. The flavor is so incredible!

reviews.title: One of my favorites!
reviews.text: I love this one! I added pineapple to this along with the mashed cauliflower!! Or rice. Is amazing!! Fast and healthy! Thank you Kevin!!

reviews.title: Better than homemade.
reviews.text: I had given up on trying to find a good tasting teriyaki sauce at the grocery store, so had started making it myself. It’s not difficult, but time consuming. Kevin’s teriyaki sauce tastes every bit as good as homemade if not better and very convenient. I keep it stocked on my shelf.

reviews.title: Great sauce
reviews.text: This sauce has everything you would expect from a teriyaki sauce from a restaurant but much healthier.

reviews.title: Delicious but not spicy or salty
reviews.text: I really love this teriyaki sauce. I use it with pasta and veggies as a unique topping. I love that it isn't salty, or spicy. It's very tasty and I'll definitely order it again!

reviews.title: Kevin's Simmer Sauces Very Tasty, Quick & Easy Prep Time.
reviews.text: Hi, I purchased Kevin's Simmer Sauce pack from Costco the other day and topped it with veggie shrimp stir fry. The sauce was lightly seasoned and the teriyaki elevated the flavor. I like the balance of spices, however the texture after simmer was too thick. I would have rather enjoyed being able to spoon the sauce over the dish but it was caked onto the veggies and shrimp like paste. If I purchase again, I will have to thin the sauce a bit with hopes it doesn't dilute the flavor. Overall, your sauce packets save a lot of prep time and that's perfect for my household. I recommend this product.

reviews.title: Great Sauce
reviews.text: I bought this on a lark but I was so surprised at how good the sauce was. I used the recipe on the package and it was so good it was all I could do not to eat the whole thing.

reviews.title: You Got Me
reviews.text: I bought this off a clearance racknowing.It was healthy thinking.Okay.This is not gonna taste good because it's healwhen I tell you.I'm a new customer and I'll be trying another sauce because I tried the Coconut sauce with a rotisserie chicken oh o.MG, I had to add nothing to it as so good.I had a second helping. It tastes like I was eating at the Indian restaurant.It's just that good. The picture is all that was left because it was just that good

reviews.title: Highly recommended products.
reviews.text: From online ordering to my kitchen - simple process. Following the instructions on the packet - simple process with delicious results. I will continue to buy the entrees as they appear at Costco because they have been quick, easy, and delicious meals. With the leftovers I have made nutritious vegetable stir-fry dinners and then later as chilled salads over spaghetti for lunches. Kent W. Smith

reviews.title: My favorite!
reviews.text: I randomly found Kevin’s years ago while using Hello Fresh. I then wondered if I could get the sauce and create my own meals (veggies, meats, tofu, etc.). I found them online and have been ordering since. Thai Coconut Curry is my #1.

reviews.title: So delicious
reviews.text: I try to make healthy, home made food, but sometimes you run out of ideas, and I like when I don’t spend too much time in the kitchen. So, I found Thai Coconut Sauce at Aldi and decided to try it. I am so glad I did! I cooked spaghetti squash in an instant pot, after that I scooped out the flash on a skillet and added the Thai Sauce. It came out so delicious and satisfying. Thank you so much for creating healthy and tasty food. I am hooked now, today I went and bought other two flavors that Aldi carries, but I wish they had all available flavors. Now I need to find out where I can get other flavors.

reviews.title: Thai Coconut Sauce
reviews.text: Finally, a good, well-balanced sauce that hits all the marks.

reviews.title: Absolutely Amazing
reviews.text: Like everything from Kevin's Natural Foods, this simmer sauce is delicious! Thank you for making a clean diet so tasty!

reviews.title: Perfect for our busy family
reviews.text: We are a very active, busy family but we try to eat healthy. I originally found the meals, which are also delicious. However, being able to make these in batches has been huge for our family. We literally eat these Every. Single. Day. I buy meat (steak, chicken and shrimp) and pair these with rice. My daughters make them and take them for lunch most days as well.

reviews.title: Love it
reviews.text: As a single mom I try to look for ready to go foods due to working a lot,This is the best heat and eat dish i’ve bought so flavorful and doesn’t taste watered down like most curry’s ,thanks kev!!

reviews.title: Please don't stop making this EVER
reviews.text: Really delightful and innovative stuff. Can't say enough good things about Kevin's ready to heat dishes and sauces!

reviews.title: Will order again
reviews.text: I used this on sautéed chicken. Flavorful, natural taste. Will order again.

reviews.title: Great with flank steak
reviews.text: Marinated a flank steak for 3 hours and then cooked it on the grill. Sliced thin and served over a bowl of sautéed onion, tri colored sweet peppers and rice. Delicious!

reviews.title: SO TASTY!!
reviews.text: One of my favorites!! I think Kevin needs to have dedicated stores with ALL of his products! :)

reviews.title: Omg thank you
reviews.text: So last night had this with chicken and rice with avocado and sour cream all mixed together it was amazing. The sour cream complimented the mildly spiciness of the sauce but made it really creamy and delicious. The only downside was there wasn't enough for seconds and lunch today.

reviews.title: Cilantro lime is the bomb !
reviews.text: This is the best marinade I have ever eaten. I am having a hard time finding it in the stores right now but glad I found it online . Flavorful and goes with any kind of meat . Sooo good !

reviews.title: Quick and delicious alternative
reviews.text: I have my own sauce I make from scratch at home that I love, but this one is just as great and so I enjoy having something ready-made that I can use when I have a little less time to prep.

reviews.title: Never thought I could afford K barbecue
reviews.text: I loved this sauce. Like any recipe I made it my own and made sticky wings in a smoking hot wok. Not disappointed at all. Honey garlic sauce this week

reviews.title: Healthy tastes so good!
reviews.text: We have been trying to find different flavors for salads so we don't get bored or burnt out. This is a win! Cook your chicken thighs bits in salt and pepper until fully cooked then sauce to coat and simmer until sticky! Perfection.

reviews.title: King of Paleo Sauces!!!
reviews.text: Best paleo and gluten free sauces!! Love all their products. Hope to see the General Taos sauce in this line up soon!! 😄😄

reviews.title: Paleo dinners
reviews.text: I love the flavor and make my husband eat this on chicken or beef withal broccoli weekly. Love these sauces!

reviews.title: Wow!!!
reviews.text: I took a chance and ordered this Korean BBQ sauce, and I am so happy that I did. I have a pound of filet mignon tips that I cut a little smaller, browned them a bit in a skillet with a small amount of avocado oil, and now they are sitting in the sauce in my slow cooker. I have tasted the sauce several times now while stirring it. It also smells wonderful, and I am so looking forward to dinner! I will be keeping this in my pantry, and I want to try more flavors. Thank you Kevin!

reviews.title: Magic sauce
reviews.text: We love the Korean BBQ Sauce and order it as a way to easily take 'normal' meat and make it extraordinary. Highly recommend you try a package -- you won't regret it!

reviews.title: Incredible Flavor
reviews.text: This is an incredibly delicious sauce that allows those who are eating clean and not familiar with Asian flavors (like me) to enjoy those amazing flavors without going to a restaurant or ordering out. It also has the added benefit of enabling folks to enjoy such delicious food in a much more healthy way, for a fraction of the price! We LOVE Kevin's Natural Foods!! Suggestion: Sear a nice piece of Flank Steak (2 minutes each side) then let it rest for 4 minutes. While it's resting, add the sauce & veggies (anything else you want to include) to the pan and soak up the seared leave-ins. After the meat is rested, THEN slice the meat to bite sized pieces and add back to the pan. Let everything simmer for a couple minutes and serve.

reviews.title: Amazing Sauce!
reviews.text: Tonight I made this for my family. I added a little more Coconut Milk to tone spice for my little girl. I cubed chicken and let it go in the crock pot for about 4 hours. It was amazing, and so good that my little girl insisted she take it for lunch to school tomorrow. Love this brand so much!

reviews.title: Absolutely Delicious - Thank you for sharing this sauce
reviews.text: I caramelized a bell pepper & onion and nestled 4 seasoned bone in chicken thighs in a dutch oven. Bake at 450f uncovered for 15-mins. Pour sauce over chicken, cover, and drop temp to 350f. Bake for 45-min, checking and moving things around at 30-mins. Serve over white rice. UNBELIEVABLY DELICIOUS!!!

reviews.title: Tasty and super easy
reviews.text: We weren’t sure about honey anything with meat but we absolutely love Kevin’s beef bulgogi so we tried this. We used chicken as the meat and it came out super tasty and we loved it. We will definitely be adding this to our meal plan. It wasn’t super sweet or really garlicky either, just a nice flavor profile.

reviews.title: Honey garlic
reviews.text: This is absolutely great tasting sauce,I love honey garlic, Korean barbecue, I like orange chicken the most but it's been out of it for some time

reviews.title: FAVORITE!!
reviews.text: This is a favorite of mine and also my teens!!

reviews.title: So gewd!
reviews.text: We are a busy house and strive to make healthy, quick meals! Kevin’s offers so many different options at an affordable price. We have it at least once a week, sometimes twice!

reviews.title: Savory - recommend!
reviews.text: We love Kevin's and this one is right up there with our favorites. It's savory, a tiny bit sweet, and barely hot. It would fit all (or most tastes) for a beautiful warm meal. We used 1 lb. of chicken breast w/ 1.5 peppers and 1 onion and it was perfect. Mostly, we LOVE that the ingredients are much healthier than most takeout or store-bought sauces which are full of MSG and things we can't pronounce. Simmer it on low or warm once it's cooked so all the flavors can meld. We don't use rice because of paleo diets, but there is plenty of sauce to serve over rice too. This is going to be in our "last-minute" meal arsenal and we're looking forward to trying more products

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: While the sauce itself is ok, pairing it with salmon (as the package suggests) or any other seafood, for that matter, is way out of place as it simply tastes like makeshift chicken gravy with some lemon.

reviews.title: New Favorite
reviews.text: A fast casual place in my hometown offers citrus chicken and it’s fantastic (shoutout Fresh Kitchen) so I decided to give this new sauce a try. It is an amazing recreation of that chicken for me as someone who has since moved away. I just leave 16-24oz of cooked chicken or paneer to marinate in it and use as needed over a few days, and it’s packed with flavor just like all the other Kevin’s sauces. Will definitely be making this a part of my regular Kevin’s orders from now on.

reviews.title: Love it
reviews.text: This sauce is so delicious! I love to make a chicken piccata and this sauce is a lovely shortcut and also doesn't use dairy which I try to avoid. I can't say enough good things about the taste. I only wish I could find it in stores near me.

reviews.title: Love this!!
reviews.text: I love this! I ordered a sous kit snd did chicken then added this! I also added mandarine orange slices! Simply amazing!

reviews.title: Orange Sauce
reviews.text: This is the most delicious sauce I have ever tried, not to sweet !

reviews.title: Soooo Good!!!
reviews.text: This is so tasty! I make it with riced cauliflower.

reviews.title: Excellent flavor!
reviews.text: Used the orange simmer sauce with chicken and some veggies tonight. Really flavorful...even my husband who's "not a health food nut" was impressed!

reviews.title: Tasty!
reviews.text: Saw the Kevin’s Orange Chicken frozen bowls at Target and gave it a try. Very tasty! These are a lifesaver for people who are gluten/dairy/soy free. Can’t wait for the release of the sauce packets so we can make our own meals using the sauce.

reviews.title: It’s delicious!😋
reviews.text: It’s delicious & I’m usually not a gravy fan. Too fatty & slimy! This is just good flavor

reviews.title: Like homemade turkey gravy
reviews.text: Kevin’s Natural turkey gravy is super convenient and easy to heat with the 2-pouch packaging. It’s delicious, flavorful, and made with clean ingredients, which I really appreciate. A great low-carb option that tastes homemade without the extra work. I wish this item was available year round. It freezes well, and reheats by placing pouch in hot water. 1/4 cup serving size nutrional value exceeds my expectations for the flavor and keto qualifications. Please provide year round. I didnt stock uo enough during the holidays. Bonus Very Affordable.

reviews.title: Just as good as homemade!
reviews.text: This gravy is so good my wife drove to a Costco 30 miles away the day before thanksgiving because we had already eaten the ones she bought and our Costco was out of stock already. DELICIOUS! Definitely hoping they sell these every year!

reviews.title: Best gravy and healthy.
reviews.text: Why only seasonal? Good any time of year.

reviews.title: Honestly this gravy is amazing.
reviews.text: We came across this gravy at Costco over Christmas, and bought it on a whim. We were more than pleasantly surprised! I won't even bother making my own any more, Kevin's is top tier.

reviews.title: Excellent !
reviews.text: I stumbled upon Kevin’s Turkey Gravy at Krogers and picked one up although I roasted chicken, and it was absolutely fabulous even over roasted chicken. Kroger’s in my area does not seem to carry your products and that is such a shame. I managed to grab a few more and freeze them on a return trip. I always read ingredients and seemed also pretty clean so thank you .

reviews.title: The Best
reviews.text: Hey Kevin’s, I’ve made turkey dinners for 35 years of Thanksgiving’s, Christmas’ and Easter meals. My gravy was just OK, thin and greasy but it tasted good. Anyway, I discovered your gravy at Costco this year and it blew us all away. Thick and delicious. Well done. I will most definitely be on the lookout for it at Costco for the turkey seasons.
I really didn't like this gravy. Slimy and had an odd taste or spice to it. Not sure what it was but I won't be buying it next year. Not even close to a traditional turkey gravy.

reviews.title: Fantastic flavor
reviews.text: This gravy is ready to just heat & serve. My friends raved about it. Will definitely be purchasing more. You will not be disappointed nor go wrong with this gravy!!!

reviews.title: The best Turkey Gravy
reviews.text: My wife is so disappointed that Costco only buys this turkey gravy around Thanksgiving. Well, we are having turkey again for Christmas. I bought 2 cartons at Thanksgiving, but it's almost gone. We love it!

reviews.title: Kevin's Turkey Gravy is best commercial turkey gravy I have ever tasted!
reviews.text: My Mother was a master at turkey gravy and but it has been difficult to duplicate! Kevin's Turkey Gravy is one of the tastiest home style gravy I have had in a very long time! I hope it will become available through more sources. Its seems to sell out quickly! Thanks Kevin's for a wonderful product!

reviews.title: Best Gravy Ever
reviews.text: I count down the days until it’s Thanksgiving so I can buy the gravy, I could drink it. Absolutely delicious.

reviews.title: Best Turkey Gravy
reviews.text: I recommend this turkey gravy. It was absolutely the best. I’m not sure what else to say. I’ll get this again anytime. A good quality turkey gravy.

reviews.title: Best Turkey Gravy Ever!
reviews.text: I can only ever find it around Thanksgiving at Costco. I try & stock up and freeze it since I'd have to wait a year to buy it again. I could never make gravy that tastes this good! No one else makes anything as wonderful as Kevin's... If only it was in my local grocery stores or Costco year round... I'd be super happy!

reviews.title: Kevin’s turkey gravy
reviews.text: Wonderful, the best, but hard to find 🥲
Kevins turkey gravy is the best I have ever bought.

reviews.title: The best gravy
reviews.text: A friend of mine bought this for me to try after seeing that it was gluten free (I am celiac). It was out of this world delicious. I have now shared it with another friend that isn't gluten free and she loves it too.

reviews.title: Absolutely the Bomb! 5+ Stars....
reviews.text: Listen, this is the closest youcan to my grandmothers gravey! Thank you Kevin, for the ultimate Thanksgiving or any other day that you need gravy, THIS IS the one. Thank you bro...you did that thing!

reviews.title: excellent gravy
reviews.text: No need to go to the expense, time and effort to make turkey gravy -- just buy Kevin's. I hope they make it every year.

reviews.title: AMAZING GRAVY!!
reviews.text: This gravy was so good. It was like homemade. And I’m very picky about my gravy. My family is from the south and my grandma was a professional cook. We don’t use that powdered stuff! Good job, Kevin!

reviews.title: Best gravy
reviews.text: Just tried this gravy for Thanksgiving , we weren't disappointed . The gravy was so delish so much better than jarred gravy. We cook our turkey on a coal grill so there are no dripping to make fresh. Hopefully I’ll be able to find it for every holiday.. Thank you

reviews.title: Gravy with a flair
reviews.text: I actually read the ingredients first. Saw coconut milk. Hmm. This will be a bit different.... i know beef and coconut go well together... the gravy is thick. Very nicely spiced. & yes I would never of thought coconut but. It is very good. I like it... I want to try the turkey gravy and the sauces too! Good job Kevins !

reviews.title: Love the turkey gravy. Run from this
reviews.text: This isn’t good. So disappointed. Ruined our beef dinner and mashed potatoes. Yuck!

reviews.title: HORRIBLE
reviews.text: Why, Kevin, WHY??? Who mixes coconut and beef? Smells like coconut and sadness. Tastes like slimy, moldy, mushrooms. How could you do this to us? Straight into the trash. NOTHING LIKE THE TURKEY GRAVY! Truly vomit inducing. It’s like it’s trying to be vegan but badly and with meat stuff. No, just NO! Run fast and far away.

reviews.title: Wonderful Meal
reviews.text: Since my Wife became ill i do the cooking. Not very well i might add. I came Across Kevin’s Natural Turkey Breast and my Wife really enjoyrd it. Cannot seem to find it anywhere. Is there a way to order it directly? Thank You.. a truly wonderful product.

reviews.title: My Favorite Entree
reviews.text: We found this through Hungryroot, and we order it every week when it's available. I'm guessing it's seasonal, so we're hoping it comes back soon!

reviews.title: Over
reviews.text: Over-priced. Small portions.

reviews.title: This one is great
reviews.text: The turkey in this is 10/10. The gravy also so good

reviews.title: SO GOOD!!!
reviews.text: THE BEST TURKEY DINNER!!! So easy to prepare and tastes great!

reviews.title: The best Turkey Gravy
reviews.text: I just went looking for Kevins Turkey Gravy at Costco. I've purchased this product for the last 2 Thanksgivings and buy more than one package. You won't be disappointed! However, I am because it was out of stock and I'm cooking a Turkey breast today.

reviews.text: Not actually paleo because it contains MILK. Please be mindful of this if you have allergies. The "certification" guidelines state both no milk products allowed and ghee is ok, but that's a milk product. This "paleo certification" is a joke. I reached out to both companies and Kevin's basically said that just because they could, they would (put dairy in their paleo products). They also said the company who does the certification had great research on the subject. This company, who does the certification, their "research" is their guidelines which don't include any "research", and they never replied to me when I reached out about the discrepancy.

I didn’t read ahead of time and thaw before cooking so I quickly soaked the different component bags in hot water to thaw, though I know that’s not the preferred method of thawing things, it works in a pinch. The beef smelled like straight cooked beef, idk how to describe it but frozen beef smelling like actual beef is not the norm unfortunately. The pasta smelled so strongly of cauliflower that the whole meal smelled a bit flatulent, once it was done I hesitantly tasted and realized, umm… wow!!! This is really good!!! The textures were great, taste was great, what smelled like cauliflower didn’t taste like it, and the pasta had the right texture for stroganoff. For a frozen meal, this was so well done, I had high expectations from previous Kevin’s meals I’ve had, and this didn’t disappoint!

When asking my kids what they thought they both liked the sauce and the noodles. The beef was a little tasteless, I guess you could add some seasoning if you wanted to but I didn't due to being in a rush and wanting to see what it actually tasted like without anything added. I just added some green beans to the side to make this a meal that all 4 of us could eat. There were no leftovers due to the quantity of what you get in the package but my kids said that if I got it they would eat it but this wouldn't be something that they asked for again.

reviews.title: Kevin's Natural Foods, Butter Chicken
reviews.text: Something's changed with Kevins chicken and beef based meals. I sous vide a lot, know what a difference it makes in tenderness, moisture and flavor. I was impressed with Kevin's meals as it used this cooking technique and have been purchasing his dinners for several years. My last order had 6 chicken based meals and 1 beef sirloin. The chicken was dry and flavorless, I had a hard time chewing some of it and it was chokingly dry. The beef sirloin tips were tough with gristle. The sauces were still great. What happened? Even through Thrive these are spendy for my budget. That's a lot of money for premium meals that tasted like bargain factory $1.00 dinners. Actually made me kinda sad as Kevin's was my solid go to for healthy, flavorful, quality frozen meals for years. Very disappointed.

reviews.text: Something's changed with Kevins chicken and beef based meals. I sous vide a lot, know what a difference it makes in tenderness, moisture and flavor. I was impressed with Kevin's meals as it used this cooking technique and have been purchasing his dinners for several years. My last order had 6 chicken based meals and 1 beef sirloin. The chicken was dry and flavorless, I had a hard time chewing some of it and it was chokingly dry. The beef sirloin tips were tough with gristle. The sauces were still great. What happened? Even through Thrive these are spendy for my budget. That's a lot of money for premium meals that tasted like bargain factory $1.00 dinners. Actually made me kinda sad as Kevin's was my solid go to for healthy, flavorful, quality frozen meals for years. Very disappointed.

reviews.title: Kevin's Natural Foods, Savory Mushroom Chicken Bowl
reviews.text: Something's changed with Kevins chicken and beef based meals. I sous vide a lot, know what a difference it makes in tenderness, moisture and flavor. I was impressed with Kevin's meals as it used this cooking technique and have been purchasing his dinners for several years. My last order had 6 chicken based meals and 1 beef sirloin. The chicken was dry and flavorless, I had a hard time chewing some of it and it was chokingly dry. The beef sirloin tips were tough with gristle. The sauces were still great. What happened? Even through Thrive these are spendy for my budget. That's a lot of money for premium meals that tasted like bargain factory $1.00 dinners. Actually made me kinda sad as Kevin's was my solid go to for healthy, flavorful, quality frozen meals for years. Very disappointed.

reviews.title: Convenient
reviews.text: On days I forget to thaw out meat, have no idea what to make or are too exhausted to make dinner, these protein dishes by Kevin’s are a lifesaver. They thaw very quickly in some hot water in the sink and they cook up even faster. I don’t think there is a meal I’ve tried from Kevin’s that I didn’t like. They are family approved, too. The downside is some flavors are often out of stock and the portions are pretty small. Some of the meals are really stretching it to feed our 2 adults and 1 teenage girl whose appetite ranges from bird-like to ravenous from one day to the next. On low-capacity days, I throw in a bag of frozen broccoli into the microwave and heat up some frozen or packaged rice. I can have an entire meal ready in about 15 minutes. It prevents us from grabbing unhealthy fast food down the street. These Kevin meals keeps my health from spiraling from eating chemical-laden fast food when my energy is low.

reviews.title: Kevin's Natural Foods, Korean BBQ-Style Chicken
reviews.text: Something's changed with Kevins chicken and beef based meals. I sous vide a lot, know what a difference it makes in tenderness, moisture and flavor. I was impressed with Kevin's meals as it used this cooking technique and have been purchasing his dinners for several years. My last order had 6 chicken based meals and 1 beef sirloin. The chicken was dry and flavorless, I had a hard time chewing some of it and it was chokingly dry. The beef sirloin tips were tough with gristle. The sauces were still great. What happened? Even through Thrive these are spendy for my budget. That's a lot of money for premium meals that tasted like bargain factory $1.00 dinners. Actually made me kinda sad as Kevin's was my solid go to for healthy, flavorful, quality frozen meals for years. Very disappointed.

I’m a 100lb female and ate the meal in one sitting, but it could be split into two meals. I love sauce and this had plenty, in case you want to cook an extra batch of noodles, rice, or vegetables. But, for a quick go to side when my battery and capacity is low, this is so quick to thaw and heat up and goes with most protein I’d make. I know I’m eating wholesome, clean ingredients with this brand and it won’t contribute to my high inflammation and low fatigue days. I keep these stocked all the time just for the days when I can barely function but still need to feed the family.

It didn't taste good (and I got sick from it later (probably a food allergy reaction to a smaller ingredient in the sauce, I have those a lot)). On top of that, it didn't come with any kind of filler food (no rice or anything), so it's just the chicken, the sauce, and some minutiae veggies. So it's not even really a complete meal, and it's definitely not filling at all. I would definitely skip this and just get one of the protein trays with maybe a side (like a 90sec rice bag) that you can make up and that would give you more options for a filling dish.

The chicken was dry and flavorless, I had a hard time chewing some of it and it was chokingly dry. The beef sirloin tips were tough with gristle. The sauces were still great. What happened? Even through Thrive these are spendy for my budget. That's a lot of money for premium meals that tasted like bargain factory $1.00 dinners. reviews.title: Kevin's Natural Foods, Thai-Style Coconut Chicken
reviews.text: Something's changed with Kevins chicken and beef based meals. I sous vide a lot, know what a difference it makes in tenderness, moisture and flavor. I was impressed with Kevin's meals as it used this cooking technique and have been purchasing his dinners for several years. My last order had 6 chicken based meals and 1 beef sirloin. The chicken was dry and flavorless, I had a hard time chewing some of it and it was chokingly dry. The beef sirloin tips were tough with gristle. The sauces were still great. What happened? Even through Thrive these are spendy for my budget. That's a lot of money for premium meals that tasted like bargain factory $1.00 dinners. Actually made me kinda sad as Kevin's was my solid go to for healthy, flavorful, quality frozen meals for years. Very disappointed.

reviews.title: NO COMPARISON to the SELF-PREPARE kits. FLAVORLESS
reviews.text: I would like to preface this review by saying I have bought and loved many Kevin meals. This is the worst meal that I have eaten from his line or in frozen foods in general. I would not buy this again. Sadly, I cannot find Kevin's SELF-PREPARE Thai Style Coconut Chicken, which was our family favorite. This frozen version is NO COMPARISON and was beyond disappointing on many levels. 1. The curry is barely noticeable because when the frozen bits melt, it is watered down to a bland nothingness. 2. Price. The SELF-Prepare meals started at $9-$10 and went up to $11-$13, which was pricey considering it was only chicken and sauce for 2 people. But if you buy 2 frozen bowls, it will also be at the $12 price point, which is pretty much the same price as the kit, which also served 2 (even though it said 3, it was only 2), and actually tasted really good. 3. Microwaving chicken is a huge no-no for me. In my opinion, it ruins all meat, but especially anything that isn't beef is the worst! Also, if this paleo style is for health, what would be the point of sous vide chicken, only to turn around and microwave it? 4. Variety and overall flavor. When I made the self-prepare kit, I added several vegetables, usually around 5 different ones. This bulked up the meal and made it more filling and since I drained the vegetables after steaming them and then added it to the sauce, the sauce was still very flavorful and delicious. In the frozen bowl, the vegetables are minimal, mushy and water down the sauce to a point of being a completely bland and flavorless dish. Also, cauli-rice is only good if done right, and this is not it!!! Between the chicken and the cauli-rice, I think that was the 2 worst parts. I felt the same way about the self-prepare meals that they added green beans to for a while. Even though the green beans were good, I quit buying it because I got sick of green beans. Suggestion: Sear a nice piece of Flank Steak (2 minutes each side) then let it rest for 4 minutes. While it's resting, add the sauce & veggies (anything else you want to include) to the pan and soak up the seared leave-ins. After the meat is rested, THEN slice the meat to bite sized pieces and add back to the pan. Let everything simmer for a couple minutes and serve.

reviews.text: Great tasting and high protein

reviews.title: My fav Kevin's meal
reviews.text: Really good! For the ingredients,taste and ease the price is definitely worth it. My favorite Kevin’s meal, although I have found all the individual meals good. I’m not a frozen meal person but I’ve bought these over and over. Adding a little tajin makes this delicious!
Pretty mid. Just get chipotle.

reviews.title: Best Kevin's Product But Hard to Find
reviews.text: This is delicious and not too spicy for those of us who have limitations. In my opinion, the best meals are the coconut milk based ones -- especially if heating up in a work microwave. This and the Chicken Tikka can be a challenge to find though.

reviews.title: Winner!
reviews.text: I'd buy this again, good flavor! tad bit of spice but I'd still consider it mild. I would say this feeds 2 people. Cooked quickly on the stove and was super easy to make. Great for busy nights! Next time I'll add in red bell peppers and serve it over rice.

reviews.title: Easy to prepare
reviews.text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] The flavor curry was there but the taste was a bit bitter to me. My husband felt the same.

reviews.title: Savory Chicken Dish
reviews.text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Almost on.par with my butter chicken. Served with Naan and basmati rice. Quick to prepare and clean.

reviews.title: Kevin If you cannot replicate the easiest of flavors then don't bother
reviews.text: The package picture looks like butter chicken, but the final product looks nothing like butter chicken, it has the same hue as Tikka Masala. Also does not taste at all like butter chicken to the point I believe either all positive reviews are lies or just plain sad, because these people have never had actual butter chicken and if they ever do will either hate it because they believe it should taste like this imposter or love it and be completely confused as to what the heck they have been eating....Some weird spice combination that reminds me of Italian food with a hint of vomit. I'm very confused how anyone finds this flavor appetizing, I found this flavor worse than Kevin's Tikka Masala and btw that flavor wasn't good either.

reviews.title: First Kevins meal I have had and it was amazing
reviews.text: First Kevin's meal I have had and it was so good I felt the need to write a review. I've had a lot of different types of butter chicken and this one is awesome. The chicken was super tender and moist, only 1 minute in the microwave. The sauce is one of the best I've had, not super spicy but so delicious I used it as a dip for pop corned chips after. Total microwave time of 2 and half minutes. I will definitely be getting more of these.

reviews.title: This was great!
reviews.text: This was great! It probably had one of the better butter chicken flavors. It’s comparable to a restaurant. Worth it!!

reviews.title: Convenient Option
reviews.text: It tastes pretty good for being a chimichurri-like sauce. It’s definitely missing some zing so I’ve added a tiny bit of apple cider vinegar to my servings along with a pinch of salt. Since I use a small serving over the course of a few days, I add the contents of the pouch to a mason jar with lid. I would buy again for the convenience.
