reviews.title: New favorite!
reviews.text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] We just tried this flavor for the first time about a week ago and it’s our new favorite! They have lots of options as well as its own sauce to add into any meal! Will be purchasing again

reviews.title: Great taste
reviews.text: I thought about a month ago and was really impressed by the flavor and how easy it was to make. Makes a great meal on the go. Would buy again.

reviews.title: Delicious!
reviews.text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I thought this was delicious! I added some white rice, carrots and cilantro. It was such a yummy bowl my family loved!

reviews.title: This was so good! It was really quick and easy to
reviews.text: This was so good! It was really quick and easy to make. The sauce had so much flavor. I love that it fits my dietary needs.

reviews.title: Thai Coco-MEH bowl - flavor??
reviews.text: I tried the Thai coconut bowl which I ate just a few minutes ago. It cooked well. The chicken was tender. The rice was perfectly cooked as were the carrots and the broccoli, and the sauce had a slight flavor of coconut VERY slight - and I found that to be disappointing. It needs to be bolder!

reviews.title: Kevin’s Chicken Thai Entree
reviews.text: Very tasty. Healthy. Low in carbs and sodium! A winner!

reviews.title: I loved how quick and easy this meal was!
reviews.text: I loved how quick and easy this meal was! Bonus points for clean ingredients and being gluten free! Super tasty

reviews.title: Thai Style coconut chicken
reviews.text: I’ve been reading the reviews and don’t know why people think it’s bland, unless there are a lot of inconsistencies in the bowls. The flavor of mine was quite good if a bit spicy. Plenty of sauce. I even added brown rice.

reviews.title: Is this real chicken??
reviews.text: I am eating this as I am typing this. The chicken has the WEIRDEST texture -- almost reminds me of some kind of soya product or tempeh. I've had other natural and/or frozen entrees and bowls and had no doubt I was eating real animal protein. Is this lab chicken? 3-D printed chicken? It is so "grainy" in texture, I don't think I can finish it. I will not be buying Kevin's again.

reviews.title: Surprisingly bland
reviews.text: Was the curry sauce omitted at the factory? My bowl was surprisingly bland and not up to the Kevin's standard.

reviews.title: So Tasty!!!!
reviews.text: I usually do not have much hope for frozen gluten free meals, but this one sure surprised me! It is so tasty and I go every week now to grab a few for when I need a quick meal. In fact, I love this so much only have one complaint— Kevin is my brother’s name! Can we petition a change in name? 🤣🤣haha

reviews.title: Yummy
reviews.text: Am I the only one who loved this? 👀 This one is my fav so far.

reviews.title: Very light and tasty!
reviews.text: In contrast to some of the reviews I read, I love this meal! I think it has lots of flavor while remaining light and tasting very fresh! This was the first time I tried this one and will definitely buy it again!

reviews.title: a sad lunch at work
reviews.text: As a fan of the Kevin's products, this was my first frozen entree. I don't know if I microwaved it weirdly, but the chicken texture was very offputting. Got very chewy, and I wasn't sure if it was overcooked or what. After reading the reviews, I know it's not me. I ended up eating everything else. I agree with the reviews about lack of sauce, and it being dry. Now I'm sad and hungry. Counting down the hours until I can go home and eat. Do not purchase this product.

reviews.title: No sauce
reviews.text: This meal needs 3x or 4x more sauce. The only sauce I got was a thin, watery layer down at the bottom that didn't even come close to coating the food like the picture.
Kevin did sacrifice that flavor ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎

reviews.title: Misleading
reviews.text: This does not taste like Thai curry. It has more of an Indian curry flavor. Please consider removing Thai from the description.

reviews.title: A little misleading
reviews.text: Looks nothing at all like wha the packaging shows. Package shows big chunks of meat that look perfectly covered in sauce. When you open it it’s like shredded white chicken. Taste is OK but kind of bland compared to how it looks on the package. Totally get that. It’s never gonna look exactly like it’s styled but a little more accurate would be nice.

reviews.title: Just didn't hit
reviews.text: I've been trying all of the Kevin's meals and this was the least favorite.

reviews.title: Finally a tasty and healthy frozen meal option
reviews.text: Finally, a healthy and tasty option that I can buy into and look forward to having at lunch each day. I love that the sodium level for the Thai Coconut Chicken is lower sodium than most of the competitors yet it is very tasty! Thank you. 😊

reviews.title: 1st time for bowl
reviews.text: This was the first time I purchased a bowl. I normally purchase the Thai chicken meal (which is great). I was a little disappointed in the bowl. I would have liked more sauce for more flavor. I will just stick to the meals instead of the bowls for now.

reviews.title: Good, but not enough flavor
reviews.text: I was so excited to find a Gluten-free meal. This is the first one I tried. I was so bummed! The flavor sauce was less than half of what I hoped for and where's the coconut milk. Also, the chicken was a little dry.

reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text: I found this sub par. No taste. I had to add quite a bit of seasoning.

reviews.title: Very Bland
reviews.text: You could hardly taste the Thai coconut flavor and was also very bland and watery. Had more vegetables than chicken.

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: I never leave reviews for anything, and this bowl was soooo delicious, I had to come here and leave my comments! The flavor was spectacular and the quality of the meat and veggies was great. FAR exceeded my expectations (especially for a frozen meal!)

reviews.title: Amazing Flavor!
reviews.text: Kevin's a genius. Great flavor and healthier than what'll you find in a 'standard' grocery store. I appreciate that there wasn't an overabundance of sauce. Very flavorful!

reviews.title: unappetizing
reviews.text: The overall presentation of the bowl was disappointing. The chicken looked like canned chicken. Curry was very bland.

reviews.title: All the flavor with no guilt
reviews.text: Thai style coconut chicken was perfect. Veggies were crisp, chicken was savory and prep was easy, quick and no mess!

reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.text: The person who works in the frozen foods department at the Shoprite supermarket in Mount Laurel, New Jersey recommended Kevin's Natural Foods to me and I thank him every time I see him. The Thai Style Coconut Chicken frozen bowl was the first one I tried and it was absolutely delicious. The chicken, carrots, rice and sauce are wonderful. So far I have tried six different Bowls and they are all so incredibly savory and delicious that I wake up at 5:30AM in the morning every day and I find myself thinking about how many hours until lunchtime so I can feast on a delectable meal from Kevin's Natural Foods. I'm 74 years old and my freezer is filled with several different varieties of Kevin's Natural Foods.

reviews.title: Cats meow
reviews.text: Did not like. Chicken tough, weird flavor. Don’t waste your money.

reviews.title: Delicious and satisfying
reviews.text: This was the first meal I tried and found it delicious and satisfying. Can't wait to try the others!

reviews.title: Coconut
reviews.text: Love the coconut taste I think it needs more meat.

reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text: Might be better if you dress it up with your own creative ideas.

reviews.title: Delicious and easy
reviews.text: Delicious! I cooked on the stove in a pan and added the sauce as directed and paired it with cilantro lime rice. Very good. I will be buying again.

reviews.title: Spot on
reviews.text: Very happy with KEVINS. This one is our absolute favorite and we serve it on a bed of rice.

reviews.title: Addicted
reviews.text: I’ve bought this flavor four times this month. This one is my favorite flavor. I might have already left a review, but I’ve bought more since.

reviews.title: Do not buy this!!!
reviews.text: NASTY baby-food texture restructured chicken!! Mainly JALEPEÑO sauce!!! Ended up tossing whole thing!!!!

reviews.title: NASTY, BABY-FOOD TEXTURE CHICKEN!!!!
reviews.text: Threw it away - first word should have been JALEPÑO!!! Chicken was so soft it crumbled into paste!!

reviews.title: This dish should be called lots of soggy green
reviews.text: This dish should be called lots of soggy green beans with a little bit of chicken! About 1.5 servings in this prepared! Very disappointed in this product. Won’t be purchasing this again!

reviews.title: Better than I can make myself
reviews.text: While this Honey Garlic Chicken Stir Fry meal kit is relatively expensive, and I think it's a stretch that it is supposed to be 2.5 servings, I think the taste and ease of preparation make it worth purchasing. The packet of chicken seems on the small side, but you get lots of beans, and I think they taste fresh and good. The amount of sauce you get is ample, and I would describe the taste as slightly salty and spicy with some sweetness added in. For someone who lives alone and isn't the greatest cook, I appreciate that this meal stays fresh for a fairly long time in the fridge, and when I don't feel like fussing with a sauce and/or choosing a separate vegetable, I can always count on having something delicious for dinner with this kit.

reviews.title: Holy Orange
reviews.text: I love Kevin’s meals but there should be more of a mention of orange! Nothing on the packaging screams orange at you. A little orange garnish sure. And “a hint of orange” is mentioned in the description. But I couldn’t eat this. I hate orange and it’s all I could taste it’s really disappointing

reviews.title: Half the meat as others
reviews.text: The taste is great, but because you get vegetables, there’s only half the amount of chicken for the same price as the other meals. Not cost effective.

reviews.title: Nana
reviews.text: Disappointed with this product. Expected more honey garlic flavor. No hint of orange either. Not worth the 11.00 price either for the small amount of ingredients in package. I added white rice (not included). I gave an extra point for quick preparation. Next time I will just get a rotisserie chicken at the deli or the Meijer "Fresh" chicken strips located in deli too. (This item is a game changer for quick and delicious meals. Love the smoked pulled pork and fajita chicken too. Fully cooked and ready to use. Wish they offered a beef option.) a bag of frozen green beans and Korean BBQ or orange glaze.

reviews.title: Dinner for the Chief
reviews.text: My husband works long hours. He is trying to cut back on meat. This dish he enjoyed so much he thought I bought it at a restaurant! Would recommend as a quick preparation dish. One pot is all you need.

reviews.title: Too sweet
reviews.text: Easy and quick to make. Good portions. Good overall flavor, just too sweet. The sweet seriously over powers everything else. First few bites are okay, but the sweet just keeps building.

reviews.title: Delicious!
reviews.text: I tried this for the 1st time yesterday, and I'm HOOKED! Absolutely fantastic! I did add some chopped onions because I lovem them. Otherwise perfect as is!

reviews.title: Easy & delicious
reviews.text: I tried this today for dinner & both my husband & I loved it. Good protein/ carb ratio Side salad & that’s it.

reviews.title: Easy and so tasty!
reviews.text: I tried your cauliflower mash recently & we loved it. I saw the honey garlic chicken at Market Basket & gave it a try for lunch today. This was so simple to make & so much flavor. I will definitely be checking out more of your products. Plus, one pan for an easy clean up. I might make this & throw away the box & serve it to my husband. He will think I slaved over the stove. (HaHa) Have a great day, Sharon

reviews.text: I don’t know if this is even beef. I’ve never had beef have the texture of a magic eraser. Sauce was bomb though

reviews.title: Mushy Meat in Plastic Bag
reviews.text: This meat was inedible, it was mushy meat in a sous vide plastic bag, it was not edible even if you decided to sear it. They sauce was also inedible.

reviews.title: Mongolian Style Beef
reviews.text: It was good , however portion size was very small for the price.

reviews.title: Good easy dinner option.

reviews.title: Wonderful easy prep meal
reviews.text: This is our favorite kevin's meal - although the Korean chicken is a close second!

reviews.title: Tasty.
reviews.text: This was really good. Quick and easy to make. Good flavor, tender beef.

reviews.title: Tasty and super easy
reviews.text: We weren’t sure about honey anything with meat but we absolutely love Kevin’s beef bulgogi so we tried this. We used chicken as the meat and it came out super tasty and we loved it. reviews.title: Ready in minutes
reviews.text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I really enjoyed how easy it was to make this Thai-Style Basil Beef meal for my family. It felt almost restaurant quality, and it was easy to cook the meat, add the sauce, and make some rice (not included) - and dinner was served! My family asked where I got the recipe, and I almost didn't want to tell them. The flavor was decent, but not outstanding, as I've had a lot of authentic Thai basil dishes. This one was lacking in flavor and I wanted more from it, as did my family. The meat was good quality, though, and I like that Kevin's makes many of their meals with clean ingredients, and they can be refrigerated or frozen. I will definitely be trying other meals from Kevin's! I received this product free in exchange for my honest opinion.

reviews.title: This was amazing!
reviews.text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] This was ga Fantastic! Everyone was thrilled with the faste! I will say, it had a bit of a kick, but it was not enough to stop my little ones from asking for more! Such a huge helping and so easy to make. reviews.text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] So easy to prepare! Really appreciate delicious, gluten free options that are easy to prepare.

reviews.title: My favorite!
reviews.text: I randomly found Kevin’s years ago while using Hello Fresh. I then wondered if I could get the sauce and create my own meals (veggies, meats, tofu, etc.). I found them online and have been ordering since. Thai Coconut Curry is my #1.

reviews.title: So delicious
reviews.text: I try to make healthy, home made food, but sometimes you run out of ideas, and I like when I don’t spend too much time in the kitchen. So, I found Thai Coconut Sauce at Aldi and decided to try it. I am so glad I did! I cooked spaghetti squash in an instant pot, after that I scooped out the flash on a skillet and added the Thai Sauce. It came out so delicious and satisfying. Thank you so much for creating healthy and tasty food. I am hooked now, today I went and bought other two flavors that Aldi carries, but I wish they had all available flavors. Now I need to find out where I can get other flavors.

reviews.title: Thai Coconut Sauce
reviews.text: Finally, a good, well-balanced sauce that hits all the marks.

reviews.title: Absolutely Amazing
reviews.text: Like everything from Kevin's Natural Foods, this simmer sauce is delicious! Thank you for making a clean diet so tasty!

reviews.title: Perfect for our busy family
reviews.text: We are a very active, busy family but we try to eat healthy. I originally found the meals, which are also delicious. However, being able to make these in batches has been huge for our family. We literally eat these Every. Single. Day. I buy meat (steak, chicken and shrimp) and pair these with rice. My daughters make them and take them for lunch most days as well.

reviews.title: Love it
reviews.text: As a single mom I try to look for ready to go foods due to working a lot,This is the best heat and eat dish i’ve bought so flavorful and doesn’t taste watered down like most curry’s ,thanks kev!!

reviews.title: Please don't stop making this EVER
reviews.text: Really delightful and innovative stuff. Can't say enough good things about Kevin's ready to heat dishes and sauces!

reviews.title: Easy and Healthy Meal!
reviews.text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] ### Product Review I really enjoyed Kevin’s Korean BBQ-Style Chicken Frozen Bowl! It was incredibly easy to prepare and gave me a quick, convenient meal in less than five minutes. The bowl includes chicken, broccoli, and rice in a tasty Korean BBQ-style sauce. I liked that it was a satisfying and healthier option without requiring much time or effort, making it perfect for a busy day. The flavors were delicious, and I would definitely consider purchasing it again! I received this product for free in exchange for trying it and sharing my honest opinion. All opinions are my own.

reviews.title: Fantastic!
reviews.text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I absolutely loved this Korean BBQ bowl! I love the Kevin’s brand and am pleasantly surprised with each new flavor I try. This was the first time I’ve seen frozen bowls before and wow only 300 Cali per bowl with 21g of protein is great! This was perfect for dinner and was very filing. I thought it tasted great and was very happy with the flavor. I love that it comes in a 4 pack and this brand is dedicated to using clean ingredients. I will definitely buy this again!

reviews.title: A fine meal
reviews.text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Maybe my expectations were just high because of all the hype I've heard around Kevin's meals, but this meal felt very mediocre to me. It was fine and I'll eat them all, but I wouldn't buy them again. It wasn't bad at all, but it tasted like any other frozen meal. Just basic chicken, rice, and veggies with some sauce. I thought the sauce would be a little more unique or flavorful, but it tasted like really basic teriyaki sauce. Again, it wasn't bad by any means, and it's nice to have some quick, balanced meals on hand, I just think I had expectations that it would be different and more "Korean BBQ."

reviews.title: Just buy it.
reviews.text: I have my first Kevin's meal tonight. I was surprised at how much I love the taste and quality. I'm currently breastfeeding while trying to eat healthy food with less artificial ingredients. The quality of this meal is delicious. I hope my local grocery store carries more Kevin's frozen meals. will for sure be giving them the thumbs up. the taste is like i was at a restaurant.

reviews.title: A must buy!!
reviews.text: I absolutely love Kevin’s brand as a whole. These are great for lunches at work or just a night that you aren’t super hungry! I wish the portions were bigger but the taste is amazing!

reviews.title: Tasty lunch
reviews.text: This was a good meal for lunch…very flavorful and the chicken really is chicken and tasted good unlike a lot of frozen meals that have chewy mystery meat…this one was really good and I’ll get it again.

reviews.title: Delicious and healthy
reviews.text: I have my first Kevin's meal tonight and I was pleasantly surprised at how much I love the taste and quality. I'm counting calories while trying to eat healthy food with less artificial ingredients and I've found it. The quality of this meal is perfect. I hope my local grocery store carries more Kevin's frozen meals.

reviews.title: Very good tasting and good size for 1 meal
reviews.text: Very good tasting and good size for 1 meal. Very healthy and reasonable

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: I’m in a calorie deficit and these bowls have literally been a game changer for me. People always talk about how small they are, but never stop to look at the protein and calorie count. Of course they’re not going to be a massive meal… that’s part of the problem. We’ve normalized overeating and oversized portions. Every bowl I’ve tried has actually been really good, and they’re honestly so much healthier than a lot of the other processed frozen meals out there. I just wish they had more flavors! Remember, eat to be satisfied, not stuffed. Love love love 10:10 😍

reviews.title: Everybody was talking
reviews.text: I took a bowl to work for lunch... And every coworker popped their head in because the smell wafting thought the office was so enticing. The flavor was amazing. And the portion size seemed just right for my taste. I would love it if there was a riced cauliflower version too. ❤️

reviews.title: Joke of A child Meal
reviews.text: While the taste was okay, the meal was so small that it is better for a 6-year-old child. I can make just as good in terms of taste but in a larger size for cheaper. Won't be buying these "meals'/snacks.....

reviews.title: Yuck….
reviews.text: The chicken was absolutely totally dry and totally tasteless…the worst frozen meal I’ve ever had…. Not much taste or flavor of anything 🤷… the only thing that was passable as decent was the broccoli….this is the first time I’ve had a meal from Kevin’s and definitely my last!

reviews.title: Very good taste!
reviews.text: I like that there is plenty of sauce in this Kevin's bowl.

reviews.title: Pretty darn good!
reviews.text: Not a fan of frozen meals, but found this on sale & tossed in the freezer. Unfortunately, I have not been able to cook on my gas stove for the last 2 weeks due to a gas leak so decided to try this tonight in the microwave. Followed the directions & was very surprised how good it is. Love the chicken is not rubbery as most in frozen meals are & overall it was great. Wish it had a few more veggies but that's my preference. Will definitely try more varieties. Thank you for making "real food"

reviews.title: More like this please!
reviews.text: I love how simplistic this bowl is; good rice, nice sauce, good quality chicken, and broccoli. I'd love more versions of this same bowl. Maybe even a larger size option. I could do without the carrots but I just give them to my dog.

reviews.title: 10/10 recommend
reviews.text: thank you thank you thank you thank you thank you for making these frozen meals! I've been chronically ill and unable to eat gluten for over a decade now, and it's hard for me to muster energy to cook for myself. They just started stocking these in the grocery store by me, and I was so happy when I saw them. These meals are so good, nicely balanced, and they seem really fresh. I really appreciate having these as an option for an easy meal every once in a while.

reviews.title: Genuinely changed my life!!!
reviews.text: I am autistic and have ADHD, so I often struggle with eating full, healthy meals especially on low-energy days. Kevin's Natural Foods makes frozen meals that are healthy, easy to make, AND delicious (even with no add-ins). If more companies made frozen meals like this, I think we'd all be a bit healthier. You won't regret trying it!

reviews.title: My favorite of the bunch!
reviews.text: This bowl was the tastiest yet of the three of tried! It had the most vegetables and best blend of flavors. I felt like the others skimped on the veggies. The ingredient list is top notch in comparison to most anything else processed and frozen. Thanks Kevin for making “dinner done” tastefully. I hope you remain true to your vision and tastebuds!

reviews.title: Love it!

reviews.title: My favorite

reviews.title: Great meal

reviews.title: Delicious and filling

reviews.title: Much Better than Lean Cuisine! Or Others!!

reviews.text: This is delicious and not too spicy for those of us who have limitations. In my opinion, the best meals are the coconut milk based ones -- especially if heating up in a work microwave. This and the Chicken Tikka can be a challenge to find though.

reviews.title: Amazing Way to Eat Healthy On The Go & Curb Inflammatory Response
reviews.text: I've tried so many of these food bowls from other companies. Not one of them has the same quality of ingredients in terms of freshness and taste. I stumbled upon Kevin's one day in a natural grocery store when searching for healthier options that work well to-go or for hard workdays, tried the BBQ Chicken one (was amazed, it stood out from the other frozen bowls I had tried immediately. I would go back to buy it and stocked up and quickly realized it was a natural favorite as it was constantly out in the store every time they had restocked. I decided to try the tomato and chicken pasta one with hesitancy but was again, blown away. These bowls are amazing. They flash freeze them (pretty sure) to lock in and preserve nutrients and taste and honestly, it works. It works well. It's the easiest and most convenient form of "healthy fast food" and at a price that people can actually afford. I started and I honestly haven't stopped looking for more and more Kevin's products. I'm just amazed at how good they are. I hope they keep coming out with more and keep testing more products.

reviews.title: Very good!
reviews.text: These are really good surprisingly. I dont often buy premade foods, but this i would buy again. It was quick and delicious and the ingredients were a lot better than an average tv dinner.

reviews.title: Anti inflammatory win!
reviews.text: Being on an anti-inflammatory diet and (mostly) low fodmap diet can feel very limiting. This is the first brand I’ve found that has whole foods, doesn’t have seed oils AND tastes good. I took one bite and immediately looked up this website. This is a weeknight game changer for me. I can’t wait to try everything else!

reviews.title: Surprisingly Delicious!

reviews.title: Delicious!

The pasta was perfectly cooked, the zucchini wasn't mushy and the chicken was not rubbery. I liked it so much I wish I had purchased two of this style. I had purchased another flavor, which is also good, but this was my favorite. I will be purchasing more and I recommend it.

reviews.title: Quick meal
reviews.text: This was a very easy meal to prepare. I was able to do it one handed after having shoulder surgery. I appreciated that the meal offers clean ingredients and included gluten free noodles. I thought the flavor was a little lacking. It also says that it is 4 servings. Those are very small servings for a main course. Probably wouldn't try this meal again.

reviews.title: Quick & easy meal
reviews.text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] We've been using Kevin's meals for a while now, so we were excited to see these new multi-serve family sized meal kits. It was really easy to make- you just dump the contents into a heated skillet and cook for 12-15 mins, defrost the sauce packet in hot water, add the sauce packet, and stir. We thought it tasted good and was a great solution for a jam-packed day that needed a simple dinner solution. I do love that there are no added sugars, and the sodium level is reasonable. The cauliflower pasta tastes like regular pasta, but without all the extra carbs. There's a great amount of protein and a reasonable amount of fat. Overall, it is a well-balanced meal with real ingredients. We did find, however, that the suggested 4 servings was a bit of a stretch. We felt it better served 3 adults with a normal-sized portion. We do agree that the sauce needs a bit of a revision. It's not our favorite.

reviews.title: Good but could be have more flavor.
reviews.text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I love the fact that the noodles didn't taste like cauliflower. However, the noodles did stick to the pan even though I followed the directions. I wish there was more chicken in this one. The pesto flavor is very mild, I was expecting more flavor in this one. Love that this is a healthy option for my busy family.

reviews.title: Great flavors and meal overall.
reviews.text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Delicious! The pesto was a bit chunky, but it was very good. reviews.title: Too Much Garlic
reviews.text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Kevin’s Pesto Chicken Pasta has high quality ingredients. It’s made with real food, no chemicals and additives, so I feel good about that. This is an easy one-dish dinner with chicken for protein, and zucchini and cauliflower pasta for vegetables. I’d advise letting the package thaw for a bit as the chicken chunks are difficult to separate. In terms of taste, garlic lovers will adore this. However, this dish delivers way too much garlic for my husband and me. Not only is there garlic in the pesto sauce, it’s also listed again in general ingredients. The first few forkfuls were divine, but then the garlic hit and it became less pleasant. Since the package serves four people, we each ate just one serving, and kept the rest for another meal. I added some high-protein pasta and more vegetables to the leftovers, and then the garlic was at the appropriate level for us. This is a nice dinner for busy nights when we are hangry and need something quick! It’s easy to prepare, has healthy ingredients, 17 grams of protein per serving, zero added sugar, and also milk-free and gluten-free for those who have problems with that.

reviews.title: Great for Allergies
reviews.text: It does smell wonderful when cooking and we do add some of our own salt/flavor to taste. If you or your group has multiple food allergies, then you may also find this very helpful especially when short on time or energy. I like to heat it in the pan with some garlic olive oil and keep the lid on to ensure all the sauce remains and everything turns out well. Like anything healthy it's not perfect, but it's as close as some of us can get when it comes to healthful, savory, and fast for allergy needs.

reviews.title: Quick, healthy and tasty, but...
reviews.text: Just finished a practically perfect Orange Chicken dinner from Kevin's. It was a perfect size (filling) meal for a single person, healthy (for an elder who needs good nutrition), just the right balance of protein and vegetables, all cooked to a great taste. Loved it! I have just one recommendation for absolute perfection: Please add more orange sauce to the mix. The sauce is quickly absorbed into the rice and isn't enough to lightly coat the chunks of chicken. It really needs a little more pizazz to get the full flavor throughout the meal. Thanks for making good food at an affordable price. Now, if you could just flavor it up a bit, I'd give it 5 stars!

reviews.title: Tastes Great for Low Carb and Low Calorie
reviews.text: Rule #1: DO NOT heat this in the microwave. It will not thicken correctly, even though it allows you the option of microwaving. Heat it up in a skillet. Rule #2: Do not expect this to taste the same as your full-calorie meals. It is low calorie and low carb. It's going to take some getting used to if you are not already used to eating those kind of meals. Kevin's is one of the best brands that I have found when it comes to low calorie and just happens to have the bonus of low carb (I don't count carbs). I personally would recommend anything from this brand. I haven't disliked any of it.

reviews.title: Easy
reviews.text: Was excited to try this as I was missing Hawaii. I followed the instructions which included “massaging the chicken” to break it apart. reviews.title: Quick + Healthy = Winner Winner Chicken Dinner
reviews.text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] As a mom, a busy student athletes, we often don’t get home till 9 PM on school nights. Being able to put something healthy and quick on the table is always the goal. This Hawaiian style chicken meal does the trick. My kids loved it, and I was able to serve it with steam in a bag vegetables as well as steam in a bag of rice and dinner was done in less than 10 minutes. Key points to consider, make sure you massage the bag with the chicken very well to break it up into bite-size pieces. And don’t forget to drain it. Outside of that, it is almost impossible to mess up the meal. I often order a healthy brand of delivery meals… Let’s just say my kids preferred this way more my preteen son is on plate number three!

reviews.text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Honestly didnt like the look of the chicken, I thought it was a heat and eat product especially since it said "ready in 5 minutes ". So much to my surprise I opened the tray to find this stark white chunk of meat ( thought it would be strips too) . It was to be drained and browned then add the sauce. I did that and browning the chicken to get it from that white paste color definitely took longer than the 5 minutes prep I anticipated. Despite the additional prep time the end result did turn out alright and looked similar to the photo on the box. I did stove top preparation and was cautious not to over cook the chicken since it was already cooked via sous vide method . I cant imagine how thos would turn out if I had followed the microwave option but I imagine white and rubbery. In the ebd the sauce waa extremely too sweet for my liking- it alao seemed one dimensional- very sweet I think I'd enjoy a different flavor more, something more savory. I would purchase this variety again but I'm open to giving Kevin's another go. The chicken was good quality and the portion fair for the price. Now that I'm aware that it takes a little more prep I'll adjust my dinner plans accordingly.

reviews.text: I loved this sauce. Like any recipe I made it my own and made sticky wings in a smoking hot wok. Not disappointed at all. Honey garlic sauce this week

reviews.title: Healthy tastes so good!
reviews.text: We have been trying to find different flavors for salads so we don't get bored or burnt out. This is a win! Cook your chicken thighs bits in salt and pepper until fully cooked then sauce to coat and simmer until sticky! Perfection.

reviews.title: King of Paleo Sauces!!!
reviews.text: Best paleo and gluten free sauces!! Love all their products. Hope to see the General Taos sauce in this line up soon!! 😄😄

reviews.title: Paleo dinners
reviews.text: I love the flavor and make my husband eat this on chicken or beef withal broccoli weekly. Love these sauces!

reviews.title: Magic sauce
reviews.text: We love the Korean BBQ Sauce and order it as a way to easily take 'normal' meat and make it extraordinary. Highly recommend you try a package -- you won't regret it!

reviews.title: Incredible Flavor
reviews.text: This is an incredibly delicious sauce that allows those who are eating clean and not familiar with Asian flavors (like me) to enjoy those amazing flavors without going to a restaurant or ordering out. It also has the added benefit of enabling folks to enjoy such delicious food in a much more healthy way, for a fraction of the price! We LOVE Kevin's Natural Foods!! Suggestion: Sear a nice piece of Flank Steak (2 minutes each side) then let it rest for 4 minutes. While it's resting, add the sauce & veggies (anything else you want to include) to the pan and soak up the seared leave-ins. After the meat is rested, THEN slice the meat to bite sized pieces and add back to the pan. Let everything simmer for a couple minutes and serve.
